using System.Security.Claims;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization.Policy;

namespace Bank.API.Authorization;

public enum AppPermission
{
    ManageCheckFiles,
    UploadDataFiles,
    Sort
}

/// <summary>
/// Policies Ø¨ØªØªØ´ÙŠÙƒ Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø¯Ø§ØªØ§Ø¨ÙŠØ² ÙÙŠ ÙƒÙ„ Ø·Ù„Ø¨ (IPermissionService) â€” Ù…Ø´ Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ù€ JWTØŒ
/// ÙØ£ÙŠ ØªØºÙŠÙŠØ± Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø¯Ù…Ù† Ø¨ÙŠØ³Ø±ÙŠ ÙÙˆØ±Ù‹Ø§. Ø­Ø·Ù‡Ø§ Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø£ÙŠ endpoint Ø¨Ù€ [Authorize(Policy = PermissionPolicies.X)].
/// Ø§Ù„Ù€ policy Ø¨ØªØ´ÙŠÙƒ Ø§Ù„ØµÙ„Ø§Ø­ÙŠØ© Ø§Ù„Ø¹Ø§Ù…Ø© Ø¨Ø³Ø› Ø§Ù„Ù‚ÙˆØ§Ø¹Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ù…Ø­ØªØ§Ø¬Ø© Ù…Ù„Ù Ù…Ø¹ÙŠÙ‘Ù† (Ù…Ù„ÙƒÙŠØ© Ù…Ù„Ù Ø§Ù„Ø¯Ø§ØªØ§ØŒ
/// Ù…Ù„ÙØ§Øª Ø§Ù„ÙØ±Ø² Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­Ø©) ÙØ§Ø¶Ù„Ø© Ø¬ÙˆÙ‡ Ø§Ù„Ù€ services.
/// </summary>
public static class PermissionPolicies
{
    public const string ManageCheckFiles = "Permission.ManageCheckFiles";
    public const string UploadDataFiles = "Permission.UploadDataFiles";
    public const string Sort = "Permission.Sort";

    public static void AddPermissionPolicies(this AuthorizationOptions options)
    {
        options.AddPolicy(ManageCheckFiles, p => p.RequireAuthenticatedUser().AddRequirements(new PermissionRequirement(AppPermission.ManageCheckFiles)));
        options.AddPolicy(UploadDataFiles, p => p.RequireAuthenticatedUser().AddRequirements(new PermissionRequirement(AppPermission.UploadDataFiles)));
        options.AddPolicy(Sort, p => p.RequireAuthenticatedUser().AddRequirements(new PermissionRequirement(AppPermission.Sort)));
    }
}

public sealed class PermissionRequirement : IAuthorizationRequirement
{
    public PermissionRequirement(AppPermission permission) => Permission = permission;
    public AppPermission Permission { get; }
}

public sealed class PermissionAuthorizationHandler : AuthorizationHandler<PermissionRequirement>
{
    private readonly IPermissionService _permissions;

    public PermissionAuthorizationHandler(IPermissionService permissions)
    {
        _permissions = permissions;
    }

    protected override async Task HandleRequirementAsync(AuthorizationHandlerContext context, PermissionRequirement requirement)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(context.User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier), out var userId)) return;

        var cancellationToken = (context.Resource as HttpContext)?.RequestAborted ?? CancellationToken.None;

        var deniedReason = requirement.Permission switch
        {
            AppPermission.ManageCheckFiles => await _permissions.CanManageCheckFilesAsync(userId, cancellationToken)
                ? null : "Ù„ÙŠØ³ Ù„Ø¯ÙŠÙƒ ØµÙ„Ø§Ø­ÙŠØ© Ø¥Ø¶Ø§ÙØ© Ø£Ùˆ Ø­Ø°Ù Ù…Ù„ÙØ§Øª Ø§Ù„ØªØ´ÙŠÙŠÙƒ.",
            AppPermission.UploadDataFiles => await _permissions.CanUploadDataFilesAsync(userId, cancellationToken)
                ? null : "Ù„ÙŠØ³ Ù„Ø¯ÙŠÙƒ ØµÙ„Ø§Ø­ÙŠØ© Ø±ÙØ¹ Ù…Ù„ÙØ§Øª Ø§Ù„Ø¯Ø§ØªØ§.",
            AppPermission.Sort => await _permissions.GetSortDeniedReasonAsync(userId, cancellationToken),
            _ => "ØµÙ„Ø§Ø­ÙŠØ© ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø¹Ø±ÙˆÙØ©."
        };

        if (deniedReason is null)
            context.Succeed(requirement);
        else
            context.Fail(new AuthorizationFailureReason(this, deniedReason));
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Ù„Ù…Ø§ policy ØµÙ„Ø§Ø­ÙŠØ© ØªØ±ÙØ¶ Ø§Ù„Ø·Ù„Ø¨ØŒ Ø¨ÙŠØ±Ø¬Ø¹ 403 Ø¨Ù†ÙØ³ Ø´ÙƒÙ„ ApiResponse ÙˆØ±Ø³Ø§Ù„Ø© Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠ
/// (Ø²ÙŠ Ø±ÙØ¶ Ø§Ù„Ù€ services) Ø¨Ø¯Ù„ 403 ÙØ§Ø¶ÙŠ. Ø£ÙŠ Ø±ÙØ¶ ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠ Ø¨ÙŠÙ…Ø´ÙŠ Ø¨Ø§Ù„Ø³Ù„ÙˆÙƒ Ø§Ù„Ø¹Ø§Ø¯ÙŠ.
/// </summary>
public sealed class PermissionDeniedResultHandler : IAuthorizationMiddlewareResultHandler
{
    private readonly AuthorizationMiddlewareResultHandler _default = new();

    public async Task HandleAsync(RequestDelegate next, HttpContext context, AuthorizationPolicy policy, PolicyAuthorizationResult authorizeResult)
    {
        var reason = authorizeResult.Forbidden
            ? authorizeResult.AuthorizationFailure?.FailureReasons
                .FirstOrDefault(r => r.Handler is PermissionAuthorizationHandler)?.Message
            : null;

        if (reason is null)
        {
            await _default.HandleAsync(next, context, policy, authorizeResult);
            return;
        }

        context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden;
        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(ApiResponse<object>.Fail(reason, null, StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden));
    }
}

namespace Bank.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/admin")]
[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
public class AdminController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IAdminService _adminService;
    private readonly ILogger<AdminController> _logger;

    public AdminController(IAdminService adminService, ILogger<AdminController> logger)
    {
        _adminService = adminService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    private Guid CurrentUserId => Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);
    /// <summary>
    /// Get all group members of the current admin's group with pagination support.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="pagination">Pagination parameters</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token</param>
    /// <returns>Paginated list of group members</returns>

    [HttpGet("users")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyGroupMembers(
        [FromQuery] PaginationParams pagination, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _adminService.GetMyGroupMembersAsync(CurrentUserId, pagination, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Get a specific group member by their ID within the current admin's group.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The ID of the group member to retrieve</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token</param>
    /// <returns>The requested group member or not found</returns>

    [HttpGet("users/{id:guid}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyGroupMemberById(
        Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _adminService.GetMyGroupMemberByIdAsync(CurrentUserId, id, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Update a specific group member's information within the current admin's group.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The ID of the group member to update</param>
    /// <param name="dto">The DTO containing the updated information</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token</param>
    /// <returns>The updated group member or not found</returns>
    [HttpPut("users/{id:guid}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateMyGroupMember(
        Guid id, [FromBody] UpdateGroupMemberDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)

        var result = await _adminService.UpdateMyGroupMemberAsync(CurrentUserId, id, dto, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Remove a specific group member from the current admin's group.
    /// </summary>

using System.Security.Claims;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.AdminDTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.AuthDTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Bank.API.Controllers
{
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    [ApiController]
    public class AuthController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly IAuthService _service;
        private readonly IPermissionService _permissions;
        public AuthController(IAuthService service, IPermissionService permissions)
        {
            _service = service;
            _permissions = permissions;
        }
        ///// <summary>
        ///// Registers a new user with the provided registration details.
        ///// </summary>
        ///// <param name="registerDTO"></param>
        ///// <returns></returns>
        //[HttpPost("register")]
        //public async Task<IActionResult> Register([FromBody] RegisterDTO registerDTO)
        //{
        //    var result = await _service.RegisterAsync(registerDTO);
        //    return Created("", result);
        //}
       // ==========================
        /// <summary>
        /// Authenticates a user with the provided login credentials and returns a JWT token if successful.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="loginDTO"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPost("login")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginDTO loginDTO)
        {
            var result=await _service.LoginAsync(loginDTO);
            return Ok(result);
        }

        // ==========================
        /// <summary>
        /// Returns the current user's permissions, read from the database (they are not in the JWT),
        /// so the frontend can show or hide actions. Call it after login and whenever a 403 comes back.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpGet("me/permissions")]
        [Authorize]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<MyPermissionsDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyPermissions(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var userId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);
            var permissions = await _permissions.GetMyPermissionsAsync(userId, cancellationToken);
            return permissions is null
                ? NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404))
                : Ok(ApiResponse<MyPermissionsDto>.SuccessResponse(permissions));
        }

    }
}

        _logger = logger;
    }

    private Guid CurrentUserId => Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);

    /// </summary>

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

    {
        var result = await _archiveService.UpdateRowAsync(id, CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the current user's recording archive â€” a persistent, ever-growing table of every
    /// plate transcribed from any recording session or manual check. Unaffected by deleting
    /// recording sessions or clearing them.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<RecordingArchiveListResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]

        [FromQuery] int page = 1, [FromQuery] int pageSize = 50, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var result = await _archiveService.GetAsync(CurrentUserId, page, pageSize, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Exports the full recording archive to an Excel file, in the same layout used for
    /// recording session exports.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("export")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(FileResult), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Export([FromQuery] string? fileName = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var (bytes, resultFileName) = await _archiveService.ExportAsync(CurrentUserId, fileName, cancellationToken);
        return File(bytes, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", resultFileName);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Permanently clears the entire recording archive table for the current user.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpDelete]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteAll(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _archiveService.DeleteAllAsync(CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    [HttpPost("from-check-file")]
    [Authorize(Policy = PermissionPolicies.Sort)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status202Accepted)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateFromCheckFile(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.CreateFromActiveCheckFileAsync(CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Exports a single combined Excel file from multiple referral jobs' matched results,
    /// grouped by data file across all of them (so e.g. "مكة 2026" rows from any selected
    /// referral job end up in the same group). Meant to be picked up by the client and shared
    /// via the device's native share sheet (e.g. to WhatsApp).
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("export-combined")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(FileResult), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ExportCombined(
        [FromBody] ExportCombinedReferralResultsRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var (bytes, fileName) = await _referralJobService.ExportCombinedResultsAsync(
                request.ReferralJobIds, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return File(bytes, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", fileName);
        }
        catch (ArgumentException ex)
        {
            var response = ApiResponse<object>.Fail(ex.Message, null, StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest);
            return StatusCode(response.StatusCode, response);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            var response = ApiResponse<object>.Fail(ex.Message, null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
            return StatusCode(response.StatusCode, response);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Inspects a referral job file upload: returns each sheet's headers, row count,
    /// and suggested plate/color/vehicle-type/model columns (suggestions only — not final).
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("upload/inspect")]
    [Authorize(Policy = PermissionPolicies.Sort)]
    [RequestSizeLimit(50_000_000)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> InspectUpload(IFormFile file, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.InspectUploadAsync(file, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Uploads a referral job file and creates a new referral job. The client must send,
    /// per selected sheet, the confirmed plate column index, plus the referral/historical
    /// columns chosen for display (defaults to inspect's suggestions if unchanged).
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("upload")]
    [Authorize(Policy = PermissionPolicies.Sort)]
    [RequestSizeLimit(50_000_000)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status202Accepted)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Upload([FromForm] CreateReferralJobUploadRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.CreateFromUploadAsync(CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Uploads a referral job from pasted text and creates a new referral job.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("paste")]
    [Authorize(Policy = PermissionPolicies.Sort)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status202Accepted)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Paste([FromBody] CreateReferralJobPasteRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.CreateFromPasteAsync(CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the status of a referral job by its ID.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{referralJobId:guid}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<ReferralJobStatusDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetStatus(Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.GetStatusAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the matched results of a referral job, grouped by data file and colored by
    /// duplicate plate, using the historical/referral columns selected on the job.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{referralJobId:guid}/results")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<ReferralResultsResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetResults(Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.GetResultsAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the unmatched results of a referral job by its ID, with pagination support.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{referralJobId:guid}/unmatched")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<UnmatchedPlateRowDto>>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetUnmatched(
        Guid referralJobId, [FromQuery] int page = 1, [FromQuery] int pageSize = 50, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.GetUnmatchedResultsAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, page, pageSize, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes a matched plate — either from this referral job's results only
    /// (deleteFromDataFile=false, default), or permanently from the historical data
    /// (deleteFromDataFile=true), which also removes it from every other referral
    /// job's results and decrements the data file's row count.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpDelete("{referralJobId:guid}/results/{matchResultId:long}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<DeleteMatchedPlateResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteMatchedPlate(
        Guid referralJobId, long matchResultId, [FromQuery] bool deleteFromDataFile = false, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.DeleteMatchedPlateAsync(
            referralJobId, matchResultId, CurrentUserId, deleteFromDataFile, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Appends All results of a referral job to a check file.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("{referralJobId:guid}/append-All-to-check-file")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<AppendUnmatchedResultDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AppendAllToCheckFile(
        Guid referralJobId, [FromBody] AppendUnmatchedToCheckFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.AppendAllToCheckFileAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>

    [HttpGet("{referralJobId:guid}/share/whatsapp")]

    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]

        var result = await _referralJobService.GetWhatsAppShareLinkAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all referral jobs for the current user, with pagination support.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<ReferralJobSummaryDto>>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(
        [FromQuery] int page = 1, [FromQuery] int pageSize = 20, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.GetReferralJobsAsync(CurrentUserId, page, pageSize, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes a referral job by its ID.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpDelete("{referralJobId:guid}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _referralJobService.DeleteAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Exports the matched results of a referral job to an Excel file.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{referralJobId:guid}/matched/export")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(FileContentResult), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ExportMatched(Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var (bytes, fileName) = await _referralJobService.ExportMatchedAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return File(bytes, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", fileName);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            var response = ApiResponse<object>.Fail(ex.Message, null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
            return StatusCode(response.StatusCode, response);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     Exports the unmatched results of a referral job to an Excel file.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{referralJobId:guid}/unmatched/export")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(FileContentResult), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ExportUnmatched(Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var (bytes, fileName) = await _referralJobService.ExportUnmatchedAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return File(bytes, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", fileName);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            var response = ApiResponse<object>.Fail(ex.Message, null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
            return StatusCode(response.StatusCode, response);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///   Exports the full results (matched + unmatched) of a referral job to an Excel file.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{referralJobId:guid}/export")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(FileResult), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Export(Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _referralJobService.ExportResultsAsync(referralJobId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return File(
                result.FileBytes,
                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
                result.FileName);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            var response = ApiResponse<object>.Fail(ex.Message, null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
            return StatusCode(response.StatusCode, response);
        }
    }
}

using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.SuperAdminDTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Bank.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/super-admin/admins")]
[Authorize(Roles = "SuperAdmin")]
public class SuperAdminAdminsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ISuperAdminService _superAdminService;
    private readonly ILogger<SuperAdminAdminsController> _logger;

    public SuperAdminAdminsController(ISuperAdminService superAdminService, ILogger<SuperAdminAdminsController> logger)
    {
        _superAdminService = superAdminService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new admin.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateAdmin(
        [FromBody] CreateAdminDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _superAdminService.CreateAdminAsync(dto, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves a paginated list of admins.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<PagedResult<AdminResponseDto>>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAdmins(
        [FromQuery] PaginationParams pagination, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _superAdminService.GetAdminsAsync(pagination, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Retrieves an admin by their unique identifier.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAdminById(
        Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _superAdminService.GetAdminByIdAsync(id, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);

using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;

namespace Bank.API.Filters;

public class ErrorFilter : IAsyncActionFilter
{
    public async Task OnActionExecutionAsync(ActionExecutingContext context, ActionExecutionDelegate next)
    {
        var executedContext = await next();

        if (executedContext.Result is ObjectResult objectResult && objectResult.Value is IApiResponse apiResponse)
        {
            apiResponse.TraceId = context.HttpContext.TraceIdentifier;

            if (!apiResponse.Success)
            {
                objectResult.StatusCode = apiResponse.StatusCode != 200 ? apiResponse.StatusCode : 400;
            }
        }
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.API\Filters\ResponseWrapperFilter.cs =====
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;

namespace Bank.API.Filters;

public class ResponseWrapperFilter : IAsyncResultFilter
{
    public async Task OnResultExecutionAsync(ResultExecutingContext context, ResultExecutionDelegate next)
    {
        if (context.Result is ObjectResult objectResult)
        {
            if (objectResult.Value is IApiResponse apiResponse)
            {
                apiResponse.TraceId ??= context.HttpContext.TraceIdentifier;
                if (objectResult.StatusCode.HasValue)
                    apiResponse.StatusCode = objectResult.StatusCode.Value;
            }
            else
            {
                var statusCode = objectResult.StatusCode ?? context.HttpContext.Response.StatusCode;
                var response = new ApiResponse<object>
                {
                    Success = statusCode is >= 200 and < 300,
                    Data = objectResult.Value,
                    Message = statusCode is >= 200 and < 300 ? "Success" : "Failed",
                    TraceId = context.HttpContext.TraceIdentifier,
                    StatusCode = statusCode
                };

                context.Result = new ObjectResult(response)
                {
                    StatusCode = statusCode
                };
            }
        }
        else if (context.Result is StatusCodeResult statusCodeResult)
        {
            var isSuccess = statusCodeResult.StatusCode is >= 200 and < 300;
            var response = new ApiResponse<object>
            {
                Success = isSuccess,
                Data = null,
                Message = isSuccess ? "Success" : "Failed",
                TraceId = context.HttpContext.TraceIdentifier,
                StatusCode = statusCodeResult.StatusCode
            };

            context.Result = new ObjectResult(response)
            {
                StatusCode = statusCodeResult.StatusCode
            };
        }

        await next();
    }
}

        catch (Exception ex) when (state.ListenCts.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            // Ø§Ù„Ø¥Ù„ØºØ§Ø¡ Ù…Ù…ÙƒÙ† ÙŠÙˆØµÙ„ Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ù€ DB driver ÙƒÙ€ exception ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠ ØºÙŠØ± OperationCanceledException
            _logger.LogWarning(ex, "AI listen loop interrupted by stop for connection {ConnectionId}", connectionId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "AI listen loop failed for connection {ConnectionId}", connectionId);
            state.Failed = true;
            await _hubContext.Clients.Client(connectionId).SendAsync("AiDisconnected", new { message = ex.Message });
            using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
            await scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILiveCheckSessionService>()
                .MarkSessionFailedAsync(state.SessionId, ex.Message, CancellationToken.None);
            _connections.Remove(connectionId);
        }
    }

    private async Task FinalizeSessionAsync(string connectionId, LiveCheckConnectionState state)
    {
        // Ø§Ù„Ù€ AI Ø¨ÙŠÙ…Ø³Ùƒ Ø¢Ø®Ø± ÙƒÙ„Ø§Ù… Ù„Ø­Ø¯ Ù…Ø§ ÙŠØªØ£ÙƒØ¯ Ø¥Ù†Ù‡ Ø®Ù„ØµØŒ ÙÙ„Ùˆ Ù‚ÙÙ„Ù†Ø§ Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø·ÙˆÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ø§ØªÙ‚Ø§Ù„Øª
        // Ù‚Ø¨Ù„ Ø§Ù„Ø¥ÙŠÙ‚Ø§Ù Ù…Ø¨Ø§Ø´Ø±Ø© Ø¨ØªØ¶ÙŠØ¹. Ø¨Ù†Ø¨Ø¹Øª stop ÙˆÙ†Ø³ØªÙ†Ù‰ Ø§Ù„Ø³ÙŠØ±ÙØ± ÙŠØ¨Ø¹Øª Ø§Ù„Ø¨Ø§Ù‚ÙŠ ÙˆÙŠÙ‚ÙÙ„ (Ø¨Ø­Ø¯ Ø£Ù‚ØµÙ‰).
        try
        {
            using var stopCts = new CancellationTokenSource(AiStopTimeout);
            await state.AiSession.SendStopAsync(stopCts.Token);
            await Task.WhenAny(state.ListenTask, Task.Delay(AiStopTimeout));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error sending stop to AI for connection {ConnectionId}", connectionId);
        }

        state.ListenCts.Cancel();

        // WhenAny Ù…Ø´ Ø¨ÙŠÙˆÙ‚Ù Ø§Ù„Ù€ listener â€” Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… Ù†Ø³ØªÙ†Ø§Ù‡ ÙŠØ®Ù„Øµ ÙØ¹Ù„Ù‹Ø§ Ø¹Ø´Ø§Ù† Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ PlateChecked
        // Ø£Ùˆ ÙƒØªØ§Ø¨Ø© ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ù„Ø³Ø© ØªÙˆØµÙ„ Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ Ù…Ø§ Ù†Ù‚ÙÙ„Ù‡Ø§.
        try
        {
            await state.ListenTask;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(ex, "AI listen loop ended with error for connection {ConnectionId}", connectionId);
        }

        try
        {
            await state.AiSession.CloseAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error closing AI session for connection {ConnectionId}", connectionId);
        }

        // Ù„Ùˆ Ø§Ù„Ù€ listener ÙØ´Ù„ (Ø­ØªÙ‰ Ø£Ø«Ù†Ø§Ø¡ Ø§Ù„Ù€ stop flush) Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ù„Ø³Ø© Ø§ØªØ¹Ù„Ù‘Ù…Øª Failed â€” Ù…Ù†ÙƒØªØ¨Ø´ Ø¹Ù„ÙŠÙ‡Ø§ Completed.
        if (!state.Failed)
            await _sessionService.CompleteSessionAsync(state.SessionId, CancellationToken.None);
        _connections.Remove(connectionId);
    }

    private Guid GetUserId() => Guid.Parse(Context.User!.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.API\MiddleWare\ErrorHandlingMiddleWare.cs =====
using System.Net;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using SendGrid.Helpers.Errors.Model;

namespace Bank.API.MiddleWare;

public class ErrorHandlingMiddleWare
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<ErrorHandlingMiddleWare> _logger;
    private readonly IHostEnvironment _env;

    public ErrorHandlingMiddleWare(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<ErrorHandlingMiddleWare> logger, IHostEnvironment env)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
        _env = env;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Request was canceled by the client. Method: {Method} Path: {Path} TraceId: {TraceId}",
                context.Request.Method, context.Request.Path, context.TraceIdentifier);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled Exception while processing. Method: {Method} Path: {Path} TraceId: {TraceId}",
                context.Request.Method, context.Request.Path, context.TraceIdentifier);

            await HandleExceptionAsync(context, ex);
        }
    }

    private async Task HandleExceptionAsync(HttpContext context, Exception ex)
    {
        if (context.Response.HasStarted)
            return;

        var statusCode = ExceptionStatusCodeMapper.GetStatusCode(ex);
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        context.Response.StatusCode = statusCode;

        var errors = new List<string> { ex.Message };

        if (_env.IsDevelopment() && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ex.StackTrace))
        {
            errors.Add($"[{ex.GetType().Name}] {ex.StackTrace}");
        }

        var response = new ApiResponse<object>
        {
            Success = false,
            Message = GetTitleForStatusCode(statusCode),
            Data = null,
            Errors = errors,
            TraceId = context.TraceIdentifier,
            StatusCode = statusCode
        };

        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(response);
    }

    private static string GetTitleForStatusCode(int statusCode) => statusCode switch
    {
        400 => "Bad Request",
        401 => "Unauthorized",
        403 => "Forbidden",
        404 => "Resource Not Found",
        409 => "Conflict",
        _ => "An error occurred while processing your request."
    };

    public static class ExceptionStatusCodeMapper
    {
        public static int GetStatusCode(Exception ex) => ex switch
        {
            NotFoundException => (int)HttpStatusCode.NotFound,
            BadRequestException => (int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest,
            UnauthorizedException => (int)HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized,
            ForbiddenException => (int)HttpStatusCode.Forbidden,
            _ => (int)HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError
        };
    }
}

        public static IServiceCollection AddAPIBehavior(this IServiceCollection services,IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            services.AddControllers(x =>
            {
                x.Filters.Add<ErrorFilter>();
                x.Filters.Add<ResponseWrapperFilter>();
            }).AddJsonOptions(op =>
            {
                op.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
            });
            services.AddOpenApi();
            services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
            return services;
        }
        public static IServiceCollection AddSwaggerWithJWT(this IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
            {
                c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo
                {
                    Title = "Bank API",
                    Version = "v1",
                    Description = "Bank API with JWT Authentication"
                });

                // Include XML Comments
                var xmlFile = $"{Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetName().Name}.xml";
                var xmlPath = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, xmlFile);
                if (File.Exists(xmlPath))
                {
                    c.IncludeXmlComments(xmlPath);
                }

                // JWT Authentication Scheme
                c.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
                {
                    Name = "Authorization",
                    Type = SecuritySchemeType.Http,
                    Scheme = "Bearer",
                    BearerFormat = "JWT",
                    In = ParameterLocation.Header,
                    Description = "Enter your JWT token"
                });

                // Security Requirement (OpenAPI v2 style)
                c.AddSecurityRequirement(document =>
                {
                    return new OpenApiSecurityRequirement
                    {
                        [new OpenApiSecuritySchemeReference("Bearer", document)] = new List<string>()
                    };
                });
            });

            return services;
        }

        public static IServiceCollection AddAuthenticationWithJWT(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(
                Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(configuration["Auth:JWT:Key"]
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT Key is missing")));
            services.AddAuthentication(options =>
            {
                options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme =
                    JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;

                options.DefaultChallengeScheme =
                    JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            })
            .AddJwtBearer(options =>
            {
                options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
                {
                    ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                    IssuerSigningKey = key,

                    ValidateIssuer = false,
                   // ValidIssuer = configuration["Auth:JWT:Issuer"],

                    ValidateAudience = false,
                   // ValidAudience = configuration["Auth:JWT:Audience"],

                    ValidateLifetime = false,
                   // ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero
                };
                options.Events = new Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer.JwtBearerEvents
                {
                    OnMessageReceived = context =>
                    {
                        var accessToken = context.Request.Query["access_token"];
                        var path = context.HttpContext.Request.Path;

                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(accessToken) && path.StartsWithSegments("/hubs"))
                        {
                            context.Token = accessToken;
                        }

                        return Task.CompletedTask;
                    }
                };
            });


            return services;
        }

    }

using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;

namespace Bank.DAL.Configration.BaseConfigrations;

public class ApplicationUserConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<ApplicationUser>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<ApplicationUser> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("users");

        builder.Property(x => x.Id)
            .HasColumnName("id")
            .HasDefaultValueSql("gen_random_uuid()")
            .ValueGeneratedOnAdd();

        builder.Property(x => x.FullName)
            .HasColumnName("full_name")
            .HasMaxLength(150)
            .IsRequired();

        builder.Property(x => x.Role)
            .HasColumnName("role")
            .HasConversion<string>()
            .HasMaxLength(50)
            .IsRequired();

        builder.Property(x => x.IsActive)
            .HasColumnName("is_active")
            .HasDefaultValue(true)
            .IsRequired();

        builder.Property(x => x.CreatedAt)
            .HasColumnName("created_at")
            .HasDefaultValueSql("now()")
            .IsRequired();

        builder.Property(x => x.UserName)
            .HasColumnName("username")
            .HasMaxLength(100);

        builder.Property(x => x.PasswordHash)
            .HasColumnName("password_hash");

        builder.Property(x => x.GroupId)
            .HasColumnName("group_id")
            .IsRequired(false);

        builder.HasIndex(x => x.GroupId);
        builder.HasOne(x => x.Group)
            .WithMany(g => g.Members)
            .HasForeignKey(x => x.GroupId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);

        builder.HasOne(x => x.UserPermission)
            .WithOne(p => p.User)
            .HasForeignKey<UserPermission>(p => p.UserId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        builder.HasMany(x => x.RefreshTokens)

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;

namespace Bank.DAL.Configration.BaseConfigrations;

public abstract class BaseEntityConfiguration<TEntity> : IEntityTypeConfiguration<TEntity>
    where TEntity : BaseEntity
{
    public virtual void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<TEntity> builder)
    {
        builder.HasKey(x => x.Id);

        builder.Property(x => x.Id)
            .HasColumnName("id")
            .HasDefaultValueSql("gen_random_uuid()")
            .ValueGeneratedOnAdd();
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.DAL\Context\AppDbContextFactory.cs =====
using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design;

namespace Bank.DAL.Context;

/// <summary>
/// Design-time factory used by the EF Core tooling (add-migration / update-database)
/// to create <see cref="AppDbContext"/> without booting the API host. The host requires
/// runtime configuration (JWT key, user secrets, database, Hangfire, ...), so relying on
/// its service provider makes migrations fail at design time.
/// </summary>
public class AppDbContextFactory : IDesignTimeDbContextFactory<AppDbContext>
{
    private const string DefaultConnection =
        "Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=bank_system;Username=postgres;Password=0000";

    public AppDbContext CreateDbContext(string[] args)
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<AppDbContext>()
            .UseNpgsql(ResolveConnectionString(), npgsql => npgsql.UseNetTopologySuite())
            .Options;

        return new AppDbContext(options);
    }

    private static string ResolveConnectionString()
    {
        // Allows overriding the connection string when running the tooling (e.g. in CI).
        var fromEnvironment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection");
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fromEnvironment))
            return fromEnvironment;

        var appSettingsPath = FindStartupAppSettings();
        if (appSettingsPath is not null)
        {
            try
            {
                using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(appSettingsPath));
                if (document.RootElement.TryGetProperty("ConnectionStrings", out var connections) &&
                    connections.TryGetProperty("DefaultConnection", out var value) &&
                    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.GetString()))
                {
                    return value.GetString()!;
                }
            }
            catch (JsonException)
            {
                // Fall back to the default connection string below.
            }
        }

        return DefaultConnection;
    }

    private static string? FindStartupAppSettings()
    {
        foreach (var origin in new[] { Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), AppContext.BaseDirectory })
        {
            var directory = new DirectoryInfo(origin);
            while (directory is not null)
            {
                var candidate = Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "Bank.API", "appsettings.json");
                if (File.Exists(candidate))
                    return candidate;

                if (directory.Name.Equals("Bank.API", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    candidate = Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "appsettings.json");
                    if (File.Exists(candidate))
                        return candidate;
                }

                directory = directory.Parent;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}

using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Storage.ValueConversion;

namespace Bank.DAL.Context;

public class AppDbContext : IdentityDbContext<ApplicationUser, IdentityRole<Guid>, Guid>
{
    public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<RefreshToken> RefreshTokens => Set<RefreshToken>();
    public DbSet<AuditLog> AuditLogs => Set<AuditLog>();
    public DbSet<Group> Groups => Set<Group>();
    public DbSet<UserPermission> UserPermissions => Set<UserPermission>();
    public DbSet<UserDataFilePermission> UserDataFilePermissions => Set<UserDataFilePermission>();
    public DbSet<CheckFile> CheckFiles => Set<CheckFile>();
    public DbSet<CheckPlate> CheckPlates => Set<CheckPlate>();
    public DbSet<RecordingSession> RecordingSessions => Set<RecordingSession>();
    public DbSet<RecordedPlate> RecordedPlates => Set<RecordedPlate>();
    public DbSet<LiveCheckLog> LiveCheckLogs => Set<LiveCheckLog>();
    public DbSet<DataFile> DataFiles => Set<DataFile>();
    public DbSet<HistoricalPlate> HistoricalPlates => Set<HistoricalPlate>();
    public DbSet<ReferralJob> ReferralJobs => Set<ReferralJob>();
    public DbSet<MatchResult> MatchResults => Set<MatchResult>();
    public DbSet<ReferralPlate> ReferralPlates => Set<ReferralPlate>();
    public DbSet<RecordingGpsPoint> RecordingGpsPoints => Set<RecordingGpsPoint>(); 
    public DbSet<CheckSession> CheckSessions => Set<CheckSession>();
    public DbSet<RecordingArchivePlate> RecordingArchivePlates
    => Set<RecordingArchivePlate>();
 
    public DbSet<Certificate> Certificates => Set<Certificate>();
    public DbSet<MapResult> MapResults => Set<MapResult>();
    public DbSet<MapUploadedFile> MapUploadedFiles => Set<MapUploadedFile>();
    public DbSet<MapUploadedPlateRow> MapUploadedPlateRows => Set<MapUploadedPlateRow>();
    protected override void ConfigureConventions(ModelConfigurationBuilder configurationBuilder)
    {
        // Npgsql Ø¨ÙŠØ±ÙØ¶ Ø£ÙŠ DateTime Ù…Ø´ UTC ÙÙŠ Ø£Ø¹Ù…Ø¯Ø© timestamptzØŒ ÙØ¨Ù†Ø«Ø¨Ù‘Øª Ø§Ù„Ù€ Kind
        // Ù„Ù„ØªÙˆØ§Ø±ÙŠØ® Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ø¬Ø§ÙŠØ© Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ù€ client Ù…Ù† ØºÙŠØ± Z (Unspecified) Ø£Ùˆ Ø¨Ù€ offset (Local).
        configurationBuilder.Properties<DateTime>().HaveConversion<UtcDateTimeConverter>();
        configurationBuilder.Properties<DateTime?>().HaveConversion<UtcDateTimeConverter>();
    }

    private sealed class UtcDateTimeConverter : ValueConverter<DateTime, DateTime>
    {
        public UtcDateTimeConverter()
            : base(
                v => v.Kind == DateTimeKind.Utc ? v
                    : v.Kind == DateTimeKind.Local ? v.ToUniversalTime()
                    : DateTime.SpecifyKind(v, DateTimeKind.Utc),
                v => DateTime.SpecifyKind(v, DateTimeKind.Utc))
        {
        }
    }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // Ø£Ø¹Ù…Ø¯Ø© Ø§Ù„Ù€ geography (Location) Ù…Ø­ØªØ§Ø¬Ø© PostGIS
        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(AppDbContext).Assembly);

        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityRole<Guid>>().ToTable("roles");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityUserRole<Guid>>().ToTable("user_roles");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityUserClaim<Guid>>().ToTable("user_claims");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityUserLogin<Guid>>().ToTable("user_logins");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityRoleClaim<Guid>>().ToTable("role_claims");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityUserToken<Guid>>().ToTable("user_tokens");
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.DAL\Data\IdentitySeeder.cs =====
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.DAL.Data
{
    public static class IdentitySeeder
    {
        public static async Task SeedRolesAsync(IServiceProvider service)
        {
         using   var scope = service.CreateScope();
            var roleManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>>>();
         //   bool Studentexist = await roleManager.RoleExistsAsync(UserTypes.Student.ToString());

            foreach(var role in Enum.GetNames<UserRole>())
            {
                if (!await roleManager.RoleExistsAsync(role))
                    await roleManager.CreateAsync(new IdentityRole<Guid>(role));
            }
        }
        public static async Task AddAdminAsync(IServiceProvider service)
        {
            using var scope = service.CreateScope();
            var roleManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>>>();
            var userManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
            var user = new ApplicationUser
            {
                FullName="Super Admin",
                Email = "admin@gmail.com",
                EmailConfirmed = true,
                UserName = "admin@gmail.com",
                Role = UserRole.SuperAdmin,

                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            var Exist =await userManager.FindByEmailAsync(user.Email);
            if (Exist != null)
                return;
            var result = await userManager.CreateAsync(user, "**AAaa010");
            if (!result.Succeeded)
            {
                var errors = string.Join(",", result.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
                throw new Exception($"failed to seed admin errors: {errors} ");
            }
            await userManager.AddToRoleAsync(user, UserTypes.SuperAdmin.ToString());

        }
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.DAL\Models\BaseModels\BaseEntity.cs =====
namespace Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;

/// <summary>
/// Base class for every aggregate whose SQL Server primary key is a
/// uuid column, generated as gen_random_uuid() in the DB.
/// The Id is exposed as a string in the domain layer so that services,
/// DTOs and API contracts never need to know it is really a GUID.
/// </summary>
public abstract class BaseEntity
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.DAL\Models\BaseModels\BaseEntityLong.cs =====
namespace Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;

/// <summary>
/// Base class for the high-volume "leaf" tables whose SQL Server primary key
/// is a bigint IDENTITY column (check_plates, recorded_plates, live_check_logs,
/// historical_plates, match_results, refresh_tokens, audit_logs).
/// These are kept as bigint (not string/GUID) on purpose: they are inserted
/// in bulk (2.7M+ rows for historical_plates) and a bigint identity is far
/// cheaper to index/cluster on than a GUID or string surrogate key.
/// </summary>
public abstract class BaseEntityLong
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Repo.Interfaces;
using Bank.Repo.Specifications;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Repo.Implementations
{
    public class GenericRepo<TEntity> : IGenericRepo<TEntity> where TEntity : BaseEntity
    {
       readonly AppDbContext _context;
       readonly DbSet<TEntity> dbset;
        public GenericRepo(AppDbContext context)
        {
            _context=context;
            dbset= context.Set<TEntity>();
        }
        public async Task<TEntity> AddAsync(TEntity entity)
        {
            await dbset.AddAsync(entity);
            return entity;
        }

        public async Task<IEnumerable<TEntity>> AddRangeAsync(IEnumerable<TEntity> entities)
        {
            await dbset.AddRangeAsync(entities);
            return entities;
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<TEntity>> GetAllAsync(bool asNoTracking=false)
        {
          IQueryable<TEntity> query = dbset;
            if(asNoTracking)
                query=query.AsNoTracking();
            return await query.ToListAsync();
            
        }

        public async Task<TEntity> GetByIdAsync(Guid Id, bool asNoTracking=false)
        {
            IQueryable<TEntity>  query = dbset;
            if(asNoTracking)
                query = query.AsNoTracking();
            
           return await query.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x=>x.Id==Id);

        }
    

        public  Task RemoveAsync(TEntity item)
        {
            dbset.Remove(item);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        public Task RemoveRangeAsync(IEnumerable<TEntity> entities)
        {
            dbset.RemoveRange(entities);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        public  Task UpdateAsync(TEntity entity)
        {
            dbset.Update(entity);
           
            return Task.CompletedTask;

        }
        public  Task UpdateRangeAsync(List<TEntity>entities)
        {
            dbset.UpdateRange(entities);
           
            return Task.CompletedTask;

        }
        
        //Specifications
        private IQueryable<TEntity> ApplySpecification(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
          
            return SpecificationEvaluator<TEntity>.GetQuery(dbset.AsQueryable(), spec);
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<TEntity>> SelectAsync(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).ToListAsync();
          
        }
        public async Task<bool> AnyAsync(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).AnyAsync();
          
        }
   

       public async Task<TEntity?> GetEntityWithSpecificationAsync(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        }

       public async Task<int> CountAsync(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).CountAsync();
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<TResult>> SelectAsync<TResult>(ISpecification<TEntity> spec
            ,Expression<Func<TEntity,TResult>> selector)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).Select(selector).ToListAsync();

        }

       public async Task<TResult?> GetEntityWithSpecificationAsync<TResult>(ISpecification<TEntity> spec,
           Expression<Func<TEntity,TResult>> selector) 
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).Select(selector).FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        }

        public async Task<TResult?> MaxAsync<TResult>(ISpecification<TEntity> spec, Expression<Func<TEntity, TResult>> selector)

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Repo\Implementations\SpecificationEvaluator.cs =====
using Bank.Repo.Specifications;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
namespace Bank.Repo.Implementations
{
    public class SpecificationEvaluator<TEntity> where TEntity : BaseEntity
    {
        public static IQueryable<TEntity> GetQuery(
            IQueryable<TEntity> QueryInput,
            ISpecification<TEntity> spec
            )
        {
            var query = QueryInput.AsQueryable();
            if (spec.Criteria != null)
                query = query.Where(spec.Criteria);
            if (spec.AsNoTracking)
                query = query.AsNoTracking();

            if (spec.IsSplitQuery)
                query = query.AsSplitQuery();

            if (spec.Includes.Any())
                foreach ( var include in spec.Includes)
                query = query.Include(include);

            if (spec.AllIncludes.Any())
                foreach (var include in spec.AllIncludes)
                    query = include(query);

            if (spec.OrderBy != null)
                query= query.OrderBy(spec.OrderBy);
            else if(spec.OrderByDescending != null)
            {
                query= query.OrderByDescending(spec.OrderByDescending);
            }

            if (spec.IsPaginable)
            {
               query=query.Skip(spec.Skip).Take(spec.Take);
            }
           
            return query;
        }
    }
}


===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Repo\Implementations\UnitOfWork.cs =====
using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Repo.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Repo.Implementations
{
    public  class UnitOfWork : IUnitOfWork
    {
        AppDbContext _context;
        Dictionary<Type, object> repositories = new Dictionary<Type, object>();
        public UnitOfWork(AppDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;

        }
        public  IGenericRepo<T> Repository<T>() where T : BaseEntity
        {
            var type=typeof(T);
            if (!repositories.ContainsKey(type))
            {
                var repo =new GenericRepo<T>(_context);
                repositories.Add(type, repo);

            }

          return (IGenericRepo<T>) repositories[type];
        }
        public async Task<int> CompleteAsync()
        {
            return await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
    }
}

using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Query;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Repo.Specifications
{
    public class BaseSpecification<T> : ISpecification<T> where T : BaseEntity
    {
        private readonly List<Expression<Func<T, object>>> _include = new();
        private readonly List<Func<IQueryable<T>,IIncludableQueryable<T,object>>> _allIncude= new();
        public Expression<Func<T, bool>>? Criteria { get; private set; }

        public IReadOnlyList<Expression<Func<T, object>>> Includes  => _include;

        public IReadOnlyList<Func<IQueryable<T>, IIncludableQueryable<T, object>>> AllIncludes => _allIncude;

       public Expression<Func<T, object>>? OrderBy { get; private set; }

       public Expression<Func<T, object>>? OrderByDescending { get;private set; }

       public int Skip { get;private set;  }

       public int Take {  get;private set; }

       public bool IsPaginable {  get;private set; }
        public bool AsNoTracking { get;private set; }
        public bool IsSplitQuery { get;private set; }

       

        public BaseSpecification()
        {
            
        }
        public BaseSpecification(Expression<Func<T,bool>> CriteriaExpression)
        {
            Criteria = CriteriaExpression;
        }
        public void AddInclude(Expression<Func<T,object>> IncludeExpression)=>_include.Add(IncludeExpression);
        public void AddInclude(Func<IQueryable<T>,IIncludableQueryable<T,object>>AllIncludeExpression)=>_allIncude.Add(AllIncludeExpression);
        public void AddOrderBy(Expression<Func<T,object>>OrderByExpression)=>OrderBy = OrderByExpression;
        
        public void AddOrderByDesc(Expression<Func<T,object>>OrderByDescExpression)=> OrderByDescending=OrderByDescExpression;
        
        public void ApplyPagination(int skip,int take)
        {
            Skip = skip;
            Take = take;
            IsPaginable = true;
        }
        public void ApplyNoTracking()=> AsNoTracking = true;
        public void ApplySplitQuery()=> IsSplitQuery = true;
    }
}

namespace Bank.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Registers the legacy code-page encoding provider (e.g. code page 1252) required by
/// ExcelDataReader's default configuration. Running it from a module initializer means it
/// executes as soon as the Bank.Services assembly is loaded, so every host/entry point is
/// covered without having to remember to register it in Program.cs.
/// </summary>
internal static class EncodingSetup
{
    // Intentional: registering here guarantees the provider is available no matter which
    // host loads Bank.Services, so we opt out of the "application code only" advisory.
#pragma warning disable CA2255
    [ModuleInitializer]
    internal static void RegisterCodePages()
    {
        Encoding.RegisterProvider(CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance);
    }
#pragma warning restore CA2255
}

                {
                    await using var local = await _storage.OpenReadAsync(cert.StoragePath, ct);
                    using var buffer = new MemoryStream();
                    await local.CopyToAsync(buffer, ct);
                    bytes = buffer.ToArray();
                }
                catch (FileNotFoundException)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Local copy missing for certificate {Id}; re-downloading", certificateId);
                    cert.StoragePath = null;
                }
            }

            if (bytes == null)
            {
                using var ms = new MemoryStream();
                await _drive.DownloadAsync(cert.DriveFileId, ms, ct);
                bytes = ms.ToArray();

                if (!LooksLikePdf(bytes))
                    throw new InvalidDataException("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ù†Ø²Ù„ Ù…Ù† Drive Ù…Ø´ PDF.");

                using var toStore = new MemoryStream(bytes);
                cert.StoragePath = await _storage.SaveAsync(toStore, EnsurePdfName(cert.FileName), "certificates", ct);
            }

            // ---------- 2) Ø§Ù„Ø§Ø³ØªØ®Ø±Ø§Ø¬ ----------
            var r = await _extractor.ExtractAsync(bytes, cert.FileName, ct);

            cert.Provider = r.Provider;
            cert.PlateLetters = TextUtil.Truncate(r.PlateLetters, 10);
            cert.PlateDigits = TextUtil.Truncate(r.PlateDigits, 10);
            cert.NormalizedPlate = TextUtil.Truncate(r.NormalizedPlate, 30);
            cert.Make = TextUtil.Truncate(r.Make, 100);
            cert.Model = TextUtil.Truncate(r.Model, 100);
            cert.Color = TextUtil.Truncate(r.Color, 100);
            cert.Lessor = TextUtil.Truncate(r.Lessor, 200);
            cert.Status = r.NeedsReview ? CertificateStatus.NeedsReview : CertificateStatus.Extracted;
            cert.StatusNote = r.NeedsReview ? TextUtil.Truncate(string.Join(" | ", r.ReviewReasons), 1000) : null;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            // Ø¥ÙŠÙ‚Ø§Ù Ø§Ù„ØªØ·Ø¨ÙŠÙ‚: Ù†Ø±Ø¬Ù‘Ø¹Ù‡Ø§ Pending Ø¹Ø´Ø§Ù† ØªØªØ¹Ø§Ø¯
            cert.Status = CertificateStatus.Pending;
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Extraction failed for certificate {Id} ({File})", certificateId, cert.FileName);
            cert.Status = CertificateStatus.Failed;
            cert.StatusNote = TextUtil.Truncate(ex is DriveAuthException ? "Drive: " + ex.Message : ex.Message, 1000);
        }

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
    }

    private static bool LooksLikePdf(byte[] bytes) =>
        bytes.Length > 5 && bytes[0] == 0x25 && bytes[1] == 0x50 && bytes[2] == 0x44 && bytes[3] == 0x46; // %PDF

    private static string EnsurePdfName(string name) =>
        name.EndsWith(".pdf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? name : name + ".pdf";
}

using System.Globalization;
using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Bank.Services.Helpers;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces.ICertificate;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Hangfire;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;

/// <summary>
/// Ø§ÙƒØªØ´Ø§Ù Ø§Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª: Ø¨ÙŠØ²Ø­Ù Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ ÙƒÙ„ "Shared with me" ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Drive Ø§Ù„Ù€ globalØŒ ÙˆÙŠÙ‚Ø§Ø±Ù† Ø¨Ø§Ù„Ù€ DB Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø£Ø³Ø§Ø³ DriveFileIdØŒ
/// ÙˆØ£ÙŠ Ù…Ù„Ù Ø¬Ø¯ÙŠØ¯ Ø¨ÙŠØªØ³Ø¬Ù‘Ù„ ÙÙŠ Ø¯ÙØ¹Ø© Ø¬Ø¯ÙŠØ¯Ø© (BatchNo) + Job Ø§Ø³ØªØ®Ø±Ø§Ø¬ Ù„ÙƒÙ„ Ù…Ù„Ù.
/// DisableConcurrentExecution: Ù…Ø²Ø§Ù…Ù†Ø© ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© Ø¨Ø³ ÙÙŠ Ù†ÙØ³ Ø§Ù„ÙˆÙ‚Øª (Ø¬Ø¯ÙˆÙ„Ø© Ø£Ùˆ ÙŠØ¯ÙˆÙŠ).
/// </summary>
[Queue("certificates")]
public class CertificateSyncJob
{
    private const int InsertChunkSize = 500;

    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    private readonly IGoogleDriveClient _drive;
    private readonly IBackgroundJobClient _jobs;
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly ILogger<CertificateSyncJob> _logger;

    public CertificateSyncJob(
        AppDbContext db,
        IGoogleDriveClient drive,
        IBackgroundJobClient jobs,
        IConfiguration configuration,
        ILogger<CertificateSyncJob> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _drive = drive;
        _jobs = jobs;
        _configuration = configuration;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [AutomaticRetry(Attempts = 0)]
    [DisableConcurrentExecution(timeoutInSeconds: 1800)]
    public async Task SyncAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (!_drive.IsConfigured)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Certificate sync skipped: GoogleDrive settings are not configured");
            return;
        }

        List<DriveFileInfo> files;
        try
        {
            files = await _drive.ListAllSharedPdfsAsync(ct);
        }
        catch (DriveAuthException ex)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Certificate sync aborted: Drive auth problem");
            _drive.ReportSync(0, ex.Message);
            return;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Certificate sync failed while listing Drive files");
            _drive.ReportSync(0, ex.Message);
            return;
        }

        // Ø§Ø®ØªÙŠØ§Ø±ÙŠ: ØªØ¬Ø§Ù‡Ù„ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„ÙØ§Øª Ø§Ù„Ø£Ù‚Ø¯Ù… Ù…Ù† ØªØ§Ø±ÙŠØ® Ù…Ø¹ÙŠÙ‘Ù† (Ø¹Ø´Ø§Ù† Ø£ÙˆÙ„ Ù…Ø²Ø§Ù…Ù†Ø© Ù…Ø§ØªØ³ØªÙˆØ±Ù‘Ø¯Ø´ Ø£Ø±Ø´ÙŠÙ Ù‚Ø¯ÙŠÙ… ÙƒÙ„Ù‡)
        if (DateTime.TryParse(_configuration["Certificates:SyncFromDate"], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal, out var from))
        {
            files = files.Where(f => f.CreatedAt == null || f.CreatedAt >= from).ToList();
        }

        var known = (await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking().Select(c => c.DriveFileId).ToListAsync(ct)).ToHashSet();
        var fresh = files.Where(f => known.Add(f.FileId)).ToList();

        if (fresh.Count == 0)
        {
            _drive.ReportSync(0, null);
            _logger.LogInformation("Certificate sync: nothing new ({Listed} files listed)", files.Count);
            return;
        }

        var batchNo = (await _db.Certificates.MaxAsync(c => (int?)c.BatchNo, ct) ?? 0) + 1;
        var ids = new List<Guid>(fresh.Count);

        foreach (var chunk in fresh.Chunk(InsertChunkSize))
        {
            var rows = chunk.Select(f => new Certificate
            {
                DriveFileId = f.FileId,
                FileName = TextUtil.Truncate(f.Name, 500)!,
                BatchNo = batchNo,
                Status = CertificateStatus.Pending
            }).ToList();

            _db.Certificates.AddRange(rows);
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
            ids.AddRange(rows.Select(r => r.Id));
            _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
        }

        foreach (var id in ids)
        {
            var certId = id;
            _jobs.Enqueue<CertificateExtractionJob>(j => j.ExtractAsync(certId, CancellationToken.None));
        }

        _drive.ReportSync(fresh.Count, null);
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Certificate sync: batch #{Batch} created with {Count} new file(s) ({Listed} listed in Drive)",
            batchNo, fresh.Count, files.Count);
    }
}
