using System.Data;
using System.Data.Common;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using CsvHelper;
using CsvHelper.Configuration;
using ExcelDataReader;
using Hangfire;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Npgsql;
using NpgsqlTypes;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;

[Queue("bulk-import")]
public class DataFileImportJob
{
    private const int BatchSize = 25_000;
    private const int BulkCopyTimeoutSeconds = 600;
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IFileStorageService _fileStorage;
    private readonly ILogger<DataFileImportJob> _logger;

    static DataFileImportJob()
    {
        Encoding.RegisterProvider(CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance);
    }

    public DataFileImportJob(AppDbContext dbContext, IFileStorageService fileStorage, ILogger<DataFileImportJob> logger, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _fileStorage = fileStorage;
        _logger = logger;
        _configuration = configuration;
    }

    [AutomaticRetry(Attempts = 0, OnAttemptsExceeded = AttemptsExceededAction.Fail)]
    public async Task ImportAsync(Guid dataFileId, Guid userId, string storagePath, bool isAppend, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var totalStopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        _logger.LogInformation("Import job started for DataFile {DataFileId} (append={IsAppend})", dataFileId, isAppend);
        var connectionString = _configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")
    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        await using var connection = new NpgsqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);
        //var connectionString = _dbContext.Database.GetConnectionString()
        //    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        //await using var connection = new NpgsqlConnection(connectionString);
        //await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        await using var transaction = await connection.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);

        try
        {
            // الحذف جوه نفس الـ transaction بتاعة الـ import: لو الاستيراد فشل، الـ rollback
            // بيرجّع الصفوف القديمة بدل ما الملف يفضل فاضي.
            if (!isAppend)
            {
                var deleteStopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                var replaced = await DeleteHistoricalPlatesAsync(connection, dataFileId, cancellationToken);
                deleteStopwatch.Stop();
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "PHASE delete: cleared {Count} existing rows for DataFile {DataFileId} in {ElapsedMs}ms",
                    replaced, dataFileId, deleteStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
            }

            var parseAndInsertStopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            await using var stream = await _fileStorage.OpenReadAsync(storagePath, cancellationToken);
            var extension = Path.GetExtension(storagePath).ToLowerInvariant();

            int totalInserted;
            if (extension == ".csv")
            {
                using var textReader = new StreamReader(stream);
                var config = new CsvConfiguration(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                {
                    HasHeaderRecord = true,
                    MissingFieldFound = null,
                    BadDataFound = null
                };
                using var csv = new CsvReader(textReader, config);
                await csv.ReadAsync();
                csv.ReadHeader();
                var map = DetectColumnsFromHeaders(csv.HeaderRecord ?? Array.Empty<string>());

                using var readerWrapper = new CsvDataReaderWrapper(csv, map, dataFileId, userId);
                totalInserted = await ExecuteBulkCopyAsync(connection, readerWrapper, cancellationToken);
            }
            else
            {
                using var excelReader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
                var map = DetectColumnsFromExcel(excelReader);
                using var readerWrapper = new ExcelDataReaderWrapper(excelReader, map, dataFileId, userId);
                totalInserted = await ExecuteBulkCopyAsync(connection, readerWrapper, cancellationToken);
            }

            parseAndInsertStopwatch.Stop();
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PHASE parse+insert: {Rows} rows for DataFile {DataFileId} in {ElapsedMs}ms ({RowsPerSec:F0} rows/sec)",
                totalInserted, dataFileId, parseAndInsertStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds,
                totalInserted / Math.Max(1.0, parseAndInsertStopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds));

            var commitStopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            await using (var updateCommand = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                updateCommand.Transaction = transaction;
                updateCommand.CommandText = isAppend
                    ? "UPDATE data_files SET row_count = row_count + @rows, import_status = @status, import_error = NULL WHERE id = @id"
                    : "UPDATE data_files SET row_count = @rows, import_status = @status, is_active_for_filtering = true, import_error = NULL WHERE id = @id";

                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@rows", totalInserted);
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@status", nameof(DataFileImportStatus.Completed));
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", dataFileId);
                await updateCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
            }

            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            commitStopwatch.Stop();

            totalStopwatch.Stop();
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PHASE commit: {ElapsedMs}ms | TOTAL import for DataFile {DataFileId}: {TotalMs}ms ({TotalRows} rows)",
                commitStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds, dataFileId, totalStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds, totalInserted);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync(cancellationToken);
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Import job failed for DataFile {DataFileId} after {ElapsedMs}ms", dataFileId, totalStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);

            await _dbContext.DataFiles
                .Where(f => f.Id == dataFileId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(f => f.ImportStatus, DataFileImportStatus.Failed)
                    .SetProperty(f => f.ImportError, ex.Message),
                    cancellationToken);

            throw;
        }
    }

    [Queue("bulk-import")]
    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid dataFileId, string storagePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Delete job started for DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);

        var connectionString = _configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")
   ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");
        await using var connection = new NpgsqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        await DeleteHistoricalPlatesAsync(connection, dataFileId, cancellationToken);

        await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .Where(f => f.Id == dataFileId)
            .ExecuteDeleteAsync(cancellationToken);

        await _fileStorage.DeleteAsync(storagePath, cancellationToken);
        _logger.LogInformation("Delete job completed for DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);
    }

    private static async Task<int> DeleteHistoricalPlatesAsync(
        NpgsqlConnection connection, Guid dataFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // match_results بيشاور على historical_plates بـ Restrict، فلازم نمسح كل
        // match_results المرتبطة (من أي عملية فرز) قبل ما نمسح الصفوف نفسها،
        // وإلا الحذف الجماعي بيفشل لو فيه لوحات اتفرزت قبل كده.
        await using (var deleteMatchesCommand = connection.CreateCommand())
        {
            deleteMatchesCommand.CommandText =
                "DELETE FROM match_results mr " +
                "USING historical_plates hp " +
                "WHERE hp.id = mr.historical_plate_id AND hp.data_file_id = @dataFileId";
            deleteMatchesCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dataFileId", dataFileId);
            await deleteMatchesCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

        var totalDeleted = 0;
        int deletedInBatch;
        do
        {
            await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
            // PostgreSQL مفيهوش DELETE TOP، فبنحدد الدفعة بـ subquery عليها LIMIT
            command.CommandText =
                "DELETE FROM historical_plates WHERE id IN (" +
                $"SELECT id FROM historical_plates WHERE data_file_id = @dataFileId LIMIT {BatchSize})";
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dataFileId", dataFileId);
            deletedInBatch = await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
            totalDeleted += deletedInBatch;
        }
        while (deletedInBatch > 0);

        return totalDeleted;
    }

    private static async Task<int> ExecuteBulkCopyAsync(
        NpgsqlConnection connection, IDataReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // COPY بالـ binary format هو المقابل لـ SqlBulkCopy في PostgreSQL، وبيشتغل
        // جوه الـ transaction المفتوحة على الـ connection تلقائياً.
        await using var importer = await connection.BeginBinaryImportAsync(
            "COPY historical_plates (data_file_id, user_id, raw_plate, normalized_plate, vehicle_type, " +
            "district, street, location, recorded_at, notes, recorder_name) FROM STDIN (FORMAT BINARY)",
            cancellationToken);
        importer.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(BulkCopyTimeoutSeconds);

        while (reader.Read())
        {
            await importer.StartRowAsync(cancellationToken);
            await importer.WriteAsync(reader.GetGuid(0), NpgsqlDbType.Uuid, cancellationToken);
            await importer.WriteAsync(reader.GetGuid(1), NpgsqlDbType.Uuid, cancellationToken);

            for (var i = 2; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
            {
                if (reader.IsDBNull(i))
                    await importer.WriteNullAsync(cancellationToken);
                else
                    await importer.WriteAsync(reader.GetString(i), NpgsqlDbType.Varchar, cancellationToken);
            }
        }

        await importer.CompleteAsync(cancellationToken);
        return ((IRowCounter)reader).TotalReadRows;
    }

    private static ColumnMapping DetectColumnsFromExcel(IExcelDataReader reader)
    {
        var map = new ColumnMapping();
        while (reader.Read())
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
            {
                var val = reader.GetValue(i)?.ToString()?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
                AssignColumn(map, val, i);
            }
            if (map.PlateCol != -1) break;
        }
        return map;
    }

    private static ColumnMapping DetectColumnsFromHeaders(string[] headers)
    {
        var map = new ColumnMapping();
        for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
        {
            AssignColumn(map, headers[i]?.Trim() ?? string.Empty, i);
        }
        return map;
    }

    private static void AssignColumn(ColumnMapping map, string header, int index)
    {
        if (header.Contains("لوحة") || header.Contains("اللوحة")) map.PlateCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("ملاحظ")) map.NotesCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("المسجّل") || header.Contains("المسجل")) map.RecorderNameCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("نوع") || header.Contains("السيارة")) map.VehicleTypeCol = index;
        else if (header.Equals("الشارع")) map.StreetCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("الحي")) map.DistrictCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("GPS") || header.Contains("الموقع") || header.Contains("رابط")) map.GpsCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("تاريخ") || header.Contains("التسجيل")) map.RecordedAtCol = index;
    }

    private interface IRowCounter
    {
        int TotalReadRows { get; }
    }

    private sealed class ExcelDataReaderWrapper : DbDataReader, IRowCounter
    {
        private readonly IExcelDataReader _reader;
        private readonly ColumnMapping _map;
        private readonly Guid _dataFileId;
        private readonly Guid _userId;

        public int TotalReadRows { get; private set; }

        public ExcelDataReaderWrapper(IExcelDataReader reader, ColumnMapping map, Guid dataFileId, Guid userId)
        {
            _reader = reader;
            _map = map;
            _dataFileId = dataFileId;
            _userId = userId;
        }

        public override bool Read()
        {
            while (_reader.Read())
            {
                var rawPlate = _map.PlateCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.PlateCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : null;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate) || rawPlate == "1" || rawPlate.Contains("لوحة"))
                    continue;

                _currentValues[0] = _dataFileId;
                _currentValues[1] = _userId;
                _currentValues[2] = rawPlate;
                _currentValues[3] = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(rawPlate);
                _currentValues[4] = _map.VehicleTypeCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.VehicleTypeCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;
                _currentValues[5] = _map.DistrictCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.DistrictCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;
                _currentValues[6] = _map.StreetCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.StreetCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;
                _currentValues[7] = _map.GpsCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.GpsCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;

                var recordedAtRaw = _map.RecordedAtCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.RecordedAtCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : null;
                _currentValues[8] = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(recordedAtRaw) ? recordedAtRaw : DBNull.Value;

                _currentValues[9] = _map.NotesCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.NotesCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;
                _currentValues[10] = _map.RecorderNameCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.RecorderNameCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;

                TotalReadRows++;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        public override object this[int ordinal] => GetValue(ordinal);
        public override object this[string name] => GetValue(GetOrdinal(name));
        public override int Depth => 0;
        public override bool NextResult() => false;
        public override object GetValue(int ordinal) => _currentValues[ordinal] ?? DBNull.Value;
        public override int FieldCount => 11;
        public override bool HasRows => true;
        public override bool IsClosed => _reader.IsClosed;
        public override int RecordsAffected => -1;
        public override int GetValues(object[] values) { Array.Copy(_currentValues, values, 11); return 11; }
        public override bool IsDBNull(int ordinal) => _currentValues[ordinal] == null || _currentValues[ordinal] == DBNull.Value;
        public override string GetName(int ordinal) => ordinal.ToString();
        public override int GetOrdinal(string name) => int.Parse(name);
        public override string GetDataTypeName(int ordinal) => typeof(object).Name;
        public override Type GetFieldType(int ordinal) => typeof(object);
        public override System.Collections.IEnumerator GetEnumerator() => _currentValues.GetEnumerator();
        public override bool GetBoolean(int ordinal) => (bool)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override byte GetByte(int ordinal) => (byte)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override long GetBytes(int ordinal, long dataOffset, byte[]? buffer, int bufferOffset, int length) => 0;
        public override char GetChar(int ordinal) => (char)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override long GetChars(int ordinal, long dataOffset, char[]? buffer, int bufferOffset, int length) => 0;
        public override Guid GetGuid(int ordinal) => (Guid)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override short GetInt16(int ordinal) => (short)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override int GetInt32(int ordinal) => (int)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override long GetInt64(int ordinal) => (long)GetValue(ordinal);

        public override double GetDouble(int ordinal) => (double)GetValue(ordinal);

                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Bank.Services.Helpers;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Hangfire;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;

[Queue("recording-processing")]
public class RecordingProcessingJob
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IFileStorageService _fileStorage;
    private readonly IAiTranscriptionService _aiService;
    private readonly IRecordingArchiveService _archiveService;
    private readonly ILogger<RecordingProcessingJob> _logger;

    public RecordingProcessingJob(
        AppDbContext dbContext, IFileStorageService fileStorage, IAiTranscriptionService aiService,
        IRecordingArchiveService archiveService, ILogger<RecordingProcessingJob> logger)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _fileStorage = fileStorage;
        _aiService = aiService;
        _archiveService = archiveService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [AutomaticRetry(Attempts = 0, OnAttemptsExceeded = AttemptsExceededAction.Fail)]
    public async Task ProcessAsync(Guid sessionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Recording processing job started for Session {SessionId}", sessionId);

        var session = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
            .Select(s => new { s.StartedAt, s.CheckFileId, s.AudioUrl, s.UserId, s.District, s.Street,s.RecorderName })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (session is null || session.AudioUrl is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("RecordingSession {SessionId} not found or has no audio â€” aborting", sessionId);
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            await using var audioStream = await _fileStorage.OpenReadAsync(session.AudioUrl, cancellationToken);
            var aiResult = await _aiService.TranscribeAsync(audioStream, "recording.aac", "audio/aac", cancellationToken);

            var gpsPoints = await _dbContext.RecordingGpsPoints
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(g => g.SessionId == sessionId)
                .OrderBy(g => g.CapturedAt)
                .Select(g => new GpsPointDto(
        g.Location,
        g.CapturedAt))/*(g => new { g.Location, g.CapturedAt })*/
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            var checkPlatesLookup = session.CheckFileId is null
                ? new Dictionary<string, long>()
                : await _dbContext.CheckPlates
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(cp => cp.CheckFileId == session.CheckFileId.Value)
                    .ToDictionaryAsync(cp => cp.NormalizedPlate, cp => cp.Id, cancellationToken);

            var recordedPlates = new List<RecordedPlate>();
            var sequence = 0;

            foreach (var car in aiResult.Cars)
            {
                sequence++;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(car.PlateNumber)) continue;

                var normalized = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(car.PlateNumber);

                
                var effectiveOffsetMs = car.TimestampStartMs.HasValue && car.TimestampEndMs.HasValue
                    ? (car.TimestampStartMs.Value + car.TimestampEndMs.Value) / 2
                    : car.TimestampMs;

                var recordedAt = session.StartedAt.AddMilliseconds(effectiveOffsetMs);
                var nearestLocation = FindNearestGpsPoint(gpsPoints, recordedAt);

                var isMatched = checkPlatesLookup.TryGetValue(normalized, out var matchedCheckPlateId);
               var bankNameAndVehicleTypeResult = isMatched
                    ? await _dbContext.CheckPlates
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .Where(cp => cp.Id == matchedCheckPlateId)
                        .Select(cp => new { cp.BankName, cp.VehicleType })
                        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
                    : null;
                recordedPlates.Add(new RecordedPlate
                {
                    SessionId = sessionId,
                    UserId = session.UserId,
                    SequenceNumber = sequence,
                    RawPlate = car.PlateNumber,
                    NormalizedPlate = normalized,
                    VehicleType = car.VehicleType,
                    Notes = car.Notes,
                    
                    District = session.District,
                    Street = session.Street,
                    Location = nearestLocation,
                    AudioOffsetMs = effectiveOffsetMs,
                    IsMatched = isMatched,
                    MatchedCheckPlateId = isMatched ? matchedCheckPlateId : null,
                    IsManualEntry = false,
                    RecordedAt = recordedAt,
                    BankName = bankNameAndVehicleTypeResult?.BankName,
                    VehicleTypeInCheckFile = bankNameAndVehicleTypeResult?.VehicleType
                });
            }

            await _dbContext.RecordedPlates.AddRangeAsync(recordedPlates, cancellationToken);

            await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
                .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(s => s.TotalPlates, recordedPlates.Count)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.TotalGpsPoints, gpsPoints.Count)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.Status, SessionStatus.Completed)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.EndedAt, DateTime.UtcNow)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.ProcessingError, (string?)null),
                    cancellationToken);

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            // Ù†Ø³Ø®Ø© Ø¯Ø§Ø¦Ù…Ø© Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ù†Ø§ØªØ¬ ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø±Ø´ÙŠÙ â€” Ø¨ØªÙØ¶Ù„ Ø­ØªÙ‰ Ù„Ùˆ Ø§Ù„ÙŠÙˆØ²Ø± Ù…Ø³Ø­ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Session
            // Ø£Ùˆ ÙƒÙ„ Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„Ø§Øª Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ ÙƒØ¯Ù‡. Ø£ÙŠ "ØªÙØ±ÙŠØº ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠ" Ù„Ù†ÙØ³ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Session Ø¨ÙŠØ¨Ø¯Ø£ Ù…Ù† Ø¬Ø¯ÙŠØ¯
            // (ReplaceSessionEntriesAsync Ø¨ØªÙ…Ø³Ø­ Ù†Ø³Ø®Ø© Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø±Ø´ÙŠÙ Ø§Ù„Ù‚Ø¯ÙŠÙ…Ø© Ø¨ØªØ§Ø¹ØªÙ‡ Ø§Ù„Ø£ÙˆÙ„).
            var recorderName = session.RecorderName; //await _dbContext.Users
            //    .AsNoTracking()
            //    .Where(u => u.Id == session.UserId)
            //    .Select(u => u.FullName)
            //    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

            var archiveEntries = recordedPlates.Select(p => new RecordingArchiveEntryInput(
                p.RawPlate, p.NormalizedPlate, p.VehicleType, session.District, session.Street, p.Notes,
                LocationLinkHelper.ToGoogleMapsLink(p.Location), p.RecordedAt, recorderName, p.IsMatched)).ToList();

            await _archiveService.ReplaceSessionEntriesAsync(sessionId, session.UserId, archiveEntries, cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Recording processing completed for Session {SessionId}: {PlateCount} plates, {MatchedCount} matched",
                sessionId, recordedPlates.Count, recordedPlates.Count(p => p.IsMatched));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Recording processing failed for Session {SessionId}", sessionId);

            await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
                .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(s => s.Status, SessionStatus.Failed)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.ProcessingError, ex.Message),
                    cancellationToken);

            throw;
        }
    }

    
    private static NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point? FindNearestGpsPoint(
        List<GpsPointDto> orderedGpsPoints, DateTime targetTime)
    {
        if (orderedGpsPoints.Count == 0) return null;

        NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point? nearest = null;
        var smallestDiff = TimeSpan.MaxValue;

        foreach (var point in orderedGpsPoints)
        {
            TimeSpan diff = ((DateTime)point.CapturedAt - targetTime).Duration();
            if (diff < smallestDiff)
            {
                smallestDiff = diff;
                nearest = (NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point)point.Location;
            }
        }

        return nearest;
    }
    private sealed record GpsPointDto(
    Point? Location,
    DateTime CapturedAt);
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Hangfire;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Npgsql;
using NpgsqlTypes;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;


[Queue("bulk-import")]
public class ReferralMatchingJob
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly ILogger<ReferralMatchingJob> _logger;
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

    public ReferralMatchingJob(AppDbContext dbContext, ILogger<ReferralMatchingJob> logger, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _logger = logger;
        _configuration = configuration;
    }

    [AutomaticRetry(Attempts = 0, OnAttemptsExceeded = AttemptsExceededAction.Fail)]
    public async Task ProcessAsync(Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Referral matching job started for ReferralJob {ReferralJobId}", referralJobId);

        var job = await _dbContext.ReferralJobs
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(j => j.Id == referralJobId)
            .Select(j => new { j.FilterType, j.GroupId, j.UserId, j.User.Role })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (job is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("ReferralJob {ReferralJobId} not found â€” aborting matching job", referralJobId);
            return;
        }

        var connectionString = _configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")
?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");


        await using var connection = new NpgsqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        try
        {
            if (job.FilterType == FilterType.New)
            {
                await MarkSkippedFromActiveCheckFileAsync(connection, referralJobId, job.GroupId, job.UserId, cancellationToken);
            }

            await InsertMatchResultsAsync(
                connection, referralJobId, job.GroupId, job.UserId, onlyGrantedFiles: job.Role == UserRole.User, cancellationToken);
            await MarkMatchedAsync(connection, referralJobId, cancellationToken);

            var skippedCount = await CountByStatusAsync(connection, referralJobId, ReferralPlateStatus.Skipped, cancellationToken);
            var matchedCount = await CountByStatusAsync(connection, referralJobId, ReferralPlateStatus.Matched, cancellationToken);

            await using (var updateCommand = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                updateCommand.CommandText =
                    "UPDATE referral_jobs SET skipped_plates_count = @skipped, matched_plates_count = @matched, status = @status WHERE id = @id";
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@skipped", skippedCount);
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@matched", matchedCount);
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@status", nameof(JobStatus.Completed));
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", referralJobId);
                await updateCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
            }

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Referral matching job completed for ReferralJob {ReferralJobId}: skipped={Skipped}, matched={Matched}",
                referralJobId, skippedCount, matchedCount);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Referral matching job failed for ReferralJob {ReferralJobId}", referralJobId);

            await using var failCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
            failCommand.CommandText = "UPDATE referral_jobs SET status = @status WHERE id = @id";
            failCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@status", nameof(JobStatus.Failed));
            failCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", referralJobId);
            await failCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);

            throw;
        }
    }

    private static async Task MarkSkippedFromActiveCheckFileAsync(
        NpgsqlConnection connection, Guid referralJobId, Guid? groupId, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = @"
            UPDATE referral_plates rp
            SET status = 'Skipped'
            WHERE rp.referral_job_id = @jobId
              AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM check_plates cp
                    JOIN check_files cf ON cf.id = cp.check_file_id
                    WHERE cf.is_active = true
                      AND cp.normalized_plate = rp.normalized_plate
                      AND (
                            (@groupId IS NOT NULL AND cf.group_id = @groupId)
                         OR (@groupId IS NULL AND cf.group_id IS NULL AND cf.uploaded_by = @userId)
                      )
              );";

        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@jobId", referralJobId);
        command.Parameters.Add("@groupId", NpgsqlDbType.Uuid).Value = (object?)groupId ?? DBNull.Value;
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@userId", userId);
        await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static async Task InsertMatchResultsAsync(
        NpgsqlConnection connection, Guid referralJobId, Guid? groupId, Guid userId, bool onlyGrantedFiles,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = @"
            INSERT INTO match_results
                (referral_job_id, historical_plate_id, normalized_plate, found_vehicle_type,
                 found_district, found_street, location, found_recorded_at, source_data_file_id, matched_at)
            SELECT
                @jobId, hp.id, rp.normalized_plate, hp.vehicle_type,
                hp.district, hp.street, hp.location, hp.recorded_at, hp.data_file_id, now()
            FROM referral_plates rp
            JOIN historical_plates hp ON hp.normalized_plate = rp.normalized_plate
            JOIN data_files df ON df.id = hp.data_file_id AND df.is_active_for_filtering = true
            WHERE rp.referral_job_id = @jobId
              AND rp.status <> 'Skipped'
              AND (
                    (@groupId IS NOT NULL AND df.group_id = @groupId)
                 OR (@groupId IS NULL AND df.group_id IS NULL AND df.owner_id = @userId)
              )
              AND (
                    NOT @onlyGrantedFiles
                 OR EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM user_data_file_permissions udp
                        WHERE udp.user_id = @userId AND udp.data_file_id = df.id
                    )
              );";

        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@jobId", referralJobId);
        command.Parameters.Add("@groupId", NpgsqlDbType.Uuid).Value = (object?)groupId ?? DBNull.Value;
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@userId", userId);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@onlyGrantedFiles", onlyGrantedFiles);
        command.CommandTimeout = 300;
        await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static async Task MarkMatchedAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = @"
            UPDATE referral_plates rp
            SET status = 'Matched'
            WHERE rp.referral_job_id = @jobId
              AND rp.status <> 'Skipped'
              AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM match_results mr
                    WHERE mr.referral_job_id = @jobId
                      AND mr.normalized_plate = rp.normalized_plate
              );";
       

        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@jobId", referralJobId);
        await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static async Task<int> CountByStatusAsync(
        NpgsqlConnection connection, Guid referralJobId, ReferralPlateStatus status, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM referral_plates WHERE referral_job_id = @jobId AND status = @status";
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@jobId", referralJobId);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@status", status.ToString());
        var result = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync(cancellationToken);
        return Convert.ToInt32(result);
    }
}

using CsvHelper;
using CsvHelper.Configuration;
using ExcelDataReader;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers
{
    public sealed record ExcelSheetInfo(
        int Index, string Name, int RowCount, List<string?> Headers, List<List<string?>> SampleRows, int HeaderRowIndex);

    public sealed record ExcelSheetData(int Index, string Name, List<List<string?>> Rows);

    public static class ExcelSheetReader
    {
        private const int MaxSampleRows = 5;
        private const int MaxHeaderScanRows = 30;
        private const int MaxBufferedRows = MaxHeaderScanRows + MaxSampleRows + 1;

        /// <summary>بيرجّع أسامي الـ Sheets وعدد صفوفها، ويكتشف صف الهيدر الحقيقي (مش بالضرورة أول صف)
        /// مع عينة صغيرة من صفوف الداتا اللي بعده (لاقتراح عمود اللوحة/الأعمدة الافتراضية).</summary>
        public static List<ExcelSheetInfo> GetSheetsInfo(Stream stream, string extension)
        {
            if (extension == ".csv")
            {
                var config = new CsvConfiguration(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                {
                    HasHeaderRecord = false,
                    MissingFieldFound = null,
                    BadDataFound = null
                };
                using var textReader = new StreamReader(stream);
                using var csv = new CsvReader(textReader, config);

                var buffered = new List<List<string?>>();
                var rowCount = 0;

                while (csv.Read())
                {
                    if (buffered.Count < MaxBufferedRows)
                    {
                        var record = csv.Parser.Record?.Select(v => (string?)v).ToList() ?? new List<string?>();
                        buffered.Add(record);
                    }
                    rowCount++;
                }

                var headerRowIndex = ReferralHeaderRowDetector.Detect(buffered);
                var headers = headerRowIndex < buffered.Count ? buffered[headerRowIndex] : new List<string?>();
                var sampleRows = buffered.Skip(headerRowIndex + 1).Take(MaxSampleRows).ToList();

                return new List<ExcelSheetInfo> { new(0, "CSV", rowCount, headers, sampleRows, headerRowIndex) };
            }

            var result = new List<ExcelSheetInfo>();
            using var reader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
            var sheetIndex = 0;

            do
            {
                var buffered = new List<List<string?>>();
                var rowCount = 0;

                while (reader.Read())
                {
                    if (buffered.Count < MaxBufferedRows)
                    {
                        var row = new List<string?>(reader.FieldCount);
                        for (var i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
                        {
                            row.Add(reader.GetValue(i)?.ToString()?.Trim());
                        }
                        buffered.Add(row);
                    }
                    rowCount++;
                }

                var headerRowIndex = ReferralHeaderRowDetector.Detect(buffered);
                var headers = headerRowIndex < buffered.Count ? buffered[headerRowIndex] : new List<string?>();
                var sampleRows = buffered.Skip(headerRowIndex + 1).Take(MaxSampleRows).ToList();

                result.Add(new ExcelSheetInfo(sheetIndex, reader.Name, rowCount, headers, sampleRows, headerRowIndex));
                sheetIndex++;
            }
            while (reader.NextResult());

            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>بيقرأ محتوى الـ Sheets المختارة بس (أو كلها لو allSheets=true).</summary>
        public static List<ExcelSheetData> ReadSelectedSheets(
            Stream stream, string extension, bool allSheets, List<int>? selectedIndexes)
        {
            if (extension == ".csv")
            {
                using var textReader = new StreamReader(stream);
                var config = new CsvConfiguration(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                {
                    HasHeaderRecord = false,
                    MissingFieldFound = null,
                    BadDataFound = null
                };
                using var csv = new CsvReader(textReader, config);

                var rows = new List<List<string?>>();
                while (csv.Read())
                {
                    var record = csv.Parser.Record;
                    rows.Add(record?.Select(v => (string?)v).ToList() ?? new List<string?>());
                }

                return new List<ExcelSheetData> { new(0, "CSV", rows) };
            }

            var selectedSet = selectedIndexes is null ? null : new HashSet<int>(selectedIndexes);
            var result = new List<ExcelSheetData>();

            using var reader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
            var sheetIndex = 0;

            do
            {
                var include = allSheets || (selectedSet?.Contains(sheetIndex) ?? false);
                if (!include)
                {
                    sheetIndex++;
                    continue;
                }

                var rows = new List<List<string?>>();
                while (reader.Read())
                {
                    var row = new List<string?>(reader.FieldCount);
                    for (var i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
                    {
                        row.Add(reader.GetValue(i)?.ToString()?.Trim());
                    }
                    rows.Add(row);
                }

                result.Add(new ExcelSheetData(sheetIndex, reader.Name, rows));
                sheetIndex++;
            }
            while (reader.NextResult());

            return result;
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers
{
    public static class FileHelper
    {
        public static string? ValidateUploadedFile(IFormFile file,long MaxUploadSizeBytes ,string[] AllowedExtensions)
        {
            if (file is null || file.Length == 0)
            {
                return "لازم ترفع ملف.";
            }

            if (file.Length > MaxUploadSizeBytes)
            {
                return $"حجم الملف أكبر من الحد المسموح ({MaxUploadSizeBytes / 1024 / 1024} MB).";
            }

            var extension = Path.GetExtension(file.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();
            if (!AllowedExtensions.Contains(extension))
            {
                return $"صيغة الملف غير مدعومة. المسموح: {string.Join(", ", AllowedExtensions)}";
            }

            return null;
        }
    }
}

using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers;


public static partial class LocationLinkHelper
{
    public static string? ToGoogleMapsLink(Point? point)
    {
        if (point is null) return null;

        // NetTopologySuite: X = Longitude, Y = Latitude
        return $"https://www.google.com/maps?q={point.Y.ToString("F6", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)},{point.X.ToString("F6", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}";
    }
    public static string ToGoogleMapsLink(double latitude, double longitude)
    {
        return $"https://www.google.com/maps?q={latitude.ToString("F6", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)},{longitude.ToString("F6", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}";
    }

    public static Point ToPoint(double latitude, double longitude)
    {
        return new Point(longitude, latitude) { SRID = 4326 };
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Net;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers;

// partial Ø¹Ø´Ø§Ù† Ø§Ù„ÙƒÙ„Ø§Ø³ Ø§Ù„Ø£ØµÙ„ÙŠ LocationLinkHelper (ÙÙŠÙ‡ ToPoint/ToGoogleMapsLink)
// Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ Ø¨Ø§Ù„ÙØ¹Ù„ ÙˆÙ…Ø§ Ø¹Ø§ÙŠØ²ÙŠÙ†Ø´ Ù†Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù‡ â€” Ø¯Ù‡ Ø¨Ø³ Ø¨ÙŠØ¶ÙŠÙ Ø§Ø³ØªØ®Ø±Ø§Ø¬ Ø§Ù„Ø¥Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ø«ÙŠØ§Øª Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠÙ†ÙƒØ§Øª.
public static partial class LocationLinkHelper
{
    private static readonly Regex CoordinatePattern = new(
        @"(?:destination=|[?&]q=|[?&]ll=|@)(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+),(-?\d{1,3}\.\d+)",
        RegexOptions.Compiled);

    private static readonly HashSet<string> ShortLinkHosts = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        "maps.app.goo.gl", "goo.gl"
    };

    private const int MaxRedirectHops = 5;

    /// <summary>
    /// Ø¨ÙŠØ­Ø§ÙˆÙ„ ÙŠØ³ØªØ®Ø±Ø¬ (Latitude, Longitude) Ù…Ù† Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø· Ø®Ø±Ø§Ø¦Ø· Ø¬ÙˆØ¬Ù„ â€” Ø³ÙˆØ§Ø¡ ÙƒØ§Ù† ÙÙŠÙ‡
    /// Ø§Ù„Ø¥Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ø«ÙŠØ§Øª Ù…Ø¨Ø§Ø´Ø±Ø©ØŒ Ø£Ùˆ Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø· Ù…Ø®ØªØµØ± (maps.app.goo.gl/goo.gl) Ø¨ÙŠØªØ§Ø¨Ø¹Ù‡ Ø¹Ø¨Ø±
    /// Ø§Ù„Ù€ redirects Ù„Ø­Ø¯ Ù…Ø§ ÙŠÙ„Ø§Ù‚ÙŠ Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø· ÙÙŠÙ‡ Ø¥Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ø«ÙŠØ§Øª Ø£Ùˆ ÙŠÙØ´Ù„.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task<(double Latitude, double Longitude)?> TryExtractCoordinatesAsync(
        string? url, HttpClient httpClient, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url)) return null;

        var direct = TryExtractFromUrlText(url);
        if (direct.HasValue) return direct;

        if (!Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri)) return null;
        if (!ShortLinkHosts.Contains(uri.Host)) return null;

        var resolvedUrl = await ResolveRedirectsAsync(uri, httpClient, cancellationToken);
        return resolvedUrl is null ? null : TryExtractFromUrlText(resolvedUrl);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Ù†Ø³Ø®Ø© Batch â€” Ø¨ØªØ¹Ù…Ù„ Distinct Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠÙ†ÙƒØ§Øª ÙˆØªØ­Ù„ ÙƒÙ„ Ù„ÙŠÙ†Ùƒ ÙØ±ÙŠØ¯ Ù…Ø±Ø© ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© Ø¨Ø³.
    /// Ø§Ù„Ù…ÙØªØ§Ø­ ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Dictionary Ø§Ù„Ø±Ø§Ø¬Ø¹Ø© Ù‡Ùˆ Ø§Ù„Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø· Ø§Ù„Ø£ØµÙ„ÙŠ ÙƒÙ…Ø§ Ù‡Ùˆ.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task<Dictionary<string, (double Latitude, double Longitude)?>> ExtractCoordinatesBatchAsync(
        IEnumerable<string?> urls, HttpClient httpClient, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var distinctUrls = urls.Where(u => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(u)).Distinct().ToList();
        var result = new Dictionary<string, (double, double)?>();

        foreach (var url in distinctUrls)
        {
            result[url!] = await TryExtractCoordinatesAsync(url, httpClient, cancellationToken);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static (double, double)? TryExtractFromUrlText(string url)
    {
        var match = CoordinatePattern.Match(url);
        if (!match.Success) return null;

        if (double.TryParse(match.Groups[1].Value, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var lat) &&
            double.TryParse(match.Groups[2].Value, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var lng))
        {
            return (lat, lng);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static async Task<string?> ResolveRedirectsAsync(Uri startUri, HttpClient httpClient, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var current = startUri;

        for (var hop = 0; hop < MaxRedirectHops; hop++)
        {
            using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, current);
            HttpResponseMessage response;
            try
            {
                response = await httpClient.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, cancellationToken);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }

            if (!IsRedirectStatus(response.StatusCode) || response.Headers.Location is null)
            {
                return response.IsSuccessStatusCode ? current.ToString() : null;
            }

            current = response.Headers.Location.IsAbsoluteUri
                ? response.Headers.Location
                : new Uri(current, response.Headers.Location);

            if (TryExtractFromUrlText(current.ToString()) is not null) return current.ToString();
        }

        return current.ToString();
    }

    private static bool IsRedirectStatus(HttpStatusCode status) =>
        status is HttpStatusCode.Moved or HttpStatusCode.MovedPermanently or HttpStatusCode.Found or
                   HttpStatusCode.Redirect or HttpStatusCode.RedirectKeepVerb or
                   HttpStatusCode.TemporaryRedirect or HttpStatusCode.PermanentRedirect;
}

using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;

public static class PlateNormalizer
{
    
    private static readonly Dictionary<char, char> EnglishToArabicPlateLetters = new()
    {
        ['A'] = 'Ø§',
        ['B'] = 'Ø¨',
        ['Z'] = 'Ù…',
        ['R'] = 'Ø±',
        ['D'] = 'Ø¯',
        ['V'] = 'ÙŠ',
        ['J'] = 'Ø­',
        ['E'] = 'Ø¹',
        ['K'] = 'Ùƒ',
        ['G'] = 'Ù‚',
        ['X'] = 'Øµ',
        ['U'] = 'Ùˆ',
        ['L'] = 'Ù„',
        ['T'] = 'Ø·',
        ['S'] = 'Ø³',
        ['N'] = 'Ù†',
        ['H'] = 'Ù‡'
    };

    public static string Normalize(string? input)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input)) return string.Empty;

        var normalized = input.Normalize(NormalizationForm.FormC);
        var sb = new StringBuilder(normalized.Length);

        foreach (var ch in normalized)
        {
            if (char.IsWhiteSpace(ch) || ch == '\u0640' || (ch >= '\u064B' && ch <= '\u065F'))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var mappedChar = ch switch
            {
                'Ø£' or 'Ø¥' or 'Ø¢' or 'Ù±' => 'Ø§',
                'Ø©' => 'Ù‡',
                'Ù‰' => 'ÙŠ',
                'Ø¤' => 'Ùˆ',
                'Ø¦' => 'ÙŠ',
                _ => char.ToUpperInvariant(ch)
            };

            if (EnglishToArabicPlateLetters.TryGetValue(mappedChar, out var arabicEquivalent))
            {
                mappedChar = arabicEquivalent;
            }

            sb.Append(mappedChar);
        }

        return sb.ToString().Trim();
    }

    private static readonly Regex ReferralPlatePattern =
     new(@"^([A-Za-z\u0621-\u064A]+)([0-9]*)$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

 
    private static readonly Regex ReversedReferralPlatePattern =
        new(@"^([0-9]+)([A-Za-z\u0621-\u064A]+)$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

    //public static string NormalizeReferralPlate(string rawPlate)

    //    return mappedLetters.ToString() + paddedDigits;

    public static string NormalizeReferralPlate(string rawPlate)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate))
            return string.Empty;

        var cleaned = rawPlate
            .Replace(" ", "")
            .Replace("-", "")
            .Trim()
            .ToUpperInvariant();

        cleaned = ConvertArabicIndicDigitsToWestern(cleaned);

        string letters;
        string digits;

        var match = ReferralPlatePattern.Match(cleaned);

        if (match.Success)
        {
            letters = match.Groups[1].Value;
            digits = match.Groups[2].Value;
        }
        else
        {
            var reversedMatch = ReversedReferralPlatePattern.Match(cleaned);

            if (reversedMatch.Success)
            {
                digits = reversedMatch.Groups[1].Value;
                letters = reversedMatch.Groups[2].Value;
            }
            else
            {
                return cleaned;
            }
        }

        var mappedLetters = new StringBuilder(letters.Length);

        // Reverse the source letter order
        for (var i = letters.Length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var ch = letters[i];

            mappedLetters.Append(
                EnglishToArabicPlateLetters.TryGetValue(ch, out var arabicChar)
                    ? arabicChar
                    : ch);
        }

        var paddedDigits = digits.Length >= 4
            ? digits
            : digits.PadLeft(4, '0');

        return mappedLetters.ToString() + paddedDigits;
    }

    private static string ConvertArabicIndicDigitsToWestern(string input)
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder(input.Length);
        foreach (var ch in input)
        {
            if (ch is >= '\u0660' and <= '\u0669')
            {
                builder.Append((char)('0' + (ch - '\u0660')));
            }
            else
            {
                builder.Append(ch);
            }
        }
        return builder.ToString();
    }
}

public static class ReferralColumnSuggestor
{
    private static readonly string[] ColorAliases =
    {
        "لون المركبة الأساسي", "لون المركبة", "اللون", "لون", "color"
    };

    private static readonly string[] VehicleTypeAliases =
    {
        "نوع السيارة", "نوع المركبة", "التصنيف", "vehicle type", "vehicletype", "type"
    };

    private static readonly string[] ModelAliases =
    {
        "طراز المركبة", "موديل السيارة", "الطراز", "الموديل", "model"
    };

    public static (string? ColorHeader, string? VehicleTypeHeader, string? ModelHeader) SuggestDefaults(
        IReadOnlyList<string?> headers)
    {
        return (
            FindByAliases(headers, ColorAliases),
            FindByAliases(headers, VehicleTypeAliases),
            FindByAliases(headers, ModelAliases));
    }

    private static string? FindByAliases(IReadOnlyList<string?> headers, string[] aliases)
    {
        foreach (var alias in aliases)
        {
            var match = headers.FirstOrDefault(h =>
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(h) && string.Equals(h.Trim(), alias, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            if (match is not null) return match;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Services\Helpers\ReferralHeaderRowDetector.cs =====
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers
{
    public static class ReferralHeaderRowDetector
    {
        private const int MaxScanRows = 30;
        private const double DataDigitFractionThreshold = 0.4;
        private const int MinNonEmptyCellsForData = 2;

        /// <returns>index الصف اللي المفروض يتعامل معاه كهيدر (0-based). لو مقدرناش نحدد صف بيانات واضح، بيرجّع 0 (نفس السلوك القديم).</returns>
        public static int Detect(List<List<string?>> rows)
        {
            var scanLimit = Math.Min(rows.Count, MaxScanRows);

            for (var i = 0; i < scanLimit; i++)
            {
                if (IsLikelyDataRow(rows[i]))
                {
                    return i == 0 ? 0 : i - 1;
                }
            }

            return 0;
        }

        private static bool IsLikelyDataRow(List<string?> row)
        {
            var nonEmpty = 0;
            var withDigits = 0;

            foreach (var cell in row)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cell)) continue;
                nonEmpty++;
                if (cell.Any(char.IsDigit)) withDigits++;
            }

            if (nonEmpty < MinNonEmptyCellsForData) return false;

            return (double)withDigits / nonEmpty >= DataDigitFractionThreshold;
        }
    }

}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Services\Helpers\TextUtil.cs =====
namespace Bank.Services.Helpers;

public static class TextUtil
{
    public static string? Truncate(string? s, int max)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)) return s;
        return s.Length <= max ? s : s[..max];
    }

    public static string? NullIfBlank(string? s) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) ? null : s;
}

/// <summary>Ø¹Ø±Ø¶ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© (Ø± Ø¹ Ø· 4428) Ø¨ÙŠØªØ­Ø³Ø¨ ÙˆÙ‚Øª Ø§Ù„Ù‚Ø±Ø§Ø¡Ø©ØŒ ÙˆÙ…Ø´ Ù…ØªØ®Ø²Ù†.</summary>
public static class PlateText
{
    public static string? Display(string? letters, string? digits)
    {
        var l = letters ?? "";
        var d = digits ?? "";
        if (l.Length == 0 && d.Length == 0) return null;
        if (l.Length == 0) return d;
        var spaced = string.Join(" ", l.ToCharArray());
        return d.Length == 0 ? spaced : spaced + " " + d;
    }
}

    public static class UserHelper

        public static string? GetCurrentUserId(IHttpContextAccessor _contextAccessor)
        {
            return _contextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
        }
    }

using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… + Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø±ÙˆØ¨ Ø§Ù„ÙØ¹Ù„ÙŠ Ø¨ØªØ§Ø¹Ù‡. Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø¯Ù…Ù† Ù…Ø±Ø¨ÙˆØ· Ø¨Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø±ÙˆØ¨ Ø¹Ù† Ø·Ø±ÙŠÙ‚ Groups.AdminId
/// (u.AdministeredGroup) ÙˆÙ…Ø´ Ø´Ø±Ø· ÙŠÙƒÙˆÙ† u.GroupId Ù…ØªØ³Ø¬Ù„ Ù„Ù‡ØŒ ÙØ§Ù„Ø£Ø¯Ù…Ù† Ø¨ÙŠØ§Ø®Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø±ÙˆØ¨ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ø¨ÙŠØ¯ÙŠØ±Ù‡
/// (Ù„Ùˆ Ù†Ø´Ø·)ØŒ ÙˆØ£ÙŠ Ø­Ø¯ ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠ (User / SuperAdmin) Ø¨ÙŠØ§Ø®Ø¯ u.GroupId Ø²ÙŠ Ù…Ø§ Ù‡Ùˆ.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ScopedUser
{
    public ApplicationUser User { get; init; } = null!;
    public Guid? GroupId { get; init; }
    public string? GroupName { get; init; }
}

public static class UserScopeQueries
{
    // Ø¨ØªØªØªØ±Ø¬Ù… Ù„Ù€ SQL (LEFT JOIN Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ groups) â€” Ø§Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù…Ù‡Ø§ Ù‚Ø¨Ù„ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Where/Select Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø§Ù„ÙŠÙˆØ²Ø±
    public static IQueryable<ScopedUser> WithEffectiveGroup(this IQueryable<ApplicationUser> users) =>
        users.Select(u => new ScopedUser
        {
            User = u,
            GroupId = u.Role == UserRole.Admin && u.AdministeredGroup != null && u.AdministeredGroup.IsActive
                ? (Guid?)u.AdministeredGroup.Id
                : u.GroupId,
            GroupName = u.Role == UserRole.Admin && u.AdministeredGroup != null && u.AdministeredGroup.IsActive
                ? u.AdministeredGroup.Name
                : u.Group != null ? u.Group.Name : null
        });
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Bank.Repo.Interfaces;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.AdminDTOs;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class AdminService : IAdminService
{
    private IUserService _userService;
    private readonly IUnitOfWork _unitOfWork;
    private readonly AppDbContext _context;
    private readonly ILogger<AdminService> _logger;

    public AdminService(IUnitOfWork unitOfWork, AppDbContext context, ILogger<AdminService> logger,IUserService userService)
    {
        _unitOfWork = unitOfWork;
        _context = context;
        _logger = logger;
        _userService = userService;
    }


    private async Task<Guid?> GetMyGroupIdAsync(Guid currentAdminId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        return await _context.Groups
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(g => g.AdminId == currentAdminId && g.IsActive)
            .Select(g => (Guid?)g.Id)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>>> GetMyGroupMembersAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, PaginationParams pagination, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} attempted to list members but administers no active group", currentAdminId);
            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var query = _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.GroupId == myGroupId && u.Role == UserRole.User);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pagination.SearchTerm))
        {
            var term = pagination.SearchTerm.Trim();
            query = query.Where(u =>
                u.FullName.ToLower().Contains(term.ToLower()));
        }

        var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(ct);

     
        var items = await query
            .OrderBy(u => u.FullName)
            .Skip((pagination.PageNumber - 1) * pagination.PageSize)
            .Take(pagination.PageSize)
            .Select(u => new GroupMemberResponseDto
            {
                Id = u.Id,
                FullName = u.FullName,
               
                Email = u.Email!,
                IsActive = u.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,

                Permissions = _context.UserPermissions
                    .Where(p => p.UserId == u.Id)
                    .Select(p => new UserPermissionDto
                    {
                        CanManageCheckFiles = p.CanManageCheckFiles,
                        CanUploadDataFiles = p.CanUploadDataFiles,
                        CanSort = p.CanSort
                    })
                    .FirstOrDefault() ?? new UserPermissionDto()
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        return ApiResponse<PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>>.SuccessResponse(new PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>
        {
            Items = items,
            TotalCount = totalCount,
            PageNumber = pagination.PageNumber,
            PageSize = pagination.PageSize
        });
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>> GetMyGroupMemberByIdAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var member = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.Id == targetUserId)
            .Select(u => new GroupMemberResponseDto
            {
                Id = u.Id,
                FullName = u.FullName,
                Email = u.Email!,
                IsActive = u.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,
                Permissions = _context.UserPermissions
                    .Where(p => p.UserId == u.Id)
                    .Select(p => new UserPermissionDto
                    {
                        CanManageCheckFiles = p.CanManageCheckFiles,
                        CanUploadDataFiles = p.CanUploadDataFiles,
                        CanSort = p.CanSort
                    })
                    .FirstOrDefault() ?? new UserPermissionDto()
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);


        var belongsToMyGroup = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(u => u.Id == targetUserId && u.GroupId == myGroupId, ct);

        if (member is null || !belongsToMyGroup)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to access User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.Fail("User not found in your group.");
        }

        return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(member);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>> UpdateMyGroupMemberAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, UpdateGroupMemberDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(targetUserId.ToString());

        if (user is null || user.GroupId != myGroupId)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to update User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.Fail("User not found in your group.");
        }

        user.FullName = dto.FullName;
        user.Email = dto.Email;
      
        await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} updated User {UserId} in Group {GroupId}", currentAdminId, targetUserId, myGroupId);

        return await GetMyGroupMemberByIdAsync(currentAdminId, targetUserId, ct);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> RemoveMemberFromMyGroupAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(targetUserId.ToString());

        if (user is null || user.GroupId != myGroupId)
        {
         
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to remove User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("User not found in your group.");
        }

   
        user.GroupId = null;
    
        await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

        // أذونات الفرز كانت على ملفات الجروب ده — مبقتش ليها لازمة
        await _context.UserDataFilePermissions.Where(p => p.UserId == targetUserId).ExecuteDeleteAsync(ct);

        _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} removed User {UserId} from Group {GroupId}", currentAdminId, targetUserId, myGroupId);

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>> UpdateMemberPermissionsAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, UpdateUserPermissionDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var userInGroup = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(u => u.Id == targetUserId && u.GroupId == myGroupId, ct);

        if (!userInGroup)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to change permissions for User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>.Fail("User not found in your group.");
        }

        var permRepo = _unitOfWork.Repository<UserPermission>();
        var permission = await _context.UserPermissions.FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.UserId == targetUserId, ct);

        if (permission is null)
        {
            
            _logger.LogWarning("UserPermission row missing for User {UserId}; creating one now", targetUserId);
            permission = new UserPermission { UserId = targetUserId };
            await permRepo.AddAsync(permission);
        }

  
        permission.CanManageCheckFiles = dto.CanManageCheckFiles;
        permission.CanUploadDataFiles = dto.CanUploadDataFiles;
        permission.CanSort = dto.CanSort;

       await permRepo.UpdateAsync(permission);
        await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} updated permissions for User {UserId} in Group {GroupId}", currentAdminId, targetUserId, myGroupId);

        return ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>.SuccessResponse(dto);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<List<UserDataFilePermissionDto>>> GetMemberDataFilePermissionsAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<List<UserDataFilePermissionDto>>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var userInGroup = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(u => u.Id == targetUserId && u.GroupId == myGroupId && u.Role == UserRole.User, ct);

        if (!userInGroup)
        {
            return ApiResponse<List<UserDataFilePermissionDto>>.Fail("User not found in your group.", null, 404);
        }

        // بس الأذونات على ملفات جروب الأدمن ده — أي إذن قديم على ملف برة الجروب ميظهرش له
        var items = await _context.UserDataFilePermissions.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(p => p.UserId == targetUserId && p.DataFile.GroupId == myGroupId)
            .OrderBy(p => p.DataFile.SortOrder)
            .Select(p => new UserDataFilePermissionDto
            {
                DataFileId = p.DataFileId,
                FileName = p.DataFile.FileName,
                GrantedByAdminId = p.GrantedByAdminId,
                GrantedByAdminName = p.GrantedByAdmin.FullName,
                CreatedAt = p.CreatedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        return ApiResponse<List<UserDataFilePermissionDto>>.SuccessResponse(items);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<List<UserDataFilePermissionDto>>> UpdateMemberDataFilePermissionsAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, UpdateUserDataFilePermissionsDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<List<UserDataFilePermissionDto>>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var userInGroup = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(u => u.Id == targetUserId && u.GroupId == myGroupId && u.Role == UserRole.User, ct);

        if (!userInGroup)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to change data file permissions for User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<List<UserDataFilePermissionDto>>.Fail("User not found in your group.", null, 404);
        }

        var requestedIds = dto.DataFileIds.Distinct().ToList();

        // الأدمن يقدر يدّي إذن بس على ملفات الداتا اللي في جروبه
        var validIds = await _context.DataFiles.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(f => requestedIds.Contains(f.Id) && f.GroupId == myGroupId)
            .Select(f => f.Id)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        if (validIds.Count != requestedIds.Count)
        {
            return ApiResponse<List<UserDataFilePermissionDto>>.Fail("Some data files were not found in your group.", null, 400);
        }

        // الأدمن بيعدّل أذونات ملفات جروبه بس — مش بيلمس أي إذن على ملف برة الجروب
        var existing = await _context.UserDataFilePermissions
            .Where(p => p.UserId == targetUserId && p.DataFile.GroupId == myGroupId)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        _context.UserDataFilePermissions.RemoveRange(existing.Where(p => !validIds.Contains(p.DataFileId)));

        var existingIds = existing.Select(p => p.DataFileId).ToHashSet();
        _context.UserDataFilePermissions.AddRange(validIds
            .Where(id => !existingIds.Contains(id))
            .Select(id => new UserDataFilePermission
            {
                UserId = targetUserId,
                DataFileId = id,
                GrantedByAdminId = currentAdminId
            }));

        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(ct);

        _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} set {Count} sortable data files for User {UserId} in Group {GroupId}",
            currentAdminId, validIds.Count, targetUserId, myGroupId);

        return await GetMemberDataFilePermissionsAsync(currentAdminId, targetUserId, ct);
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;


public class AiTranscriptionService : IAiTranscriptionService

    private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
    private readonly ILogger<AiTranscriptionService> _logger;

    public AiTranscriptionService(HttpClient httpClient, IConfiguration configuration, ILogger<AiTranscriptionService> logger)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        _logger = logger;

        var baseUrl = configuration["AiService:BaseUrl"] ?? "http://localhost:8000";
        _httpClient.BaseAddress = new Uri(baseUrl);
        _httpClient.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
    }

    public async Task<AiTranscriptionResult> TranscribeAsync(
        Stream audioStream, string fileName, string contentType, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        using var content = new MultipartFormDataContent();
        using var streamContent = new StreamContent(audioStream);
        streamContent.Headers.ContentType = MediaTypeHeaderValue.Parse(contentType);
        content.Add(streamContent, "file", fileName);

        var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync("/api/v1/process", content, cancellationToken);
        response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

        var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
        var raw = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AiRawResponse>(json, JsonOptions)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("AI service returned an empty/invalid response.");

        var cars = raw.Cars
            .Select(c => new AiCarResult(c.PlateNumber, c.TimestampMs, c.TimestampStartMs, c.TimestampEndMs, c.VehicleType, c.Notes))
            .ToList();

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "AI transcription returned {Count} plates for {FileName} (recording duration {DurationMs}ms)",
            cars.Count, fileName, raw.RecordingDurationMs);

        return new AiTranscriptionResult(raw.RecordingDurationMs, raw.TimestampReference, cars);
    }

    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOptions = new() { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };

    private record AiRawResponse(
        [property: JsonPropertyName("recording_duration_ms")] int RecordingDurationMs,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("timestamp_reference")] string TimestampReference,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("cars")] List<AiRawCar> Cars);

    private record AiRawCar(
        [property: JsonPropertyName("plate_number")] string PlateNumber,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("timestamp_ms")] int TimestampMs,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("timestamp_start_ms")] int? TimestampStartMs,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("timestamp_end_ms")] int? TimestampEndMs,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("vehicle_type")] string? VehicleType,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("notes")] string? Notes);
}

using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.AuthDTOs;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using SendGrid.Helpers.Errors.Model;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations
{
    public class AuthService : IAuthService
    {

        private readonly IUserService _userService;
        private readonly IJWTService _jWTService;
        private readonly IConfiguration _conf;
        public AuthService(IUserService userService, IJWTService jWTService, IConfiguration conf)
        {
            _userService = userService;
            _jWTService = jWTService;
            _conf = conf;
        }
        public async Task<ApiResponse<RegisterResponseDTO>> RegisterAsync(RegisterDTO registerDTO)
        {
            if (registerDTO is null)
                return ApiResponse<RegisterResponseDTO>.Fail("please fill the form");
            var existingUser = await _userService.GetByEmailAsync(registerDTO.Email);
            if (existingUser is not null)
                return ApiResponse<RegisterResponseDTO>.Fail("Email Already Exist");
            ApplicationUser user = new ApplicationUser
            {
                FullName = registerDTO.FullName,
                Email = registerDTO.Email,
                UserName = registerDTO.Email,
                Role = UserRole.Admin

            };
            var Appuser = await _userService.CreateUserAsync(user, registerDTO.Password);
            var res = new RegisterResponseDTO
            {
                UserId = Appuser.Id.ToString(),
                Email = Appuser.Email
            };
            return ApiResponse<RegisterResponseDTO>.SuccessResponse(res, "User registered successfully", 201);
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>> LoginAsync(LoginDTO loginDTO)
        {
            if (loginDTO is null)
                return ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>.Fail("please fill the form");
            var user = await _userService.GetByEmailAsync(loginDTO.Email);
            if (user is null)
                return ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>.Fail("Email or password is not correct");
            bool isCorrect = await _userService.CheckPasswordAsync(user, loginDTO.Password);
            if (!isCorrect)
                return ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>.Fail("Email or password is not correct");
            string token = await _jWTService.GenerateJWTToken(user);

            if (!int.TryParse(_conf["Auth:JWT:DurationInMinuts"], out int minuts))
            {
                minuts = 60;
            }
            var result = new LoginResponseDTO
            {
                AccessToken = token,
                ExpireAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(minuts),
                UserLogin = new UserLoginDTO
                {
                    Id = user.Id.ToString(),
                    FullName = user.FullName,
                    Role = user.Role.ToString()
                }

            };
            return ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>.SuccessResponse(result, "User logged in successfully", 200);

        }
    }
}

    private async Task DeactivateExistingActiveFileAsync(Guid? groupId, Guid uploaderId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {

            ? query.Where(f => f.GroupId == groupId.Value)
