    }

    private async Task<int> BulkInsertCheckPlatesAsync(
        AppDbContext dbContext, Guid checkFileId, List<List<string?>> dataRows, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var table = new DataTable();
        table.Columns.Add("check_file_id", typeof(Guid));
        table.Columns.Add("raw_plate", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("normalized_plate", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("bank_name", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("vehicle_type", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("chassis_number", typeof(string));

        var seen = new HashSet<string>();

        // Query DB for already-existing normalized plates for this check file
        var existingPlates = new HashSet<string>(await dbContext.CheckPlates
            .Where(p => p.CheckFileId == checkFileId)
            .Select(p => p.NormalizedPlate)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken));

        foreach (var row in dataRows)
        {
            if (PlateColumnIndex >= row.Count) continue;
            var rawPlate = row[PlateColumnIndex]?.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate)) continue;

            var normalized = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(rawPlate);
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized) || !seen.Add(normalized)) continue;

            // Skip if this normalized plate already exists in DB for this check file
            if (existingPlates.Contains(normalized)) continue;

            var dr = table.NewRow();
            dr["check_file_id"] = checkFileId;
            dr["raw_plate"] = rawPlate;
            dr["normalized_plate"] = normalized;
            dr["bank_name"] = GetCell(row, BankNameColumnIndex) ?? "ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø­Ø¯Ø¯";
            dr["vehicle_type"] = (object?)GetCell(row, VehicleTypeColumnIndex) ?? DBNull.Value;
            dr["chassis_number"] = (object?)GetCell(row, ChassisNumberColumnIndex) ?? DBNull.Value;
            table.Rows.Add(dr);
        }

        if (table.Rows.Count == 0) return 0;

        var connectionString = _configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")
     ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        await using var connection = new NpgsqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        await using var importer = await connection.BeginBinaryImportAsync(
            "COPY check_plates (check_file_id, raw_plate, normalized_plate, bank_name, vehicle_type, chassis_number) FROM STDIN (FORMAT BINARY)", cancellationToken);
        importer.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120);

        foreach (DataRow row in table.Rows)
        {
            await importer.StartRowAsync(cancellationToken);
            await importer.WriteAsync((Guid)row["check_file_id"], NpgsqlDbType.Uuid, cancellationToken);
            foreach (var column in new[] { "raw_plate", "normalized_plate", "bank_name", "vehicle_type", "chassis_number" })
            {
                if (row[column] is string value)
                    await importer.WriteAsync(value, NpgsqlDbType.Varchar, cancellationToken);
                else
                    await importer.WriteNullAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
        }

        await importer.CompleteAsync(cancellationToken);
        return table.Rows.Count;
    }

    private static string? GetCell(List<string?> row, int index) => index < row.Count ? row[index]?.Trim() : null;

    private async Task<UserScopeInfo?> ResolveUserScopeAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == userId)
            .Select(x => new UserScopeInfo(x.GroupId, x.User.Role))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static System.Linq.Expressions.Expression<Func<CheckFile, bool>> ScopeFilter(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, Guid checkFileId)
    {
        return groupId.HasValue
            ? f => f.Id == checkFileId && f.GroupId == groupId.Value
            : f => f.Id == checkFileId && f.GroupId == null && f.UploadedBy == currentUserId;
    }

    private static string? ValidateUploadedFile(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IFormFile? file)
    {
        if (file is null || file.Length == 0) return "Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªØ±ÙØ¹ Ù…Ù„Ù.";
        if (file.Length > MaxUploadSizeBytes) return $"Ø­Ø¬Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ø£ÙƒØ¨Ø± Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­ ({MaxUploadSizeBytes / 1024 / 1024} MB).";

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(file.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!AllowedExtensions.Contains(extension))
        {
            return $"ØµÙŠØºØ© Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø¯Ø¹ÙˆÙ…Ø©. Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­: {string.Join(", ", AllowedExtensions)}";
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù…Ø© ÙƒÙ…Ø§Ù† Ù…Ù† ReferralJobService (Ù†ÙØ³ Ù…Ù†Ø·Ù‚ Ø§Ù„Ù‚Ø±Ø§Ø¡Ø©ØŒ Ø£Ø¹Ù…Ø¯Ø© Ù…Ø®ØªÙ„ÙØ©).</summary>
    internal static IEnumerable<List<string?>> ReadAllRowsAsStrings(Stream stream, string extension)
    {
        if (extension == ".csv")
        {
            using var textReader = new StreamReader(stream);
            var config = new CsvConfiguration(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            {
                HasHeaderRecord = false,
                MissingFieldFound = null,
                BadDataFound = null
            };
            using var csv = new CsvReader(textReader, config);

            while (csv.Read())
            {
                var record = csv.Parser.Record;
                yield return record?.Select(v => (string?)v).ToList() ?? new List<string?>();
            }

            yield break;
        }

        using var reader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
        while (reader.Read())
        {
            var row = new List<string?>(reader.FieldCount);
            for (var i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
            {
                row.Add(reader.GetValue(i)?.ToString()?.Trim());
            }
            yield return row;
        }
    }

    private record UserScopeInfo(Guid? GroupId, UserRole Role);
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class CheckPlateCacheService : ICheckPlateCacheService
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan CacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromHours(6);
    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;

    public CheckPlateCacheService(IMemoryCache cache, AppDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _cache = cache;
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<bool> IsPlateInActiveCheckFileAsync(
        Guid? groupId, Guid userId, string normalizedPlate, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var key = BuildCacheKey(groupId, userId);

        var plateSet = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(key, async entry =>
        {
            entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = CacheDuration;

            var query = _dbContext.CheckPlates
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(cp => cp.CheckFile.IsActive);

            query = groupId.HasValue
                ? query.Where(cp => cp.CheckFile.GroupId == groupId.Value)
                : query.Where(cp => cp.CheckFile.GroupId == null && cp.CheckFile.UploadedBy == userId);

            var plates = await query.Select(cp => cp.NormalizedPlate).ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
            return new HashSet<string>(plates, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        });

        return plateSet?.Contains(normalizedPlate) ?? false;
    }

    public void InvalidateActiveCheckFileCache(Guid? groupId, Guid userId)
    {
        _cache.Remove(BuildCacheKey(groupId, userId));
    }

    private static string BuildCacheKey(Guid? groupId, Guid userId) =>
        groupId.HasValue ? $"active-check-plates:group:{groupId.Value}" : $"active-check-plates:user:{userId}";
}

    public async Task<ApiResponse<DataFilesListResponseDto>> GetDataFilesAsync(
        Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {

        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<DataFilesListResponseDto>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

            ? query.Where(f => f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value)
            : query.Where(f => f.GroupId == null && f.OwnerId == currentUserId);

        // على نفس الـ list اللي رجعت من الداتابيز، من غير round trips إضافية.

            .OrderBy(f => f.SortOrder)

            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var items = files.Select(f => new DataFileSummaryDto(
                f.Id, f.FileName, f.RowCount, f.IsActiveForFiltering, f.SortOrder,
                f.RequiresPassword, f.OwnerName, f.ImportStatus, f.CreatedAt))
            .ToList();

        var totalRows = files.Sum(f => (long)f.RowCount);
        var currentUserRows = files.Where(f => f.OwnerId == currentUserId).Sum(f => (long)f.RowCount);

        var header = new DataFilesHeaderDto(items.Count, totalRows, currentUserRows, userScope.DisplayName);
        return ApiResponse<DataFilesListResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new DataFilesListResponseDto(header, items));
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<Guid>> CreateDataFileAsync(
        Guid uploaderId, CreateDataFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var validationError = FileHelper.ValidateUploadedFile(request.File, MaxUploadSizeBytes, AllowedExtensions);
        if (validationError != null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected data file upload: {Reason}", validationError);
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail(validationError, null, 400);
        }

        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(uploaderId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

        if (!await _permissions.CanUploadDataFilesAsync(uploaderId, cancellationToken))
        {
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("ليس لديك صلاحية رفع ملفات الداتا.", null, StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden);
        }

        var subFolder = userScope.GroupId.HasValue
            ? $"groups/{userScope.GroupId.Value}"
            : $"users/{uploaderId}";

        await using var stream = request.File.OpenReadStream();
        var storagePath = await _fileStorageService.SaveAsync(stream, request.File.FileName, subFolder: subFolder);

        var nextSortOrder = await GetNextSortOrderAsync(userScope.GroupId, uploaderId, CancellationToken.None);

        var dataFile = new DataFile
        {
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            OwnerId = uploaderId,
            FileName = request.File.FileName,
            RowCount = 0,
            IsActiveForFiltering = false,
            PasswordHash = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Password)
                ? null
                : BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(request.Password),
            StoragePath = storagePath,
            ImportStatus = DataFileImportStatus.Pending,
            SortOrder = nextSortOrder
        };

        await _unit.Repository<DataFile>().AddAsync(dataFile);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("DataFile {DataFileId} created (groupId={GroupId}) by user {UserId}; queuing import job",
            dataFile.Id, userScope.GroupId, uploaderId);

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<DataFileImportJob>(job =>
            job.ImportAsync(dataFile.Id, uploaderId, storagePath, false, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<Guid>.SuccessResponse(dataFile.Id, "الملف اتقبل وبدأ يتعالج في الخلفية.", 201);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> AppendAsync(
        Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, AppendDataFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var validationError = FileHelper.ValidateUploadedFile(request.File, MaxUploadSizeBytes, AllowedExtensions);
        if (validationError is not null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail(validationError);
        }

        var dataFile = await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .AsNoTracking()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(f => f.Id == dataFileId, cancellationToken);

        if (dataFile is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Append attempted on missing DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("الملف غير موجود.", null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
        }

        if (!await _permissions.CanManageDataFileAsync(currentUserId, dataFileId, cancellationToken))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Append denied on DataFile {DataFileId} for user {UserId}", dataFileId, currentUserId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail(NoDataFilePermissionMessage, null, StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden);
        }

        var appendFolder = dataFile.GroupId.HasValue
            ? $"groups/{dataFile.GroupId.Value}/appends/{dataFileId}"
            : $"users/{dataFile.OwnerId}/appends/{dataFileId}";

        await using var stream = request.File.OpenReadStream();
        var appendStoragePath = await _fileStorageService.SaveAsync(
            stream, request.File.FileName, appendFolder, cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation("Append file stored for DataFile {DataFileId} by user {UserId}; queuing import job",
            dataFileId, currentUserId);

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<DataFileImportJob>(job =>
            job.ImportAsync(dataFileId, currentUserId, appendStoragePath, true, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true, "جاري إلحاق البيانات في الخلفية.");
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> ToggleActiveAsync(
        Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var exists = await _dbContext.DataFiles.AsNoTracking().AnyAsync(f => f.Id == dataFileId, cancellationToken);
        if (!exists)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("ToggleActive: DataFile {DataFileId} not found", dataFileId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("الملف غير موجود.", null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
        }

        // تفعيل/إيقاف الملف في الفرز تعديل على الملف — نفس قاعدة التعديل
        if (!await _permissions.CanManageDataFileAsync(currentUserId, dataFileId, cancellationToken))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("ToggleActive denied on DataFile {DataFileId} for user {UserId}", dataFileId, currentUserId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail(NoDataFilePermissionMessage, null, StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden);
        }

        var affected = await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .Where(f => f.Id == dataFileId)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                .SetProperty(f => f.IsActiveForFiltering, f => !f.IsActiveForFiltering),
                cancellationToken);

        if (affected == 0)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("ToggleActive: DataFile {DataFileId} not found", dataFileId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("الملف غير موجود.");
        }

        _logger.LogInformation("DataFile {DataFileId} filtering toggled", dataFileId);
        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> ReorderAsync(
        Guid currentUserId, ReorderDataFilesRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (request.Items.Count == 0)
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("لا يوجد عناصر لإعادة ترتيبها.");
        }

        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

        // المستخدم العادي بيرتّب ملفاته هو بس (المرفوعة بـ CanUploadDataFiles) — الأدمن كل ملفات الجروب
        var ownFilesOnly = userScope.Role == UserRole.User;
        if (ownFilesOnly && !await _permissions.CanUploadDataFilesAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken))
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail(NoDataFilePermissionMessage, null, StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden);
        }

        // UPDATE واحد بـ CASE WHEN بدل ما نعمل round trip منفصل لكل عنصر —
        // نفس النتيجة النهائية، لكن query واحدة بس مهما كان عدد الملفات
        // اللي اتسحبت وترتيبها اتغيّر.
        var sql = new StringBuilder("UPDATE data_files SET sort_order = CASE id ");
        var parameters = new List<object>();

        for (var i = 0; i < request.Items.Count; i++)
        {
            sql.Append($"WHEN @id{i} THEN @order{i} ");
            parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter($"@id{i}", request.Items[i].Id));
            parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter($"@order{i}", request.Items[i].SortOrder));
        }

        sql.Append("ELSE sort_order END WHERE id IN (")
           .Append(string.Join(", ", Enumerable.Range(0, request.Items.Count).Select(i => $"@id{i}")))
           .Append(") AND ");

        if (userScope.GroupId.HasValue)
        {
            sql.Append("group_id = @scopeGroupId");
            parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter("@scopeGroupId", userScope.GroupId.Value));
        }
        else
        {
            sql.Append("group_id IS NULL AND owner_id = @scopeUserId");
            parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter("@scopeUserId", currentUserId));
        }

        if (ownFilesOnly && userScope.GroupId.HasValue)
        {
            sql.Append(" AND owner_id = @ownerId");
            parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter("@ownerId", currentUserId));
        }

        var affected = await _dbContext.Database.ExecuteSqlRawAsync(sql.ToString(), parameters, cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Reordered {Requested} data files ({Affected} rows actually matched scope) for user {UserId} in a single round trip",
            request.Items.Count, affected, currentUserId);

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> DeleteAsync(
        Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {

        var dataFile = await _dbContext.DataFiles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(f => f.Id == dataFileId, cancellationToken);

        if (dataFile is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Delete attempted on missing DataFile {DataFileId} by user {UserId}", dataFileId, currentUserId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("الملف غير موجود.", null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
        }

        if (!await _permissions.CanManageDataFileAsync(currentUserId, dataFileId, cancellationToken))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Delete denied on DataFile {DataFileId} for user {UserId}", dataFileId, currentUserId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail(NoDataFilePermissionMessage, null, StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden);
        }

        dataFile.IsActiveForFiltering = false;
        dataFile.ImportStatus = DataFileImportStatus.Processing;
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("DataFile {DataFileId} marked for deletion; queuing background cleanup", dataFileId);

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<DataFileImportJob>(job =>
            job.DeleteAsync(dataFileId, dataFile.StoragePath, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true, "جاري حذف الملف والبيانات المرتبطة به في الخلفية.");
    }

    public async Task<(Stream Stream, string ContentType, string FileName)> DownloadAsync(
        Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var dataFile = await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .AsNoTracking()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(f => f.Id == dataFileId, cancellationToken);

        if (dataFile is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Download attempted on missing DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);
            throw new KeyNotFoundException("الملف غير موجود.");
        }

        if (!await _permissions.CanManageDataFileAsync(currentUserId, dataFileId, cancellationToken))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(NoDataFilePermissionMessage);
        }

        var stream = await _fileStorageService.OpenReadAsync(dataFile.StoragePath, cancellationToken);
        _logger.LogInformation("DataFile {DataFileId} downloaded", dataFileId);

        return (stream, "application/octet-stream", dataFile.FileName);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<UpdateHistoricalPlateResponseDto>> UpdateHistoricalPlateAsync(
        long historicalPlateId, Guid currentUserId, UpdateHistoricalPlateDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.RawPlate))
        {
            return ApiResponse<UpdateHistoricalPlateResponseDto>.Fail("رقم اللوحة مطلوب.", null, 400);
        }

        var plate = await _dbContext.HistoricalPlates
            .Include(h => h.DataFile)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(h => h.Id == historicalPlateId, cancellationToken);

        if (plate is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<UpdateHistoricalPlateResponseDto>.Fail("اللوحة غير موجودة.", null, 404);
        }

        if (!await _permissions.CanManageDataFileAsync(currentUserId, plate.DataFileId, cancellationToken))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Update denied on HistoricalPlate {HistoricalPlateId} by user {UserId}",
                historicalPlateId, currentUserId);
            return ApiResponse<UpdateHistoricalPlateResponseDto>.Fail(NoDataFilePermissionMessage, null, StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden);
        }

        var normalized = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(dto.RawPlate);

        await using var transaction = await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
        try
        {
            // تعديل حقيقي على الصف نفسه في historical_plates.
            plate.RawPlate = dto.RawPlate.Trim();
            plate.NormalizedPlate = normalized;
            plate.VehicleType = dto.VehicleType;
            plate.District = dto.District;
            plate.Street = dto.Street;
            plate.Location = dto.Location;
            plate.RecordedAt = dto.RecordedAt;
            plate.Notes = dto.Notes;
            plate.RecorderName = dto.RecorderName;

            // مزامنة أي match_results مرتبطة بنفس الصف (Found* fields بس) —
            // من غير عمل عملية فرز جديدة أو تقييم ضد referral_plates.
            var syncedCount = await _dbContext.MatchResults
                .Where(m => m.HistoricalPlateId == historicalPlateId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(m => m.NormalizedPlate, normalized)
                    .SetProperty(m => m.FoundVehicleType, dto.VehicleType)
                    .SetProperty(m => m.FoundDistrict, dto.District)
                    .SetProperty(m => m.FoundStreet, dto.Street)
                    .SetProperty(m => m.Location, dto.Location)
                    .SetProperty(m => m.FoundRecordedAt, dto.RecordedAt),
                    cancellationToken);

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "HistoricalPlate {HistoricalPlateId} updated by user {UserId}; {Count} match_results rows synced (no new matching performed)",
                historicalPlateId, currentUserId, syncedCount);

            return ApiResponse<UpdateHistoricalPlateResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(
                new UpdateHistoricalPlateResponseDto(historicalPlateId, normalized, syncedCount));
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync(cancellationToken);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private async Task<UserScopeInfo?> ResolveUserScopeAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == userId)
            .Select(x => new UserScopeInfo(
                x.GroupId,
                x.GroupName ?? "ملفاتي الشخصية",
                x.User.Role))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static Expression<Func<DataFile, bool>> ScopeFilter(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, Guid dataFileId)
    {
        return groupId.HasValue
            ? f => f.Id == dataFileId && f.GroupId == groupId.Value
            : f => f.Id == dataFileId && f.GroupId == null && f.OwnerId == currentUserId;
    }

    private async Task<int> GetNextSortOrderAsync(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var query = _dbContext.DataFiles.AsNoTracking();

        query = groupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(f => f.GroupId == groupId.Value)
            : query.Where(f => f.GroupId == null && f.OwnerId == currentUserId);

        var maxOrder = await query
            .Select(f => (int?)f.SortOrder)
            .MaxAsync(cancellationToken);

        return (maxOrder ?? 0) + 1;
    }


    private record UserScopeInfo(Guid? GroupId, string DisplayName, UserRole Role);

    private record DataFileRow(
        Guid Id, string FileName, int RowCount, bool IsActiveForFiltering, int SortOrder,
        bool RequiresPassword, string OwnerName, Guid OwnerId, string ImportStatus, DateTime CreatedAt);
}

using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations
{
    public class JWTService : IJWTService
    {
        private readonly IConfiguration  _conf;
        public JWTService(IConfiguration conf)
        {
            _conf = conf;
        }
        public Task<string> GenerateJWTToken(ApplicationUser user)
        {
            var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_conf["Auth:JWT:Key"] ?? "this is my secret key it must be very secure and hidden"));
            var crds = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

            var roleString = user.Role.ToString();

            var clims = new List<Claim>
    {
        new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.FullName ?? string.Empty),
        new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, user.Id.ToString()),
        new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, roleString),
        new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
        new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString())
    };

            // مفيش صلاحيات في الـ token — الـ API بيقراها من الداتابيز في كل طلب (IPermissionService)،
            // والفرونت بيجيبها من GET api/auth/me/permissions.

            if (!int.TryParse(_conf["Auth:JWT:DurationInMinuts"], out int minuts))
            {
                minuts = 60;
            }

            var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
                signingCredentials: crds,
                issuer: _conf["Auth:JWT:Issuer"],
                audience: _conf["Auth:JWT:Audience"],
                expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(minuts),
                claims: clims
            );

            return Task.FromResult(new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token));
        }
    }
}

using Castle.Core.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations
{
    public class LocalFileStorageService : IFileStorageService
    {
        private readonly string _rootPath;
        private readonly ILogger<LocalFileStorageService> _logger;
       

        public LocalFileStorageService(IConfiguration configuration, ILogger<LocalFileStorageService> logger)
        {
            _rootPath = configuration["FileStorage:RootPath"]
                        ?? Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "App_Data", "data-files");
            _logger = logger;
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_rootPath);
        }

        public async Task<string> SaveAsync(Stream content, string suggestedFileName, string subFolder, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var targetFolder = Path.Combine(_rootPath, subFolder);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(targetFolder);

            var extension = Path.GetExtension(suggestedFileName);
            var storedName = $"{Guid.NewGuid():N}{extension}";
            var fullPath = Path.Combine(targetFolder, storedName);

            await using var fileStream = new FileStream(
                fullPath, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, bufferSize: 81920, useAsync: true);
            await content.CopyToAsync(fileStream, cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation("Stored file {OriginalName} at {Path}", suggestedFileName, fullPath);

            return Path.Combine(subFolder, storedName).Replace('\\', '/');
        }

        public Task<Stream> OpenReadAsync(string storagePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fullPath = Path.Combine(_rootPath, storagePath);
            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Requested stored file not found: {Path}", fullPath);
                throw new FileNotFoundException("الملف المطلوب مش موجود في التخزين.", fullPath);
            }

            Stream stream = new FileStream(
                fullPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, bufferSize: 81920, useAsync: true);
            return Task.FromResult(stream);
        }

        public Task DeleteAsync(string storagePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fullPath = Path.Combine(_rootPath, storagePath);
            if (File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                File.Delete(fullPath);
                _logger.LogInformation("Deleted stored file {Path}", fullPath);
            }
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }
    }
}

    private async Task<MapResultDto> PrepareMapResultFromReferralJobAsync(ReferralJob job, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var rows = await _dbContext.MatchResults
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(m => m.ReferralJobId == job.Id)
            .Select(m => new
            {
                m.NormalizedPlate,
                m.FoundVehicleType,
                m.FoundDistrict,
                m.FoundStreet,
                m.Location,
                m.FoundRecordedAt,
                RecorderName = m.HistoricalPlate.RecorderName,
                Notes = m.HistoricalPlate.Notes,
                DatafileName = m.SourceDataFile.FileName
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var httpClient = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("MapsLinkResolver");

        // Ù†Ø­Ù„ ÙƒÙ„ Ù„ÙŠÙ†Ùƒ ÙØ±ÙŠØ¯ Ù…Ø±Ø© ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© Ø¨Ø³ØŒ Ø­ØªÙ‰ Ù„Ùˆ Ø¹Ø´Ø±Ø§Øª Ø§Ù„ØµÙÙˆÙ Ø¨ØªØ´ÙŠØ± Ù„Ù†ÙØ³ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠÙ†Ùƒ.
        var coordsByLink = await LocationLinkHelper.ExtractCoordinatesBatchAsync(

        var rowDtos = rows.Select(r =>
        {
            (double Latitude, double Longitude)? coords = null;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.Location))
            {
                coordsByLink.TryGetValue(r.Location, out coords);
            }

            return new MapResultRowDto(
                r.NormalizedPlate, r.FoundVehicleType, r.FoundDistrict, r.FoundStreet,
                r.Notes, r.FoundRecordedAt, r.RecorderName, r.Location, coords?.Latitude, coords?.Longitude, r.DatafileName);
        }).ToList();

        var carCount = rowDtos.Count(r => r.Latitude.HasValue && r.Longitude.HasValue);
        var unresolvedCount = rowDtos.Count - carCount;

    private static MapResultDto DeserializeMapResult(MapResult cached)
    {
        var rows = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<MapResultRowDto>>(cached.ResultJson) ?? new List<MapResultRowDto>();
        return new MapResultDto(cached.ReferralJobId, cached.CarCount, cached.UnresolvedCount, cached.PreparedAt, rows);
    }

    private async Task SaveMapResultAsync(
        Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, Guid referralJobId, MapResultDto prepared, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var existing = await _dbContext.MapResults
            .Where(m => groupId.HasValue ? m.GroupId == groupId.Value : m.GroupId == null && m.UserId == currentUserId)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (existing is null)
        {
            existing = new MapResult { GroupId = groupId, UserId = currentUserId };
            // await _unit.Repository<MapResult>().AddAsync(existing);
            await _dbContext.MapResults.AddAsync(existing, cancellationToken);

        existing.ReferralJobId = referralJobId;
        existing.ResultJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(prepared.Rows);
        existing.CarCount = prepared.CarCount;
        existing.UnresolvedCount = prepared.UnresolvedCount;
        existing.PreparedAt = prepared.PreparedAt;

        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "MapResult refreshed for workspace (GroupId={GroupId}, UserId={UserId}) from ReferralJob {JobId}: {CarCount} cars, {UnresolvedCount} unresolved",
            groupId, currentUserId, referralJobId, prepared.CarCount, prepared.UnresolvedCount);

    private static MapUploadedFileDto BuildUploadedFileDto(MapUploadedFile file, List<MapUploadedPlateRow> rows)
    {
        var carCount = rows.Count(r => r.Latitude.HasValue && r.Longitude.HasValue);
        var unresolvedCount = rows.Count - carCount;

        var rowDtos = rows.Select(r => new MapUploadedFileRowDto(
            r.Id, r.NormalizedPlate, r.VehicleType, r.District, r.Street, r.Notes, r.RecordedAt,
            r.RecorderName, r.LocationLink, r.Latitude, r.Longitude, r.DataFileName)).ToList();

        return new MapUploadedFileDto(file.Id, file.FileName, file.RowCount, carCount, unresolvedCount, file.UploadedAt, rowDtos);
    }

    // ---------- Ù‚Ø±Ø§Ø¡Ø© Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ø¨Ù€ ClosedXML â€” Ø¨ØªÙØ¶Ù‘Ù„ Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø· Ø§Ù„Ù€ Hyperlink Ø§Ù„Ø­Ù‚ÙŠÙ‚ÙŠ ----------

    // Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø§Ù„Ù†Øµ Ø§Ù„Ø¸Ø§Ù‡Ø± ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ù„ÙŠØ©. Ø¯Ù‡ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ø¨ÙŠØ®Ù„Ù‘ÙŠ Ø¥Ø¹Ø§Ø¯Ø© Ø±ÙØ¹ Ù…Ù„Ù Ø§ØªØµØ¯Ù‘Ø± Ù…Ù† WriteMatchedSheet
    // (Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ø¨ÙŠÙƒØªØ¨ "ÙØªØ­ Ø§Ù„Ù…ÙˆÙ‚Ø¹" ÙƒÙ†Øµ Ø¸Ø§Ù‡Ø± ÙˆÙŠØ­Ø· Ø§Ù„Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø· Ø§Ù„Ø­Ù‚ÙŠÙ‚ÙŠ ÙƒÙ€ hyperlink Ù…Ù†ÙØµÙ„)
    // ÙŠØ±Ø¬Ù‘Ø¹ Ø§Ù„Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø· Ø§Ù„ØµØ­ Ø¨Ø¯Ù„ Ø§Ù„Ù†Øµ.
    private static List<List<string?>> ReadRowsPreservingHyperlinks(Stream stream, int sheetIndex)
    {
        using var workbook = new XLWorkbook(stream);
        var worksheet = sheetIndex >= 0 && sheetIndex < workbook.Worksheets.Count
            ? workbook.Worksheets.ElementAt(sheetIndex)
            : workbook.Worksheets.First();

        var rows = new List<List<string?>>();
        var usedRange = worksheet.RangeUsed();
        if (usedRange is null) return rows;

        var firstRow = usedRange.FirstRow().RowNumber();
        var lastRow = usedRange.LastRow().RowNumber();
        var lastColumn = usedRange.LastColumn().ColumnNumber();

        for (var r = firstRow; r <= lastRow; r++)
        {
            var row = new List<string?>(lastColumn);
            for (var c = 1; c <= lastColumn; c++)
            {
                var cell = worksheet.Cell(r, c);

                string? value;
                if (cell.HasHyperlink && cell.GetHyperlink().ExternalAddress is not null)
                {
                    value = cell.GetHyperlink().ExternalAddress.ToString();
                }
                else
                {
                    var text = cell.GetString();
                    value = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) ? null : text.Trim();
                }

                row.Add(value);
            }
            rows.Add(row);
        }

        return rows;
    }

    private sealed record SheetGroup(string GroupName, List<string?> Headers, List<List<string?>> DataRows);

    private static List<SheetGroup> ParseGroupedSheet(List<List<string?>> allRows)
    {
        var groups = new List<SheetGroup>();
        var i = 0;

        while (i < allRows.Count)
        {
            if (IsGroupTitleRow(allRows[i], out var groupName))
            {
                var headerRowIndex = i + 1;
                if (headerRowIndex >= allRows.Count) break;

                var headers = allRows[headerRowIndex];
                var dataRows = new List<List<string?>>();

                var j = headerRowIndex + 1;
                while (j < allRows.Count && !IsBlankRow(allRows[j]) && !IsGroupTitleRow(allRows[j], out _))
                {
                    dataRows.Add(allRows[j]);
                    j++;
                }

                groups.Add(new SheetGroup(groupName, headers, dataRows));
                i = j + 1; // ØªØ®Ø·Ù‘ÙŠ ØµÙ Ø§Ù„ÙØ§ØµÙ„ Ø§Ù„ÙØ§Ø¶ÙŠ Ù„Ùˆ Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯
            }
            else
            {
                i++;
            }
        }

        return groups;
    }

    private static bool IsGroupTitleRow(List<string?> row, out string groupName)
    {
        groupName = string.Empty;

        var nonEmpty = row.Where(c => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(c)).ToList();
        if (nonEmpty.Count != 1) return false;

        var text = nonEmpty[0]!.Trim();
        if (!text.Contains("ðŸ“"))   return false;

        groupName = text.Replace("ðŸ“", string.Empty).Trim();
        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsBlankRow(List<string?> row) => row.All(c => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(c));

    // ÙˆÙŠØ·Ù„Ù‘Ø¹ Ù…Ù†Ù‡Ø§ RawMapRowØŒ Ù…Ø¹ ÙØµÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø¹Ù…Ø¯Ø© Ø§Ù„Ø«Ø§Ø¨ØªØ© Ø¹Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø¹Ù…Ø¯Ø© Ø§Ù„Ù…ØªØºÙŠØ±Ø©.
    private List<RawMapRow> ExtractRowsFromGroup(List<string?> headerRow, List<List<string?>> dataRows, string? dataFileName)
    {
        var result = new List<RawMapRow>();

        var plateColumn = _columnDetector.DetectPlateColumn(headerRow, dataRows.Take(5));
        if (plateColumn is null) return result; // Ø¬Ø¯ÙˆÙ„ Ù…Ù† ØºÙŠØ± Ø¹Ù…ÙˆØ¯ Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ÙˆØ§Ø¶Ø­ â€” ÙŠØªØ¬Ø§Ù‡Ù„ Ø¨Ù‡Ø¯ÙˆØ¡

        var fixedCols = new HashSet<int>
        {
            cols.PlateCol, cols.VehicleTypeCol, cols.DistrictCol, cols.StreetCol,
            cols.GpsCol, cols.RecordedAtCol, cols.NotesCol, cols.RecorderNameCol
        };

        foreach (var row in dataRows)
        {
            if (cols.PlateCol >= row.Count) continue;
            var rawPlate = row[cols.PlateCol]?.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate)) continue;

            string? Get(int idx) => idx != -1 && idx < row.Count ? row[idx]?.Trim() : null;

            Dictionary<string, string?>? extra = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < headerRow.Count && i < row.Count; i++)
            {
                if (fixedCols.Contains(i)) continue;
                var header = headerRow[i]?.Trim();
                var value = row[i]?.Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) continue;

                extra ??= new Dictionary<string, string?>();
                extra[header] = value;
            }

            result.Add(new RawMapRow(
                rawPlate, Get(cols.VehicleTypeCol), Get(cols.DistrictCol), Get(cols.StreetCol),
                Get(cols.NotesCol), Get(cols.RecorderNameCol), Get(cols.GpsCol), Get(cols.RecordedAtCol),
                extra is null ? null : JsonSerializer.Serialize(extra),
        dataFileName));
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static FixedColumnMap DetectFixedColumns(List<string?> headerRow, int plateColumn)
    {

    public async Task<bool> CanManageDataFileAsync(Guid userId, Guid dataFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

        };

    }

    public async Task<MyPermissionsDto?> GetMyPermissionsAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var access = await GetAccessAsync(userId, cancellationToken);
        if (access is null) return null;

        if (access.Role != UserRole.User)
        {
            return new MyPermissionsDto
            {
                Role = access.Role.ToString(),
                CanManageCheckFiles = true,
                CanUploadDataFiles = true,
                CanSort = true
            };
        }

        var sortableIds = access.CanSort
            ? await _dbContext.UserDataFilePermissions
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(p => p.UserId == userId)
                .Select(p => p.DataFileId)
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken)

        return new MyPermissionsDto
        {
            Role = access.Role.ToString(),
            CanManageCheckFiles = access.CanManageCheckFiles,
            CanUploadDataFiles = access.CanUploadDataFiles,
            CanSort = access.CanSort,
            SortableDataFileIds = sortableIds
        };
    }

    private async Task<UserAccess?> GetAccessAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == userId && x.User.IsActive)
            .Select(x => new UserAccess(
                x.User.Role,
                x.GroupId,
                x.User.UserPermission != null && x.User.UserPermission.CanManageCheckFiles,
                x.User.UserPermission != null && x.User.UserPermission.CanUploadDataFiles,
                x.User.UserPermission != null && x.User.UserPermission.CanSort))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private record UserAccess(
        UserRole Role, Guid? GroupId,
        bool CanManageCheckFiles, bool CanUploadDataFiles, bool CanSort);

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class PlateColumnDetector : IPlateColumnDetector
{

    private static readonly string[] ArabicPlateExplicitKeywords =
    {
        "Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠ", "Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠ", "Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø§Ù„Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠ", "Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø¨Ø§Ù„Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠ",
        "Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠ", "plate number in arabic", "plate in arabic", "arabic plate"
    };

    private static readonly string[] HeaderKeywords =
    {
        "Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©", "Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©", "Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©", "Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø±ÙƒØ¨Ø©", "plate", "license"
    };

    private static readonly Regex PlatePattern =
        new(@"^[A-Za-z\u0621-\u064A]{2,4}[0-9\u0660-\u0669]{3,5}$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

    private const double MinMatchRatio = 0.8;

    public int? DetectPlateColumn(IReadOnlyList<string?> headerRow, IEnumerable<IReadOnlyList<string?>> sampleDataRows)
    {
        // Ø£ÙˆÙ„ÙˆÙŠØ© Ù‚ØµÙˆÙ‰: Ø¹Ù…ÙˆØ¯ Ø¨ÙŠÙ‚ÙˆÙ„ ØµØ±Ø§Ø­Ø© Ø¥Ù†Ù‡ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© "Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠ" â€” Ù„Ùˆ Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ØŒ Ø¨ÙŠÙƒØ³Ø¨ Ø­ØªÙ‰
        // Ù„Ùˆ Ø¹Ù…ÙˆØ¯ ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠ ÙÙŠÙ‡ ÙƒÙ„Ù…Ø© "Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©" Ø¹Ø§Ø¯ÙŠØ© ÙˆØ¬Ø§ÙŠ Ù‚Ø¨Ù„Ù‡ ÙÙŠ ØªØ±ØªÙŠØ¨ Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø¹Ù…Ø¯Ø©.
        var explicitArabicMatch = FindColumnByKeywords(headerRow, ArabicPlateExplicitKeywords);
        if (explicitArabicMatch.HasValue) return explicitArabicMatch;

        var generalMatch = FindColumnByKeywords(headerRow, HeaderKeywords);
        if (generalMatch.HasValue) return generalMatch;

        var samples = sampleDataRows as IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<string?>> ?? sampleDataRows.ToList();
        if (samples.Count == 0) return null;

        var columnCount = samples.Max(r => r.Count);
        var bestColumn = -1;
        var bestRatio = 0.0;

        for (var col = 0; col < columnCount; col++)
        {
            var nonEmpty = 0;
            var matches = 0;

            foreach (var row in samples)
            {
                if (col >= row.Count) continue;
                var value = row[col]?.Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) continue;

                nonEmpty++;
                if (PlatePattern.IsMatch(value)) matches++;
            }

            if (nonEmpty == 0) continue;

            var ratio = (double)matches / nonEmpty;
            if (ratio > bestRatio)
            {
                bestRatio = ratio;
                bestColumn = col;
            }
        }

        return bestRatio >= MinMatchRatio ? bestColumn : null;
    }

    private static int? FindColumnByKeywords(IReadOnlyList<string?> headerRow, string[] keywords)
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < headerRow.Count; i++)
        {
            var header = headerRow[i]?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
            if (header.Length > 0 && keywords.Any(k => header.Contains(k, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> UpdateRowAsync(
      long id, Guid currentUserId, UpdateRecordingArchiveRowDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.RawPlate))
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ù…Ø·Ù„ÙˆØ¨.", null, 400);
        }

            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == id && a.UserId == currentUserId, cancellationToken);

        if (row is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„ØµÙ ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404);

        row.RawPlate = request.RawPlate.Trim();
        row.NormalizedPlate = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(request.RawPlate);
        row.VehicleType = request.VehicleType;
        row.District = request.District;
        row.Street = request.Street;
        row.Notes = request.Notes;
        row.RecorderName = request.RecorderName;

        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

       
        if (request.ApplyDistrictStreetToWholeSession && row.SourceSessionId.HasValue)
        {
            var sessionId = row.SourceSessionId.Value;

            var sessionUpdated = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
                .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId && s.UserId == currentUserId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(s => s.District, request.District)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.Street, request.Street),
                    cancellationToken);

            await _dbContext.RecordedPlates
                .Where(p => p.SessionId == sessionId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(p => p.District, request.District)
                    .SetProperty(p => p.Street, request.Street),
                    cancellationToken);

            await _dbContext.RecordingArchivePlates
                .Where(a => a.SourceSessionId == sessionId && a.UserId == currentUserId && a.Id != id)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(a => a.District, request.District)
                    .SetProperty(a => a.Street, request.Street),
                    cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "District/Street propagated to whole RecordingSession {SessionId} (session row matched: {SessionUpdated}) from archive row {Id} by user {UserId}",
                sessionId, sessionUpdated > 0, id, currentUserId);
        }

        _logger.LogInformation("RecordingArchivePlate {Id} updated by user {UserId}", id, currentUserId);
        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    private static byte[] BuildHistoricalWorkbook(List<RecordingArchivePlate> rows)
    {
        using var workbook = new XLWorkbook();
        var sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add("Ø§Ù„Ø¯Ø§ØªØ§");
        sheet.RightToLeft = true;

        sheet.Cell(1, 1).Value = "Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©";
        sheet.Cell(1, 2).Value = "Ù…Ù„Ø§Ø­Ø¸Ø§Øª";
        sheet.Cell(1, 3).Value = "Ù†ÙˆØ¹ Ø§Ù„Ø³ÙŠØ§Ø±Ø©";
        sheet.Cell(1, 4).Value = "Ø§Ù„Ø´Ø§Ø±Ø¹";
        sheet.Cell(1, 5).Value = "Ø§Ù„Ø­ÙŠ";
        sheet.Cell(1, 6).Value = "GPS";
        sheet.Cell(1, 7).Value = "ØªØ§Ø±ÙŠØ® Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„";
        sheet.Cell(1, 8).Value = "Ø§Ø³Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ø¬Ù‘Ù„";

        var r = 2;
        foreach (var row in rows)
        {
            sheet.Cell(r, 1).Value = row.RawPlate;
            sheet.Cell(r, 2).Value = row.Notes;
            sheet.Cell(r, 3).Value = row.VehicleType;
            sheet.Cell(r, 4).Value = row.Street;
            sheet.Cell(r, 5).Value = row.District;
            sheet.Cell(r, 6).Value = row.Location;
            sheet.Cell(r, 7).Value = row.RecordedAt.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss");
            sheet.Cell(r, 8).Value = row.RecorderName;
            r++;
        }
        sheet.Columns().AdjustToContents();

        using var stream = new MemoryStream();
        workbook.SaveAs(stream);
        return stream.ToArray();
    }

    private async Task<int> GetNextSortOrderAsync(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var query = _dbContext.DataFiles.AsNoTracking();
        query = groupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(f => f.GroupId == groupId.Value)
            : query.Where(f => f.GroupId == null && f.OwnerId == currentUserId);

        var maxOrder = await query.Select(f => (int?)f.SortOrder).MaxAsync(cancellationToken);
        return (maxOrder ?? 0) + 1;
    }

    private async Task<string> GenerateUniqueDisplayNameAsync(
        Guid? groupId, Guid userId, string baseName, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var query = _dbContext.RecordingSessions.AsNoTracking();
        query = groupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(s => s.GroupId == groupId.Value)
            : query.Where(s => s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == userId);

        var existingNames = new HashSet<string>(
            await query.Where(s => s.DisplayName.StartsWith(baseName)).Select(s => s.DisplayName).ToListAsync(cancellationToken));

        if (!existingNames.Contains(baseName)) return baseName;

        var suffix = 1;
        while (existingNames.Contains($"{baseName} ({suffix})")) suffix++;
        return $"{baseName} ({suffix})";
    }

    private async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<RecordedPlateRowDto>>> GetPlatesInternalAsync(

    private async Task<bool> EnsureSessionInScopeAsync(Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return false;

        return await _dbContext.RecordingSessions.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, sessionId), cancellationToken);
    }

    private async Task<UserScopeInfo?> ResolveUserScopeAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == userId)
            .Select(x => new UserScopeInfo(x.GroupId, x.User.FullName))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static System.Linq.Expressions.Expression<Func<RecordingSession, bool>> ScopeFilter(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, Guid sessionId)
    {
        return groupId.HasValue
            ? s => s.Id == sessionId && s.GroupId == groupId.Value
            : s => s.Id == sessionId && s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == currentUserId;
    }

    private async Task<ReferralResultsResponseDto> BuildCombinedResultsAsync(
     List<ReferralJob> jobs, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {

            .SelectMany(j => DeserializeStringList(j.ReferralColumnsJson))
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(m => jobIds.Contains(m.ReferralJobId))
            .Select(m => new

                m.ReferralJobId,
                m.HistoricalPlateId,
                m.NormalizedPlate,
                m.FoundVehicleType,
                m.FoundDistrict,
                m.FoundStreet,
                m.Location,
                m.FoundRecordedAt,
                m.SourceDataFileId,
                SourceFileName = m.SourceDataFile.FileName,
                SortOrder = m.SourceDataFile.SortOrder,
                RawPlate = m.HistoricalPlate.RawPlate,
                Notes = m.HistoricalPlate.Notes,
                RecorderName = m.HistoricalPlate.RecorderName

            .ToList();

        {

                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(p => jobIds.Contains(p.ReferralJobId))
                .Select(p => new { p.ReferralJobId, p.NormalizedPlate, p.ExtraDataJson })
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            foreach (var e in referralExtras)
            {
                extraByJobAndPlate[$"{e.ReferralJobId}|{e.NormalizedPlate}"] = e.ExtraDataJson;
            }
        }

            .ToDictionary(x => x.Key, x => x.Color);

            .GroupBy(r => new { r.SourceDataFileId, r.SourceFileName, r.SortOrder })
            .OrderBy(g => g.Key.SortOrder)

                g.Key.SourceDataFileId,
                g.Key.SourceFileName,
                g.Key.SortOrder,

                    var referralCols = BuildReferralColumns(selectedReferral, extraJson);

                        r.Id, r.HistoricalPlateId, r.NormalizedPlate, r.RawPlate,
                        hasColor ? colorIdx : null,

                }).ToList()))

            selectedHistorical.Select(c => c.ToString()).ToList(),
            selectedReferral,

    public async Task<ApiResponse<InspectReferralFileResponseDto>> InspectUploadAsync(
        IFormFile file, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var validationError = ValidateUploadedFile(file);
        if (validationError is not null) return ApiResponse<InspectReferralFileResponseDto>.Fail(validationError, null, 400);

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(file.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();

        List<ExcelSheetInfo> sheets;
        await using (var stream = file.OpenReadStream())
        {
            sheets = ExcelSheetReader.GetSheetsInfo(stream, extension);
        }

        var sheetDtos = sheets.Select(s =>
        {
            var plateColumn = _columnDetector.DetectPlateColumn(s.Headers, s.SampleRows);
            var (colorHeader, vehicleTypeHeader, modelHeader) = ReferralColumnSuggestor.SuggestDefaults(s.Headers);
            var suggestions = new SuggestedReferralColumnsDto(plateColumn, colorHeader, vehicleTypeHeader, modelHeader);
            return new SheetInfoDto(s.Index, s.Name, s.RowCount, s.Headers, suggestions, s.HeaderRowIndex);
        }).ToList();

        return ApiResponse<InspectReferralFileResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new InspectReferralFileResponseDto(sheetDtos));
    }
    public async Task<ApiResponse<Guid>> CreateFromUploadAsync(
     Guid userId, CreateReferralJobUploadRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var validationError = ValidateUploadedFile(request.File);
        if (validationError is not null) return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail(validationError, null, 400);

        if (request.Sheets is null || request.Sheets.Count == 0)
        {
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªØ®ØªØ§Ø± Sheet ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø§Ù„Ø£Ù‚Ù„ ÙˆØªØ­Ø¯Ø¯ Ø¹Ù…ÙˆØ¯ Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ÙÙŠÙ‡Ø§.", null, 400);
        }

        await using (var stream = request.File.OpenReadStream())
        {
            sheets = ExcelSheetReader.ReadSelectedSheets(stream, extension, allSheets: false, selectedIndexes);
        }

        var plateColumnBySheet = request.Sheets.ToDictionary(s => s.SheetIndex, s => s.PlateColumnIndex);
        var headerRowIndexBySheet = request.Sheets.ToDictionary(s => s.SheetIndex, s => s.HeaderRowIndex);

        foreach (var sheet in sheets)
        {
            if (!plateColumnBySheet.TryGetValue(sheet.Index, out var plateColIdx)) continue;

            var headerRowIdx = headerRowIndexBySheet.TryGetValue(sheet.Index, out var hIdx) ? hIdx : 0;
            if (headerRowIdx < 0 || headerRowIdx >= sheet.Rows.Count)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Invalid header row index {Index} for sheet '{SheetName}' â€” skipping sheet", headerRowIdx, sheet.Name);
                continue;
            }

            var headerRow = sheet.Rows[headerRowIdx];
            if (plateColIdx < 0 || plateColIdx >= headerRow.Count)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Invalid plate column index {Index} for sheet '{SheetName}' â€” skipping sheet", plateColIdx, sheet.Name);
                continue;
            }

            var dataRows = sheet.Rows.Skip(headerRowIdx + 1);

            foreach (var dataRow in dataRows)
            {
                if (plateColIdx >= dataRow.Count) continue;
                var rawPlate = dataRow[plateColIdx]?.Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate)) continue;

                // Ù†Ø®Ø²Ù‘Ù† ÙƒÙ„ Ø£Ø¹Ù…Ø¯Ø© Ø§Ù„ØµÙ Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø®Ø±Ù‰ (Ù…Ø´ Ø¨Ø³ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø®ØªØ§Ø± Ù„Ù„Ø¹Ø±Ø¶) Ø¹Ø´Ø§Ù† Ù„Ùˆ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù…

                Dictionary<string, string?>? extra = null;
                for (var i = 0; i < headerRow.Count && i < dataRow.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (i == plateColIdx) continue;
                    var header = headerRow[i]?.Trim();
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header)) continue;
                    var value = dataRow[i]?.Trim();
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) continue;

                    extra ??= new Dictionary<string, string?>();
                    extra[header] = value;
                }

                rawPlates.Add(new RawReferralPlate(rawPlate, extra is null ? null : JsonSerializer.Serialize(extra)));
            }
        }

        if (rawPlates.Count == 0)
        {
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ù…Ù‚Ø¯Ø±Ù†Ø§Ø´ Ù†Ù„Ø§Ù‚ÙŠ Ø£ÙŠ Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø§Øª ØµØ§Ù„Ø­Ø© ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Sheets Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ø§Ø®ØªØ±ØªÙ‡Ø§.", null, 422);
        }

        return await CreateReferralJobInternalAsync(
            userId, request.FilterType, SourceType.FileUpload, request.File.FileName,
            request.Password, rawPlates, request.SelectedReferralColumns, request.SelectedHistoricalColumns,
            cancellationToken);
    }
    public async Task<ApiResponse<Guid>> CreateFromPasteAsync(
        Guid userId, CreateReferralJobPasteRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

    private async Task<ApiResponse<Guid>> CreateReferralJobInternalAsync(
        Guid userId, FilterType filterType, SourceType sourceType, string? sourceFileName,
        string? password, List<RawReferralPlate> rawPlates,
        List<string>? selectedReferralColumns, List<HistoricalDataColumn>? selectedHistoricalColumns,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userScope = await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == userId)
            .Select(x => new { x.GroupId })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var sortDenied = await _permissions.GetSortDeniedReasonAsync(userId, cancellationToken);
        if (sortDenied is not null) return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail(sortDenied, null, 403);

        var distinctPlates = new Dictionary<string, RawReferralPlate>();
        foreach (var raw in rawPlates)
        {
            var normalized = PlateNormalizer.NormalizeReferralPlate(raw.RawPlate);
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized)) continue;
            distinctPlates.TryAdd(normalized, raw);
        }

        if (distinctPlates.Count == 0)
        {
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ Ø£ÙŠ Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ØµØ§Ù„Ø­Ø© ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù/Ø§Ù„Ù†Øµ.", null, 400);
        }

        var referralJob = new ReferralJob
        {
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            UserId = userId,
            FilterType = filterType,
            SourceType = sourceType,
            SourceFileName = sourceFileName,
            PasswordHash = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password) ? null : BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(password),
            TotalReferralPlates = distinctPlates.Count,
            Status = JobStatus.Processing,
            SelectedHistoricalColumnsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(
                selectedHistoricalColumns is { Count: > 0 } ? selectedHistoricalColumns : Enum.GetValues<HistoricalDataColumn>().ToList()),
            ReferralColumnsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(selectedReferralColumns ?? new List<string>())
        };

        await _unit.Repository<ReferralJob>().AddAsync(referralJob);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        await BulkInsertReferralPlatesAsync(referralJob.Id, distinctPlates, cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "ReferralJob {ReferralJobId} created by user {UserId} ({FilterType}, {Count} distinct plates); queuing matching job",
            referralJob.Id, userId, filterType, distinctPlates.Count);

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ReferralMatchingJob>(job =>
            job.ProcessAsync(referralJob.Id, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<Guid>.SuccessResponse(referralJob.Id, "Ø¨Ø¯Ø£Ù†Ø§ Ù†Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬ Ø§Ù„ÙØ±Ø² ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ù„ÙÙŠØ©.", 202);
    }

    private async Task BulkInsertReferralPlatesAsync(
        Guid referralJobId, Dictionary<string, RawReferralPlate> distinctPlates, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var table = new DataTable();
        table.Columns.Add("referral_job_id", typeof(Guid));
        table.Columns.Add("raw_plate", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("normalized_plate", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("status", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("extra_data_json", typeof(string));

        foreach (var (normalized, raw) in distinctPlates)
        {
            var dr = table.NewRow();
            dr["referral_job_id"] = referralJobId;
            dr["raw_plate"] = raw.RawPlate;
            dr["normalized_plate"] = normalized;
            dr["status"] = nameof(ReferralPlateStatus.Unmatched);
            dr["extra_data_json"] = (object?)raw.ExtraDataJson ?? DBNull.Value;
            table.Rows.Add(dr);
        }

        var connectionString = _configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")
    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        await using var connection = new NpgsqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        await using var importer = await connection.BeginBinaryImportAsync(
            "COPY referral_plates (referral_job_id, raw_plate, normalized_plate, status, extra_data_json) FROM STDIN (FORMAT BINARY)", cancellationToken);
        importer.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120);

        foreach (DataRow row in table.Rows)
        {
            await importer.StartRowAsync(cancellationToken);
            await importer.WriteAsync((Guid)row["referral_job_id"], NpgsqlDbType.Uuid, cancellationToken);
            foreach (var column in new[] { "raw_plate", "normalized_plate", "status", "extra_data_json" })
            {
                if (row[column] is string value)
                    await importer.WriteAsync(value, NpgsqlDbType.Varchar, cancellationToken);
                else
                    await importer.WriteNullAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
        }

        await importer.CompleteAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<UnmatchedPlateRowDto>>> GetUnmatchedResultsAsync(
        Guid referralJobId, Guid currentUserId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var job = await GetJobInScopeAsync(referralJobId, currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (job is null) return ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<UnmatchedPlateRowDto>>.Fail("Ø¹Ù…Ù„ÙŠØ© Ø§Ù„ÙØ±Ø² ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯Ø©.", null, 404);

        var query = _dbContext.ReferralPlates
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(p => p.ReferralJobId == referralJobId && p.Status == ReferralPlateStatus.Unmatched);

        var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(cancellationToken);

        var items = await query
            .OrderBy(p => p.NormalizedPlate)
            .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize)
            .Select(p => new UnmatchedPlateRowDto(p.Id, p.RawPlate, p.NormalizedPlate))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<UnmatchedPlateRowDto>>.SuccessResponse(
            new PagedResultDto<UnmatchedPlateRowDto>(items, totalCount, page, pageSize));
    }

        var toAppend = combinedByPlate.Where(p => existingSet.Add(p.Key)).ToList();

                NormalizedPlate = p.Key,
                BankName = bankName

            await _dbContext.CheckFiles
                .Where(f => f.Id == activeCheckFile.Id)

            "Appended {Count} plates (matched + unmatched) from ReferralJob {ReferralJobId} into CheckFile {CheckFileId} ({Skipped} already existed)",
            toAppend.Count, referralJobId, activeCheckFile.Id, skippedCount);

        return ApiResponse<AppendUnmatchedResultDto>.SuccessResponse(new AppendUnmatchedResultDto(toAppend.Count, skippedCount));
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<ReferralJobSummaryDto>>> GetReferralJobsAsync(
        Guid currentUserId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == currentUserId)
            .Select(x => new { x.GroupId, x.User.Role })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<ReferralJobSummaryDto>>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var query = _dbContext.ReferralJobs.AsNoTracking();
        query = userScope.GroupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(j => j.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value)
            : query.Where(j => j.GroupId == null && j.UserId == currentUserId);

        // Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… Ø§Ù„Ø¹Ø§Ø¯ÙŠ Ø¨ÙŠØ´ÙˆÙ Ø¹Ù…Ù„ÙŠØ§Øª Ø§Ù„ÙØ±Ø² Ø¨ØªØ§Ø¹ØªÙ‡ Ø¨Ø³ (Ø´ÙˆÙ GetJobInScopeAsync)
        if (userScope.Role == UserRole.User)
            query = query.Where(j => j.UserId == currentUserId);

        var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(cancellationToken);

        var items = await query
            .OrderByDescending(j => j.CreatedAt)
            .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize)
            .Select(j => new ReferralJobSummaryDto(
                j.Id, j.FilterType, j.SourceType, j.Status,
                j.TotalReferralPlates, j.SkippedPlatesCount, j.MatchedPlatesCount,
                j.TotalReferralPlates - j.SkippedPlatesCount - j.MatchedPlatesCount,
                j.CreatedAt))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<ReferralJobSummaryDto>>.SuccessResponse(
            new PagedResultDto<ReferralJobSummaryDto>(items, totalCount, page, pageSize));
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<DeleteMatchedPlateResponseDto>> DeleteMatchedPlateAsync(
        Guid referralJobId, long matchResultId, Guid currentUserId, bool deleteFromDataFile, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "MatchResult {MatchResultId} removed from ReferralJob {ReferralJobId} results only (data kept) by user {UserId}",
                matchResultId, referralJobId, currentUserId);

            return ApiResponse<DeleteMatchedPlateResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new DeleteMatchedPlateResponseDto(false));
        }

        // Ù…Ø³Ø­ Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø¯Ø§ØªØ§ Ù†Ù‡Ø§Ø¦ÙŠ â€” Ø§Ù„ØµÙ Ø¨ÙŠØªØ´Ø§Ù„ Ù…Ù† historical_plates + Ø£ÙŠ match_results

                .Where(m => m.HistoricalPlateId == historicalPlateId)
                .ExecuteDeleteAsync(cancellationToken);

            var deletedRows = await _dbContext.HistoricalPlates
                .Where(h => h.Id == historicalPlateId)
                .ExecuteDeleteAsync(cancellationToken);

            if (deletedRows > 0)
            {
                await _dbContext.DataFiles
                    .Where(f => f.Id == dataFileId)
                    .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters.SetProperty(f => f.RowCount, f => f.RowCount - 1), cancellationToken);
            }

            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
        }
        catch
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync(cancellationToken);
            throw;
        }

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "HistoricalPlate {HistoricalPlateId} permanently deleted from DataFile {DataFileId} (triggered from ReferralJob {ReferralJobId}) by user {UserId}",
            historicalPlateId, dataFileId, referralJobId, currentUserId);

    private async Task<ReferralJob?> GetJobInScopeAsync(Guid referralJobId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userScope = await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == currentUserId)
            .Select(x => new { x.GroupId, x.User.Role })

        var ownJobsOnly = userScope.Role == UserRole.User;

                (userScope.GroupId.HasValue ? j.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value : j.GroupId == null && j.UserId == currentUserId) &&

    private async Task<ReferralResultsResponseDto> BuildResultsAsync(ReferralJob job, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var selectedHistorical = DeserializeHistoricalColumns(job.SelectedHistoricalColumnsJson);
        var selectedReferral = DeserializeStringList(job.ReferralColumnsJson);

          var rows = await _dbContext.MatchResults
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(m => m.ReferralJobId == job.Id)
            .Select(m => new
            {
                m.Id,
                m.HistoricalPlateId,
                m.NormalizedPlate,
                m.FoundVehicleType,
                m.FoundDistrict,
                m.FoundStreet,
                m.Location,
                m.FoundRecordedAt,
                m.SourceDataFileId,
                SourceFileName = m.SourceDataFile.FileName,
                SortOrder = m.SourceDataFile.SortOrder,
                RawPlate = m.HistoricalPlate.RawPlate,
                Notes = m.HistoricalPlate.Notes,
                RecorderName = m.HistoricalPlate.RecorderName
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var extraByPlate = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
        if (selectedReferral.Count > 0)
        {
            extraByPlate = await _dbContext.ReferralPlates
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(p => p.ReferralJobId == job.Id)
                .Select(p => new { p.NormalizedPlate, p.ExtraDataJson })
                .ToDictionaryAsync(p => p.NormalizedPlate, p => p.ExtraDataJson, cancellationToken);
        }

        // Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø§Ù„Ù…ØªÙƒØ±Ø±Ø© (ÙÙŠ Ø£ÙƒØªØ± Ù…Ù† ØµÙ) Ø¨ØªØ§Ø®Ø¯ Ù†ÙØ³ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆÙ† Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø·ÙˆÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ù†ØªÙŠØ¬Ø©ØŒ
        // Ø¨ØªØ±ØªÙŠØ¨ Ø£ÙˆÙ„ Ø¸Ù‡ÙˆØ±. Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø§Ù„ÙØ±ÙŠØ¯Ø© ØªÙØ¶Ù„ Ù…Ù† ØºÙŠØ± ØªÙ„ÙˆÙŠÙ†.
        var colorByPlate = rows
            .GroupBy(r => r.NormalizedPlate)
            .Where(g => g.Count() > 1)
            .Select((g, idx) => new { g.Key, Color = idx % ReferralColorPalette.Colors.Count })
            .ToDictionary(x => x.Key, x => x.Color);

        var groups = rows
            .GroupBy(r => new { r.SourceDataFileId, r.SourceFileName, r.SortOrder })
            .OrderBy(g => g.Key.SortOrder)
            .Select(g => new ReferralResultGroupDto(
                g.Key.SourceDataFileId,
                g.Key.SourceFileName,
                g.Key.SortOrder,
                g.OrderBy(r => r.NormalizedPlate).Select(r =>
                {
                    var dataCols = BuildDataColumns(
                        selectedHistorical, r.FoundVehicleType, r.FoundDistrict, r.FoundStreet,
                        r.Location, r.FoundRecordedAt, r.Notes, r.RecorderName);

                    extraByPlate.TryGetValue(r.NormalizedPlate, out var extraJson);
                    var referralCols = BuildReferralColumns(selectedReferral, extraJson);

                    var hasColor = colorByPlate.TryGetValue(r.NormalizedPlate, out var colorIdx);

                    return new ReferralResultRowDto(
                        r.Id, r.HistoricalPlateId, r.NormalizedPlate, r.RawPlate,
                        hasColor ? colorIdx : null,
                        dataCols, referralCols);
                }).ToList()))
            .ToList();

        return new ReferralResultsResponseDto(
            selectedHistorical.Select(c => c.ToString()).ToList(),
            selectedReferral,
            groups);
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string?> BuildDataColumns(
        List<HistoricalDataColumn> selected, string? vehicleType, string? district, string? street,
        string? location, string? recordedAt, string? notes, string? recorderName)
    {
        var dict = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
        foreach (var col in selected)
        {
            dict[col.ToString()] = col switch
            {
                HistoricalDataColumn.VehicleType => vehicleType,
                HistoricalDataColumn.District => district,
                HistoricalDataColumn.Street => street,
                HistoricalDataColumn.Location => location,
                HistoricalDataColumn.RecordedAt => recordedAt,
                HistoricalDataColumn.Notes => notes,
                HistoricalDataColumn.RecorderName => recorderName,
                _ => null
            };
        }
        return dict;
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string?> BuildReferralColumns(List<string> selectedHeaders, string? extraJson)
    {
        var dict = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
        if (selectedHeaders.Count == 0) return dict;

        Dictionary<string, string?>? extra = null;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(extraJson))
        {
            try { extra = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string?>>(extraJson); }
            catch (JsonException) { extra = null; }
        }

        foreach (var header in selectedHeaders)
        {
            dict[header] = extra != null && extra.TryGetValue(header, out var v) ? v : null;
        }
        return dict;
    }

    private static List<HistoricalDataColumn> DeserializeHistoricalColumns(string? json)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json)) return Enum.GetValues<HistoricalDataColumn>().ToList();
        try
        {
            var names = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(json) ?? new();
            var parsed = names
                .Select(n => Enum.TryParse<HistoricalDataColumn>(n, out var v) ? v : (HistoricalDataColumn?)null)
                .Where(v => v.HasValue)
                .Select(v => v!.Value)
                .ToList();
            return parsed.Count > 0 ? parsed : Enum.GetValues<HistoricalDataColumn>().ToList();
        }
        catch (JsonException) { return Enum.GetValues<HistoricalDataColumn>().ToList(); }
    }

    private static List<string> DeserializeStringList(string? json)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json)) return new List<string>();
        try { return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(json) ?? new List<string>(); }
        catch (JsonException) { return new List<string>(); }
    }

    private static string HistoricalColumnLabel(string columnName) => columnName switch
    {
        nameof(HistoricalDataColumn.VehicleType) => "Ù†ÙˆØ¹ Ø§Ù„Ø³ÙŠØ§Ø±Ø©",
