        nameof(HistoricalDataColumn.RecordedAt) => "ØªØ§Ø±ÙŠØ® Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„",
        nameof(HistoricalDataColumn.Notes) => "Ù…Ù„Ø§Ø­Ø¸Ø§Øª",
        nameof(HistoricalDataColumn.RecorderName) => "Ø§Ø³Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ø¬Ù‘Ù„",
        _ => columnName
    };

    private static readonly string[] GroupBannerColors = { "2F5496", "C55A11", "548235", "7030A0", "BF8F00", "1F4E78" };
    private static readonly string[] GroupHeaderColors = { "1F3864", "833C00", "375623", "4C1F6D", "806000", "0F2A44" };
    private static void WriteMatchedSheet(XLWorkbook workbook, string sheetName, ReferralResultsResponseDto data)
    {
        var sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(sheetName);
        sheet.RightToLeft = true;

        var historicalHeaders = data.SelectedHistoricalColumns.Select(HistoricalColumnLabel).ToList();
        var referralHeaders = data.SelectedReferralColumns;
        var totalCols = 1 + historicalHeaders.Count + referralHeaders.Count;
        var locationColIndex = data.SelectedHistoricalColumns.IndexOf(nameof(HistoricalDataColumn.Location));

        var row = 1;
        var groupIndex = 0;

        foreach (var group in data.Groups)
        {
            var bannerColor = XLColor.FromHtml("#" + GroupBannerColors[groupIndex % GroupBannerColors.Length]);
            var headerColor = XLColor.FromHtml("#" + GroupHeaderColors[groupIndex % GroupHeaderColors.Length]);
            groupIndex++;

            var titleCell = sheet.Cell(row, 1);
            titleCell.Value = $"ðŸ“ {group.DataFileName}";
            titleCell.Style.Font.Bold = true;
            titleCell.Style.Font.FontSize = 13;
            titleCell.Style.Font.FontColor = XLColor.White;
            titleCell.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = bannerColor;
            titleCell.Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
            titleCell.Style.Alignment.Vertical = XLAlignmentVerticalValues.Center;
            if (totalCols > 1) sheet.Range(row, 1, row, totalCols).Merge();
            sheet.Row(row).Height = 24;
            row++;

            var headerRow = row;
            sheet.Cell(headerRow, 1).Value = "Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©";
            var headerCol = 2;
            foreach (var h in historicalHeaders) sheet.Cell(headerRow, headerCol++).Value = h;
            foreach (var h in referralHeaders) sheet.Cell(headerRow, headerCol++).Value = h;

            var headerRange = sheet.Range(headerRow, 1, headerRow, totalCols);
            headerRange.Style.Font.Bold = true;
            headerRange.Style.Font.FontColor = XLColor.White;
            headerRange.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = XLColor.FromHtml("#" + GroupHeaderColors[groupIndex % GroupHeaderColors.Length]); headerRange.Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
            headerRange.Style.Alignment.Vertical = XLAlignmentVerticalValues.Center;
            headerRange.Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
            headerRange.Style.Border.InsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
            sheet.Row(headerRow).Height = 20;
            row++;

            var firstDataRow = row;

            foreach (var r in group.Rows)
            {
                var plateCell = sheet.Cell(row, 1);
                plateCell.Value = r.NormalizedPlate;
                plateCell.Style.Font.Bold = true;
                plateCell.Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
                plateCell.Style.Alignment.Vertical = XLAlignmentVerticalValues.Center;
                if (r.ColorIndex.HasValue)
                {
                    plateCell.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = XLColor.FromHtml("#" + ReferralColorPalette.Colors[r.ColorIndex.Value]);
                }

                var col = 2;
                foreach (var key in data.SelectedHistoricalColumns)
                {
                    var cell = sheet.Cell(row, col);
                    var value = r.DataColumns.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v : null;
                    cell.Value = value;
                    cell.Style.Alignment.Vertical = XLAlignmentVerticalValues.Center;

                    if (key == nameof(HistoricalDataColumn.Location) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)
                        && Uri.TryCreate(value, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
                    {
                        cell.Value = "ÙØªØ­ Ø§Ù„Ù…ÙˆÙ‚Ø¹";
                        cell.SetHyperlink(new XLHyperlink(uri.AbsoluteUri));
                        cell.Style.Font.FontColor = XLColor.FromHtml("#0563C1");
                        cell.Style.Font.Underline = XLFontUnderlineValues.Single;
                        cell.Style.Alignment.Horizontal = XLAlignmentHorizontalValues.Center;
                    }

                    if (r.ColorIndex.HasValue)
                    {
                        cell.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = XLColor.FromHtml("#" + ReferralColorPalette.Colors[r.ColorIndex.Value]);
                    }
                    col++;
                }

                foreach (var key in referralHeaders)
                {
                    var cell = sheet.Cell(row, col);
                    cell.Value = r.ReferralColumns.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v : null;
                    cell.Style.Fill.BackgroundColor = XLColor.FromHtml("#" + ReferralColorPalette.ReferralColumnBackground);
                    cell.Style.Alignment.Vertical = XLAlignmentVerticalValues.Center;
                    col++;
                }
                row++;
            }

            if (row > firstDataRow)
            {
                var dataRange = sheet.Range(firstDataRow, 1, row - 1, totalCols);
                dataRange.Style.Border.OutsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Thin;
                dataRange.Style.Border.InsideBorder = XLBorderStyleValues.Hair;
            }

            row++; 
        }

        sheet.Columns().AdjustToContents();

        if (locationColIndex >= 0)
        {
            sheet.Column(2 + locationColIndex).Width = 14;
        }

        sheet.Column(1).Width = Math.Max(sheet.Column(1).Width, 14);
        sheet.SheetView.FreezeColumns(1); 
    }

    private static void WriteUnmatchedSheet(XLWorkbook workbook, string sheetName, List<(string RawPlate, string NormalizedPlate)> rows)
    {
        var sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(sheetName);
        sheet.RightToLeft = true;

        sheet.Cell(1, 1).Value = "Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ÙƒÙ…Ø§ Ø£ÙØ¯Ø®Ù„Øª";
        sheet.Cell(1, 2).Value = "Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ Ø§Ù„ØªØ·Ø¨ÙŠØ¹";

        var r = 2;
        foreach (var row in rows)
        {
            sheet.Cell(r, 1).Value = row.RawPlate;
            sheet.Cell(r, 2).Value = row.NormalizedPlate;
            r++;
        }
        sheet.Columns().AdjustToContents();
    }

    private static string? ValidateUploadedFile(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IFormFile? file)
    {
        if (file is null || file.Length == 0) return "Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªØ±ÙØ¹ Ù…Ù„Ù.";
        if (file.Length > MaxUploadSizeBytes) return $"Ø­Ø¬Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ø£ÙƒØ¨Ø± Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­ ({MaxUploadSizeBytes / 1024 / 1024} MB).";

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(file.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!AllowedExtensions.Contains(extension))
        {
            return $"ØµÙŠØºØ© Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø¯Ø¹ÙˆÙ…Ø©. Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­: {string.Join(", ", AllowedExtensions)}";
        }

        return null;
    }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>> CreateAdminAsync(CreateAdminDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            if (await _userService.GetByEmailAsync(dto.Email) is not null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateAdmin rejected: email {Email} already taken", dto.Email);
                return ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>.Fail("Email is already taken.");
            }

            var admin = new ApplicationUser
            {
                FullName = dto.FullName,
                UserName = dto.Email,
                Email = dto.Email,
                Role = UserRole.Admin,
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            // UserManager handles password hashing, security stamp, normalized
            // username/email — never insert a user manually through the context.
            var adminUser = await _userService.CreateUserAsync(admin, dto.Password);
            if (adminUser is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateAdmin failed for {Email}: User creation unsuccessful", dto.Email);
                return ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>.Fail("Failed to create admin user.");
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} ({Username}) created", admin.Id, admin.UserName);

            return ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new AdminResponseDto
            {
                Id = admin.Id,
                FullName = admin.FullName,
                Email = admin.Email!,
                IsActive = admin.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = admin.CreatedAt
            });
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<AdminResponseDto>>> GetAdminsAsync(PaginationParams pagination, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            
            var query = _context.Users
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(u => u.Role == UserRole.Admin);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pagination.SearchTerm))
            {
                var term = pagination.SearchTerm.Trim();
                query = query.Where(u =>
                    u.FullName.ToLower().Contains(term.ToLower()) ||
                   
                    u.Email!.ToLower().Contains(term.ToLower()));
            }

            var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(ct);
            var items = await query
                .OrderByDescending(u => u.CreatedAt)
                .Skip((pagination.PageNumber - 1) * pagination.PageSize)
                .Take(pagination.PageSize)
                .Select(u => new AdminResponseDto
                {
                    Id = u.Id,
                    FullName = u.FullName,
                    Email = u.Email!,
                    IsActive = u.IsActive,
                    CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,
                    AdministeredGroupId = u.AdministeredGroup != null ? u.AdministeredGroup.Id : (Guid?)null,
                    AdministeredGroupName = u.AdministeredGroup != null ? u.AdministeredGroup.Name : null
                })
                .ToListAsync(ct);

            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<AdminResponseDto>>.SuccessResponse(new PagedResult<AdminResponseDto>
            {
                Items = items,
                TotalCount = totalCount,
                PageNumber = pagination.PageNumber,
                PageSize = pagination.PageSize
            });
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>> CreateGroupAsync(CreateGroupDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            var admin = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == dto.AdminId && u.Role == UserRole.Admin, ct);

            if (admin is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateGroup rejected: AdminId {AdminId} is not a valid Admin", dto.AdminId);
                return ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>.Fail("The selected user is not a valid Admin.", null, 400);
            }

            var alreadyAdministers = await _context.Groups.AsNoTracking()
                .AnyAsync(g => g.AdminId == dto.AdminId && g.IsActive, ct);

            if (alreadyAdministers)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateGroup rejected: Admin {AdminId} already administers an active group", dto.AdminId);
                return ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>.Fail("This admin already administers an active group.", null, 409);
            }

            var group = new Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels.Group
            {
                Name = dto.Name,
                AdminId = dto.AdminId,
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            await _unitOfWork.Repository<Group>().AddAsync(group);
            await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

            _logger.LogInformation("Group {GroupId} ({GroupName}) created with Admin {AdminId}", group.Id, group.Name, group.AdminId);

            return ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new GroupResponseDto
            {
                Id = group.Id,
                Name = group.Name,
                IsActive = group.IsActive,
                AdminId = group.AdminId,
                AdminName = admin.FullName,
                MembersCount = 0,
                CreatedAt = group.CreatedAt
            });
        }

        {

                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == dto.AdminId && u.Role == UserRole.Admin, ct);

        public async Task<ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>> CreateUserAsync(CreateUserDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            if (await _userService.GetByEmailAsync(dto.Email) is not null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateUser rejected: email {Email} already taken", dto.Email);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("Email is already taken.", null, 409);
            }

            if (dto.GroupId.HasValue)
            {
                var groupExists = await _context.Groups.AsNoTracking()
                    .AnyAsync(g => g.Id == dto.GroupId.Value && g.IsActive, ct);

                if (!groupExists)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("CreateUser rejected: GroupId {GroupId} not found/inactive", dto.GroupId);
                    return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("Group not found or inactive.", null, 400);
                }
            }

            var user = new ApplicationUser
            {
                FullName = dto.FullName,
                Email = dto.Email,
                Role = UserRole.User,
                IsActive = true,
                UserName=dto.Email,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                GroupId = dto.GroupId
            };

            var newUser = await _userService.CreateUserAsync(user, dto.Password);
            if (newUser is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateUser failed for {Email}: Failed to create user.", dto.Email);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("Failed to create user.", null, 400);
            }


            //var permission = new UserPermission { UserId = user.Id };
            var permission = dto.Permissions is not null ? new UserPermission { UserId = user.Id,
                CanManageCheckFiles = dto.Permissions.CanManageCheckFiles,
                CanUploadDataFiles = dto.Permissions.CanUploadDataFiles,
                CanSort = dto.Permissions.CanSort
            } : new UserPermission { UserId = user.Id };

            await _unitOfWork.Repository<UserPermission>().AddAsync(permission);
            await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

            _logger.LogInformation("User {UserId} ({Username}) created, GroupId={GroupId}", user.Id, user.UserName, dto.GroupId);

            string? groupName = dto.GroupId.HasValue
                ? await _context.Groups.AsNoTracking().Where(g => g.Id == dto.GroupId.Value).Select(g => g.Name).FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct)
                : null;

            return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new UserResponseDto
            {
                Id = user.Id,
                FullName = user.FullName,
                Email = user.Email!,
                IsActive = user.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = user.CreatedAt,
                GroupId = user.GroupId,
                GroupName = groupName
            });
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>> AssignUserToGroupAsync(Guid userId, AssignUserToGroupDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
           
            var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(userId.ToString());
            if (user is null || user.Role != UserRole.User)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("AssignUserToGroup failed: User {UserId} not found", userId);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("User not found.", null, 404);
            }

            var groupExists = await _context.Groups.AsNoTracking()
                .AnyAsync(g => g.Id == dto.GroupId && g.IsActive, ct);

            if (!groupExists)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("AssignUserToGroup rejected: GroupId {GroupId} not found/inactive", dto.GroupId);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("Group not found or inactive.", null, 400);
            }

            var previousGroupId = user.GroupId;
            user.GroupId = dto.GroupId;
            await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

            // أذونات الفرز كانت على ملفات الجروب القديم
            if (previousGroupId != dto.GroupId)
                await _context.UserDataFilePermissions.Where(p => p.UserId == userId).ExecuteDeleteAsync(ct);

            _logger.LogInformation("User {UserId} moved from Group {OldGroupId} to Group {NewGroupId}", userId, previousGroupId, dto.GroupId);

            return await GetUserByIdAsync(userId, ct);
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>> RemoveUserFromGroupAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
          
            var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(userId.ToString());
            if (user is null || user.Role != UserRole.User)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("RemoveUserFromGroup failed: User {UserId} not found", userId);

    private static double X0(Letter l) => Math.Min(l.StartBaseLine.X, l.EndBaseLine.X);
    private static double X1(Letter l) => Math.Max(l.StartBaseLine.X, l.EndBaseLine.X);

    // ØªØ¬Ù…ÙŠØ¹ Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø±ÙˆÙ Ø¥Ù„Ù‰ ÙƒØªÙ„ Ø£ÙÙ‚ÙŠØ© Ù…ØªØ¬Ø§ÙˆØ±Ø© (Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„ÙŠÙ…ÙŠÙ† Ù„Ù„ÙŠØ³Ø§Ø±)
    private static List<List<Letter>> Cluster(IEnumerable<Letter> letters, double gap)
    {
        var clusters = new List<List<Letter>>();
        double minX0 = 0;
        foreach (var l in letters.OrderByDescending(X1))
        {
            if (clusters.Count > 0 && minX0 - X1(l) < gap)
            {
                clusters[^1].Add(l);
                minX0 = Math.Min(minX0, X0(l));
            }
            else
            {
                clusters.Add(new List<Letter> { l });
                minX0 = X0(l);
            }
        }
        return clusters;
    }

    private static CertLayout ReadSijilLayout(byte[] pdfBytes)
    {
        using var doc = PdfDocument.Open(pdfBytes);
        var page = doc.GetPage(1);
        double W = page.Width, H = page.Height;
        var words = page.GetWords().ToList();

        string? Find(string pattern) =>
            words.Select(w => Regex.Match(w.Text, pattern)).FirstOrDefault(m => m.Success)?.Value;

        var certNo = Find(@"REPO-\d{3}-\d{8}");
        var cells = new Dictionary<string, CertCell>();

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Ø®Ù„ÙŠØ© "Ø§Ø³Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø¤Ø¬Ø±": Ø¨Ù†Ø«Ø¨Ù‘Øª Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø§Ù„Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„ÙˆØ·Ù†ÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù…ÙˆØ­Ø¯ (700â€¦) Ø£Ùˆ Ø§Ù„Ø³Ø¬Ù„ Ø§Ù„ØªØ¬Ø§Ø±ÙŠ (101â€¦)
        // ÙˆØ§Ù„Ø§Ø³Ù… Ø¨ÙŠÙƒÙˆÙ† ÙÙˆÙ‚Ù‡Ù… Ù…Ø¨Ø§Ø´Ø±Ø©ØŒ Ù‚Ø¨Ù„ Ø¹Ù†ÙˆØ§Ù† "Ø§Ø³Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø¤Ø¬Ø±:" Ø§Ù„ÙˆØ§Ù‚Ø¹ ÙÙŠ Ø£Ù‚ØµÙ‰ Ø§Ù„ÙŠÙ…ÙŠÙ†.
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        var unifiedNoWord = words.FirstOrDefault(w => Regex.IsMatch(w.Text, @"700\d{7}"));
        var crWord = words.FirstOrDefault(w => Regex.IsMatch(w.Text, @"101\d{7}"));
        if (unifiedNoWord != null || crWord != null)
        {
            var anchor = crWord ?? unifiedNoWord!;
            double refY = anchor.BoundingBox.Top;
            cells["lessor"] = new CertCell("lessor", W * 0.60, W * 0.78, refY + 26, refY + 7);
        }

        var vinWord = words.FirstOrDefault(w =>
        {
            var m = Regex.Match(w.Text, @"(?<![A-Z0-9])[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}(?![A-Z0-9])");
            return m.Success && m.Value.Any(char.IsLetter) && m.Value.Any(char.IsDigit);
        });

        if (vinWord == null)
            return new CertLayout(W, H, certNo, null, null, 0, cells);

        var vin = Regex.Match(vinWord.Text, @"[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}").Value;

        var asset = page.Letters.Where(l => l.Value != " " &&
                                            l.StartBaseLine.Y > vinBase - 6 && l.StartBaseLine.Y < vinBase + 55).ToList();
        var rows = new List<List<Letter>>();
        foreach (var l in asset.OrderByDescending(l => l.StartBaseLine.Y))
        {
            var row = rows.FirstOrDefault(r => Math.Abs(r[0].StartBaseLine.Y - l.StartBaseLine.Y) < 4);
            if (row == null) rows.Add(new List<Letter> { l }); else row.Add(l);
        }

        // Ø§Ù„ØµÙ 0: Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠ | Ø§Ù„Ù…ØµÙ†Ø¹    Ø§Ù„ØµÙ 1: Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ø¥Ù†Ø¬Ù„ÙŠØ²ÙŠ | Ø§Ù„Ù…ÙˆØ¯ÙŠÙ„    Ø§Ù„ØµÙ 2: Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆÙ† | VIN
        string?[,] map = { { "plate", "make" }, { "english_plate", "model" }, { "color", null } };
        string? plateDigits = null;
        string? englishPlateLetters = null;
        int plateGlyphs = 0;

        for (int ri = 0; ri < rows.Count && ri < 3; ri++)
        {
            var row = rows[ri];
            double baseY = row.Average(l => l.StartBaseLine.Y);
            double size = row.Select(l => l.PointSize).Where(s => s > 0).DefaultIfEmpty(8).Average();
            double topPdf = baseY + 1.25 * size, botPdf = baseY - 0.55 * size;

            for (int half = 0; half < 2; half++)
            {
                var key = map[ri, half];
                if (key == null) continue;

                var hl = row.Where(l => (half == 0) == ((X0(l) + X1(l)) / 2 < W / 2)).ToList();
                if (hl.Count == 0) continue;

                if (key == "plate")
                {
                    var digits = hl.Where(l => l.Value.Length == 1 && char.IsAsciiDigit(l.Value[0])).OrderBy(X0).ToList();

                    var nonDigits = hl.Except(digits).ToList();

                    if (clusters.Count < 2) continue;

                    var valueLetters = clusters.Skip(1).SelectMany(c => c).ToList();
                    plateGlyphs = valueLetters.Count;

                    double minX = valueLetters.Min(X0);
                    if (digits.Count > 0)
                    {
                        double maxDigitX = digits.Max(X1);
                        minX = Math.Max(minX - 2, maxDigitX + 1.5);
                    }
                    cells[key] = new CertCell(key, minX, valueLetters.Max(X1) + 4, topPdf, botPdf);
                }
                else if (key == "english_plate")
                {
                    // Ø§Ù„ØªØ±ØªÙŠØ¨ Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„ÙŠÙ…ÙŠÙ† Ù„Ù„ÙŠØ³Ø§Ø± Ù„ÙŠØ·Ø§Ø¨Ù‚ Ø§ØªØ¬Ø§Ù‡ Ù‚Ø±Ø§Ø¡Ø© Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø±ÙˆÙ Ø§Ù„Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠØ© ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©
                    var engLetters = hl.Where(l => l.Value.Length == 1 && char.IsAsciiLetter(l.Value[0]))
                                       .OrderByDescending(X0)
                                       .Select(l => l.Value[0])
                                       .ToArray();
                    if (engLetters.Length > 0) englishPlateLetters = new string(engLetters);
                }
                else if (key == "color")
                {
                    double minX = Math.Max(0, hl.Min(X0) - 15);
                    double maxX = hl.Max(X1) + 15;
                    cells[key] = new CertCell(key, minX, maxX, topPdf, botPdf);
                }
                else
                {
                    var clusters = Cluster(hl, 10);
                    if (clusters.Count < 2) continue;

                    var valueLetters = clusters.Skip(1).SelectMany(c => c).ToList();
                    cells[key] = new CertCell(key, valueLetters.Min(X0) - 5, valueLetters.Max(X1) + 5, topPdf, botPdf);
                }
            }
        }

        return new CertLayout(W, H, certNo, vin, plateDigits, plateGlyphs, cells, englishPlateLetters);
    }

    private Decision RunOcr(
        TesseractEngine engine, SKBitmap bmp, double sx, double sy, CertLayout lay,
        string key, bool isPlate, int? mustLen, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (!lay.Cells.TryGetValue(key, out var c)) return Decision.Empty;

        var results = new List<(string Text, double Conf)>();
        var psms = isPlate
            ? new[] { PageSegMode.SingleLine, PageSegMode.SingleBlock }
            : new[] { PageSegMode.SingleLine, PageSegMode.SingleWord };

        engine.SetVariable("tessedit_char_whitelist", isPlate ? PlateAlphabet : "");
        int total = 0;

        foreach (var pad in new[] { 3.0, 5.0 })
        {
            foreach (var scale in new[] { 2, 3 })
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                int l = (int)Math.Max(0, (c.X0 - pad) * sx);
                int r = (int)Math.Min(bmp.Width, (c.X1 + pad) * sx);
                int t = (int)Math.Max(0, (lay.PageH - c.TopPdf - pad) * sy);
                int b = (int)Math.Min(bmp.Height, (lay.PageH - c.BotPdf + pad) * sy);

                var png = MakeCrop(bmp, l, t, r, b, scale);
                using var pix = Pix.LoadFromMemory(png);

                foreach (var psm in psms)
                {
                    total++;
                    using var tp = engine.Process(pix, psm);
                    var text = Clean(tp.GetText(), isPlate);
                    if (text.Length > 0 && (mustLen == null || text.Length == mustLen))
                        results.Add((text, tp.GetMeanConfidence()));
                }
            }
        }

        return Vote(results, total);
    }

    private static byte[] MakeCrop(SKBitmap src, int l, int t, int r, int b, int scale)
    {
        const int border = 30;
        int w = Math.Max(1, r - l), h = Math.Max(1, b - t);
        using var dst = new SKBitmap(w * scale + 2 * border, h * scale + 2 * border);
        using var canvas = new SKCanvas(dst);
        canvas.Clear(SKColors.White);
        using var paint = new SKPaint { IsAntialias = true };
        canvas.DrawBitmap(src, new SKRect(l, t, r, b),
                          new SKRect(border, border, border + w * scale, border + h * scale), paint);
        using var img = SKImage.FromBitmap(dst);
        using var data = img.Encode(SKEncodedImageFormat.Png, 100);
        return data.ToArray();
    }

    private static string Clean(string s, bool plate)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var ch in s)
        {
            if (ch >= '\u0621' && ch <= '\u064A' && ch != '\u0640') sb.Append(ch);
            else if (!plate && char.IsWhiteSpace(ch)) sb.Append(' ');
        }
        var t = Regex.Replace(sb.ToString(), @"\s+", " ").Trim();
        return plate ? t.Replace('Ø£', 'Ø§').Replace('Ø¥', 'Ø§').Replace('Ø¢', 'Ø§') : t;
    }

    private static Decision Vote(List<(string Text, double Conf)> r, int total)
    {
        if (r.Count == 0) return new Decision("", 0, total, 0);
        var best = r.GroupBy(x => x.Text)
                    .Select(g => new { g.Key, N = g.Count(), C = g.Average(x => x.Conf) })
                    .OrderByDescending(x => x.N).ThenByDescending(x => x.C).First();
        return new Decision(best.Key, best.N, total, best.C);
    }

    // =====================================================================
    //  Lexicon snapping (Ù…Ø´ØªØ±Ùƒ Ø¨ÙŠÙ† Ø§Ù„Ù†ÙˆØ¹ÙŠÙ†)
    // =====================================================================
    private static string NormAr(string s) =>
        s.Replace('Ø£', 'Ø§').Replace('Ø¥', 'Ø§').Replace('Ø¢', 'Ø§').Replace('Ù‰', 'ÙŠ').Replace('Ø©', 'Ù‡');

    private static int Lev(string a, string b)
    {
        var d = new int[a.Length + 1, b.Length + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= a.Length; i++) d[i, 0] = i;
        for (int j = 0; j <= b.Length; j++) d[0, j] = j;
        for (int i = 1; i <= a.Length; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= b.Length; j++)
                d[i, j] = Math.Min(Math.Min(d[i - 1, j] + 1, d[i, j - 1] + 1),
                                   d[i - 1, j - 1] + (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1));
        return d[a.Length, b.Length];
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// (1) Ø§Ø­ØªÙˆØ§Ø¡ ÙƒÙ€ token Ù…Ø³ØªÙ‚Ù„ (Ø§Ù„Ø£Ø·ÙˆÙ„ Ø£ÙˆÙ„Ø§Ù‹)  (2) Levenshtein Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø§Ù„Ù†Øµ ÙƒÙ„Ù‡  (3) Levenshtein Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ ÙƒÙ„ ÙƒÙ„Ù…Ø©.
    /// ÙƒÙ„ Ù…Ø±Ø­Ù„Ø© Ø¨ØªØ­ØªØ±Ù… Ø­Ø¯Ù‘Ù‡Ø§ ÙÙ‚Ø· (Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ ØªØ³Ø±ÙŠØ¨ Ø¨ÙŠÙ† Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø±Ø§Ø­Ù„).
    /// </summary>
    private static (string Value, bool Snapped) Snap(string text, string[] lexicon)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)) return (text, false);

        string cleaned = StripHeaderPrefixes(text);
        string n = NormAr(cleaned);
        var sorted = lexicon.OrderByDescending(c => c.Length).ToList();

        foreach (var cand in sorted)
        {
            if (Regex.IsMatch(n, $@"(^|\s){Regex.Escape(NormAr(cand))}(\s|$)"))
                return (cand, true);
        }

        string? best = null;
        int bestD = int.MaxValue;
        foreach (var cand in sorted)
        {
            var dd = Lev(n, NormAr(cand));
            if (dd < bestD) { bestD = dd; best = cand; }
        }
        int allowed = n.Length >= 8 ? 2 : n.Length >= 4 ? 1 : 0;
        if (best != null && bestD <= allowed) return (best, true);

        var words = n.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        string? tokenBest = null;
        int tokenBestD = int.MaxValue;
        foreach (var cand in sorted)
        {
            string normCand = NormAr(cand);
            int candAllowed = normCand.Length >= 5 ? 1 : 0;
            foreach (var w in words)
            {
                int d = Lev(w, normCand);
                if (d <= candAllowed && d < tokenBestD) { tokenBestD = d; tokenBest = cand; }
            }
        }
        if (tokenBest != null) return (tokenBest, true);

        return (cleaned, false);
    }

    private static (string Value, bool Snapped) ExtractBestColor(string ocrText, string[] lexicon)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ocrText)) return ("", false);

        string cleaned = NormAr(StripHeaderPrefixes(ocrText))
            .Replace("Ù„ÙˆÙ†", "")
            .Replace("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø±ÙƒØ¨Ù‡", "")
            .Replace("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø±ÙƒØ¨Ø©", "")
            .Replace("Ø§Ù„Ø£ØµÙ„", "")
            .Replace("Ø§Ù„Ø§ØµÙ„", "")
            .Replace(":", "")
            .Trim();

        var sortedLexicon = lexicon.OrderByDescending(c => c.Length).ToList();

        foreach (var color in sortedLexicon)
        {
            if (cleaned.Contains(NormAr(color))) return (color, true);
        }

        string[] words = cleaned.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        string? bestMatch = null;
        int lowestDistance = int.MaxValue;

        foreach (var color in sortedLexicon)
        {
            string normColor = NormAr(color);

            int distFull = Lev(cleaned, normColor);
            if (distFull < lowestDistance && distFull <= 2)
            {
                lowestDistance = distFull;
                bestMatch = color;
            }

            foreach (var word in words)
            {
                int distWord = Lev(word, normColor);
                if (distWord < lowestDistance && distWord <= (normColor.Length >= 4 ? 1 : 0))
                {
                    lowestDistance = distWord;
                    bestMatch = color;
                }
            }
        }

        return (bestMatch ?? cleaned, bestMatch != null);
    }

    /// <summary>Pool Ø¨Ø³ÙŠØ·: ÙƒÙ„ Ù…Ø­Ø±Ùƒ Tesseract Ø¨ÙŠØªØ­Ù…Ù‘Ù„ Ù…Ø±Ø© ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© ÙˆÙŠØªØ¹Ø§Ø¯ Ø§Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ø§Ù…Ù‡ (ara.traineddata ~12MB).</summary>
    private sealed class TesseractEnginePool : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly string _tessDir;
        private readonly SemaphoreSlim _semaphore;
        private readonly ConcurrentBag<TesseractEngine> _idle = new();
        private readonly List<TesseractEngine> _all = new();
        private readonly object _gate = new();

        public TesseractEnginePool(string tessDir, int size)
        {
            _tessDir = tessDir;
            _semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(size, size);
        }

        public async Task<Lease> AcquireAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            await _semaphore.WaitAsync(ct);
            try
            {
                if (!_idle.TryTake(out var engine))
                {
                    if (!File.Exists(Path.Combine(_tessDir, "ara.traineddata")))
                        throw new InvalidOperationException(
                            $"ara.traineddata Ù…Ø´ Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯ ÙÙŠ: {_tessDir} (Ù…Ø·Ù„ÙˆØ¨ Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª Ø³Ø¬Ù„ ÙÙ‚Ø·. Ø­Ù…Ù‘Ù„Ù‡ Ù…Ù† tessdata_best ÙˆØ¸Ø¨Ù‘Ø· Certificates:TessdataPath).");

                    engine = new TesseractEngine(_tessDir, "ara", EngineMode.LstmOnly);
                    lock (_gate) _all.Add(engine);
                }
                return new Lease(this, engine);
            }
            catch
            {
                _semaphore.Release();
                throw;
            }
        }

        private void Release(TesseractEngine engine)
        {
            _idle.Add(engine);
            _semaphore.Release();
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                foreach (var e in _all) e.Dispose();
                _all.Clear();
            }
            _semaphore.Dispose();
        }

        public sealed class Lease : IDisposable
        {
            private readonly TesseractEnginePool _pool;
            private bool _released;
            public TesseractEngine Engine { get; }

            public Lease(TesseractEnginePool pool, TesseractEngine engine)
            {
                _pool = pool;
                Engine = engine;
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (_released) return;
                _released = true;
                _pool.Release(Engine);
            }
        }
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<CertificateListItemDto>>> ListAsync(
        CertificateQueryDto query, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        IQueryable<Certificate> q = _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking();

        if (query.BatchNo.HasValue)
        {
            var batchNo = query.BatchNo.Value;
            q = q.Where(c => c.BatchNo == batchNo);
        }
        else
        {
            switch ((query.Scope ?? "all").Trim().ToLowerInvariant())
            {
                case "latest-batch":
                    {
                        var latest = await _db.Certificates.MaxAsync(c => (int?)c.BatchNo, ct);
                        if (latest == null) return ApiResponse<PagedResult<CertificateListItemDto>>.SuccessResponse(EmptyPage(query));
                        q = q.Where(c => c.BatchNo == latest);
                        break;
                    }
                case "today":
                    {
                        var offset = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(Math.Clamp(query.TzOffsetMinutes ?? 180, -840, 840));
                        var startUtc = (DateTime.UtcNow + offset).Date - offset;
                        var endUtc = startUtc.AddDays(1);
                        q = q.Where(c => c.DiscoveredAt >= startUtc && c.DiscoveredAt < endUtc);
                        break;
                    }
            }
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.Status) &&
            Enum.TryParse<CertificateStatus>(query.Status, true, out var status))
        {
            q = q.Where(c => c.Status == status);
        }

        // Ø§Ù„Ø¨Ø­Ø«: Ø§Ø³Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„ÙØŒ Ø£Ùˆ Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© (Ø­Ø±ÙˆÙ + Ø£Ø±Ù‚Ø§Ù… Ù…Ø¹ Ø¨Ø¹Ø¶ØŒ Ø²ÙŠ: Ø§Ø¨Ù…7263). ØµÙŠØºØ© ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© Ø¨Ø³.
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.SearchTerm))
        {
            var term = query.SearchTerm.Trim();
            var plate = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(term);
            var searchPlate = plate.Length >= 3;

            q = q.Where(c =>
                c.FileName.ToLower().Contains(term.ToLower()) ||
                (searchPlate && c.NormalizedPlate != null && c.NormalizedPlate.Contains(plate)));
        }

        var total = await q.CountAsync(ct);

        var rows = await q
            .OrderByDescending(c => c.DiscoveredAt)
            .ThenBy(c => c.FileName)
            .Skip((query.PageNumber - 1) * query.PageSize)
            .Take(query.PageSize)
            .Select(c => new
            {
                c.Id, c.FileName, c.PlateLetters, c.PlateDigits, c.NormalizedPlate,
                c.Make, c.Model, c.Color, c.Lessor, c.Status, c.BatchNo, c.DiscoveredAt
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var items = rows.Select(c => new CertificateListItemDto(
            c.Id, c.FileName, PlateText.Display(c.PlateLetters, c.PlateDigits), c.NormalizedPlate,
            c.Make, c.Model, c.Color, c.Lessor, c.Status.ToString(),
            c.Status == CertificateStatus.NeedsReview, c.BatchNo, c.DiscoveredAt)).ToList();

        return ApiResponse<PagedResult<CertificateListItemDto>>.SuccessResponse(new PagedResult<CertificateListItemDto>
        {
            Items = items,
            PageNumber = query.PageNumber,
            PageSize = query.PageSize,
            TotalCount = total
        });
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<CertificateDetailDto>> GetAsync(Guid certificateId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var dto = await LoadDetailAsync(certificateId, ct);
        return dto == null
            ? ApiResponse<CertificateDetailDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø© ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯Ø©.", null, 404)
            : ApiResponse<CertificateDetailDto>.SuccessResponse(dto);
    }

    private async Task<CertificateDetailDto?> LoadDetailAsync(Guid certificateId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var c = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking().FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == certificateId, ct);
        if (c == null) return null;

        return new CertificateDetailDto(
            c.Id, c.FileName, c.Provider.ToString(), c.PlateLetters, c.PlateDigits,
            PlateText.Display(c.PlateLetters, c.PlateDigits), c.NormalizedPlate,
            c.Make, c.Model, c.Color, c.Lessor, c.Status.ToString(), c.StatusNote,
            c.IsManuallyEdited, !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.StoragePath), c.BatchNo, c.DiscoveredAt);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<CertificateBatchDto>>> ListBatchesAsync(
    PaginationParams pagination, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var total = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking().Select(c => c.BatchNo).Distinct().CountAsync(ct);

        var rows = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking()
            .GroupBy(c => c.BatchNo)
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Key)                       // order + page BEFORE projecting
            .Skip((pagination.PageNumber - 1) * pagination.PageSize)
            .Take(pagination.PageSize)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                BatchNo = g.Key,
                CreatedAt = g.Min(c => c.DiscoveredAt),
                Total = g.Count(),
                Extracted = g.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.Extracted),
                NeedsReview = g.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.NeedsReview),
                Failed = g.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.Failed),
                Pending = g.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.Pending || c.Status == CertificateStatus.Processing)
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var items = rows.Select(b => new CertificateBatchDto(
            b.BatchNo, b.CreatedAt, b.Total, b.Extracted, b.NeedsReview, b.Failed, b.Pending, b.Pending == 0)).ToList();

        return ApiResponse<PagedResult<CertificateBatchDto>>.SuccessResponse(new PagedResult<CertificateBatchDto>
        {
            Items = items,
            PageNumber = pagination.PageNumber,
            PageSize = pagination.PageSize,
            TotalCount = total
        });
    }
    public async Task<ApiResponse<CertificateBatchDto?>> GetLatestBatchAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var latest = await _db.Certificates.MaxAsync(c => (int?)c.BatchNo, ct);
        if (latest == null) return ApiResponse<CertificateBatchDto?>.SuccessResponse(null);   // no batches yet

        var b = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.BatchNo == latest)
            .GroupBy(c => c.BatchNo)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                BatchNo = g.Key,
                CreatedAt = g.Min(c => c.DiscoveredAt),
                Total = g.Count(),
                Extracted = g.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.Extracted),
                NeedsReview = g.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.NeedsReview),
                Failed = g.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.Failed),
                Pending = g.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.Pending || c.Status == CertificateStatus.Processing)
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        return ApiResponse<CertificateBatchDto?>.SuccessResponse(b == null ? null : new CertificateBatchDto(
            b.BatchNo, b.CreatedAt, b.Total, b.Extracted, b.NeedsReview, b.Failed, b.Pending, b.Pending == 0));
    }

    public async Task<(Stream Stream, string FileName)> OpenFileAsync(Guid certificateId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var cert = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.Id == certificateId)
            .Select(c => new { c.FileName, c.StoragePath, c.DriveFileId })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        if (cert == null) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Ø§Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø© ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯Ø©.");

        var fileName = cert.FileName.EndsWith(".pdf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? cert.FileName : cert.FileName + ".pdf";

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cert.StoragePath))
        {
            try
            {
                var local = await _storage.OpenReadAsync(cert.StoragePath, ct);
                return (local, fileName);
            }
            catch (FileNotFoundException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Local copy missing for certificate {Id}; falling back to Drive", certificateId);
            }
        }

        // Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ Ù†Ø³Ø®Ø© Ù…Ø­Ù„ÙŠØ©: Ù†Ø¬ÙŠØ¨Ù‡Ø§ Ù…Ù† Drive Ù…Ø¨Ø§Ø´Ø±Ø©
        var ms = new MemoryStream();
        try
        {
            await _drive.DownloadAsync(cert.DriveFileId, ms, ct);
        }
        catch (DriveAuthException ex)
        {
            ms.Dispose();
            throw new KeyNotFoundException("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ù…Ø´ Ù…ØªØ§Ø­ Ø¯Ù„ÙˆÙ‚ØªÙŠ: " + ex.Message);
        }
        ms.Position = 0;
        return (ms, fileName);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<CertificateSortResultDto>> CreateSortAsync(
        Guid currentUserId, CertificateSortRequestDto request, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var user = await _db.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == currentUserId)
            .Select(x => new { x.GroupId })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);
        if (user == null) return ApiResponse<CertificateSortResultDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404);

        var sortDenied = await _permissions.GetSortDeniedReasonAsync(currentUserId, ct);
        if (sortDenied is not null) return ApiResponse<CertificateSortResultDto>.Fail(sortDenied, null, 403);

        var batchNo = request.BatchNo ?? await _db.Certificates.MaxAsync(c => (int?)c.BatchNo, ct);
        if (batchNo == null)
            return ApiResponse<CertificateSortResultDto>.Fail("Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ Ø¯ÙØ¹Ø§Øª Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª Ù„Ø³Ù‡.", null, 404);

        var certs = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.BatchNo == batchNo)
            .OrderBy(c => c.FileName)
            .Select(c => new
            {
                c.FileName, c.Status, c.PlateLetters, c.PlateDigits, c.NormalizedPlate,
                c.Make, c.Model, c.Color, c.Lessor
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        if (certs.Count == 0)
            return ApiResponse<CertificateSortResultDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ø¯ÙØ¹Ø© Ø¯ÙŠ Ù…Ø´ Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯Ø©.", null, 404);

        var inProgress = certs.Count(c => c.Status is CertificateStatus.Pending or CertificateStatus.Processing);
        if (inProgress > 0)
            return ApiResponse<CertificateSortResultDto>.Fail(
                $"Ø§Ù„Ø¯ÙØ¹Ø© Ù„Ø³Ù‡ Ø¨ØªØªØ¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬ ({inProgress} Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø© Ù…ØªØ¨Ù‚ÙŠØ©). Ø¬Ø±Ù‘Ø¨ Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ Ø´ÙˆÙŠØ©.", null, 409);

        var skippedFailed = certs.Count(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.Failed);
        var usable = certs
            .Where(c => c.Status is CertificateStatus.Extracted or CertificateStatus.NeedsReview)
            .ToList();

        // Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ØµØ§Ù„Ø­Ø© = Ø­Ø±ÙˆÙ + Ø£Ø±Ù‚Ø§Ù…. Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø§Øª Ø§Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª Ø¨ØªØªØ·Ø¨Ù‘Ø¹ Ø¨Ù†ÙØ³ Normalize Ø¨ØªØ§Ø¹ Ù…Ù„ÙØ§Øª Ø§Ù„Ø¨ÙŠØ§Ù†Ø§Øª ÙˆÙ…Ù„Ù Ø§Ù„ØªØ´ÙŠÙƒ.
        var withPlate = usable
            .Where(c => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.PlateLetters) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.PlateDigits)
                        && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.NormalizedPlate))
            .ToList();
        var skippedNoPlate = usable.Count - withPlate.Count;

        if (withPlate.Count == 0)
            return ApiResponse<CertificateSortResultDto>.Fail("Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ Ø£ÙŠ Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø© ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø¯ÙØ¹Ø© Ø¯ÙŠ Ù„ÙŠÙ‡Ø§ Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ØµØ§Ù„Ø­Ø© Ù„Ù„ÙØ±Ø².", null, 422);

        var distinct = new Dictionary<string, (string Raw, string? ExtraJson)>();
        var duplicates = 0;
        foreach (var c in withPlate)
        {
            if (distinct.ContainsKey(c.NormalizedPlate!)) { duplicates++; continue; }

            var vehicleType = string.Join(" ", new[] { c.Make, c.Model }.Where(s => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)));
            var extra = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
            AddIfNotBlank(extra, ColFileName, c.FileName);
            AddIfNotBlank(extra, ColVehicleType, vehicleType);
            AddIfNotBlank(extra, ColColor, c.Color);
            AddIfNotBlank(extra, ColLessor, c.Lessor);

            distinct[c.NormalizedPlate!] = (
                PlateText.Display(c.PlateLetters, c.PlateDigits)!,
                extra.Count == 0 ? null : JsonSerializer.Serialize(extra));
        }

        var referralJob = new ReferralJob
        {
            GroupId = user.GroupId,
            UserId = currentUserId,
            FilterType = request.FilterType,
            SourceType = SourceType.Certificates,
            SourceFileName = $"Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª - Ø¯ÙØ¹Ø© {batchNo}",
            TotalReferralPlates = distinct.Count,
            Status = JobStatus.Processing,
            SelectedHistoricalColumnsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Enum.GetValues<HistoricalDataColumn>().ToList()),
            ReferralColumnsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new List<string> { ColFileName, ColVehicleType, ColColor, ColLessor })
        };
        _db.ReferralJobs.Add(referralJob);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);

        foreach (var chunk in distinct.Chunk(1000))
        {
            _db.ReferralPlates.AddRange(chunk.Select(kv => new ReferralPlate
            {
                ReferralJobId = referralJob.Id,
                RawPlate = kv.Value.Raw,
                NormalizedPlate = kv.Key,
                Status = ReferralPlateStatus.Unmatched,
                ExtraDataJson = kv.Value.ExtraJson
            }));
            await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
            _db.ChangeTracker.Clear();
        }

        var jobId = referralJob.Id;
        _jobs.Enqueue<ReferralMatchingJob>(job => job.ProcessAsync(jobId, CancellationToken.None));

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Certificate batch #{Batch} sent to sorting by user {UserId}: referral job {JobId}, {Count} plate(s)",
            batchNo, currentUserId, jobId, distinct.Count);

        return ApiResponse<CertificateSortResultDto>.SuccessResponse(
            new CertificateSortResultDto(jobId, batchNo.Value, distinct.Count, duplicates, skippedNoPlate, skippedFailed),
            "Ø¨Ø¯Ø£Ù†Ø§ Ù†Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬ Ø§Ù„ÙØ±Ø² ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ù„ÙÙŠØ©.", 202);
    }

    private static void AddIfNotBlank(Dictionary<string, string?> dict, string key, string? value)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) dict[key] = value.Trim();
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<CertificateSystemStatusDto>> GetSystemStatusAsync(bool liveCheck, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var state = _drive.GetState();
        var driveState = state.State;
        var email = state.AccountEmail;
        var lastError = state.LastError;

        if (liveCheck && _drive.IsConfigured)
        {
            try
            {
                email = await _drive.CheckConnectionAsync(ct);
                driveState = "Ok";
            }
            catch (DriveAuthException ex)
            {
                driveState = _drive.GetState().State;
                lastError = ex.Message;
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
            {
                lastError = ex.Message;
            }
        }

        var counts = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking()
            .GroupBy(c => c.Status)
            .Select(g => new { g.Key, N = g.Count() })
            .ToListAsync(ct);
        int Count(CertificateStatus s) => counts.Where(x => x.Key == s).Select(x => x.N).FirstOrDefault();

        var latest = await _db.Certificates.MaxAsync(c => (int?)c.BatchNo, ct) ?? 0;

        return ApiResponse<CertificateSystemStatusDto>.SuccessResponse(new CertificateSystemStatusDto(
            _drive.IsConfigured, driveState, email, state.LastSyncAt, state.LastSyncNewFiles, lastError, latest,
            Count(CertificateStatus.Pending), Count(CertificateStatus.Processing), Count(CertificateStatus.Extracted),
            Count(CertificateStatus.NeedsReview), Count(CertificateStatus.Failed)));
    }

    public Task<ApiResponse<bool>> TriggerSyncAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (!_drive.IsConfigured)
            return Task.FromResult(ApiResponse<bool>.Fail(
                "Ø¥Ø¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª Google Drive Ù†Ø§Ù‚ØµØ© (ClientId / ClientSecret / RefreshToken).", null, 409));

        _jobs.Enqueue<CertificateSyncJob>(j => j.SyncAsync(CancellationToken.None));
        return Task.FromResult(ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true, "Ø¨Ø¯Ø£Øª Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø²Ø§Ù…Ù†Ø© ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ù„ÙÙŠØ©.", 202));
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<RetryResultDto>> RetryAsync(Guid certificateId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var status = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.Id == certificateId)
            .Select(c => (CertificateStatus?)c.Status)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        if (status == null) return ApiResponse<RetryResultDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø© ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯Ø©.", null, 404);
        if (status == CertificateStatus.Processing)
            return ApiResponse<RetryResultDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø© Ù‚ÙŠØ¯ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø© Ø¯Ù„ÙˆÙ‚ØªÙŠ.", null, 409);

        await RequeueAsync(new List<Guid> { certificateId }, ct);
        return ApiResponse<RetryResultDto>.SuccessResponse(new RetryResultDto(1), "Ø§ØªØ¶Ø§ÙØª Ù„Ù„Ù…Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø© Ù…Ù† Ø¬Ø¯ÙŠØ¯.");
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<RetryResultDto>> RetryFailedAsync(bool includeStuck, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        // Failed Ø¯Ø§ÙŠÙ…Ø§Ù‹. ÙˆØ¨Ø´ÙƒÙ„ Ø§Ø®ØªÙŠØ§Ø±ÙŠ: Pending/Processing Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ù‚ÙŠÙ† Ù…Ù† Ø£ÙƒØªØ± Ù…Ù† Ø³Ø§Ø¹ØªÙŠÙ† (Ù…Ø«Ù„Ø§Ù‹ Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ Ø¥Ø¹Ø§Ø¯Ø© ØªØ´ØºÙŠÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ø³ÙŠØ±ÙØ±).
        var stuckBefore = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-2);
        var ids = await _db.Certificates.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(c => c.Status == CertificateStatus.Failed ||
                        (includeStuck
                         && (c.Status == CertificateStatus.Pending || c.Status == CertificateStatus.Processing)
                         && c.DiscoveredAt < stuckBefore))
            .Select(c => c.Id)
            .Take(5000)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        if (ids.Count == 0)
            return ApiResponse<RetryResultDto>.SuccessResponse(new RetryResultDto(0), "Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª ÙØ§Ø´Ù„Ø©.");

        await RequeueAsync(ids, ct);
        return ApiResponse<RetryResultDto>.SuccessResponse(new RetryResultDto(ids.Count), "Ø§ØªØ¶Ø§ÙØª Ù„Ù„Ù…Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø© Ù…Ù† Ø¬Ø¯ÙŠØ¯.");
    }

    private async Task RequeueAsync(List<Guid> ids, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        foreach (var part in ids.Chunk(1000))
        {
            var chunk = part.ToList();
            await _db.Certificates.Where(c => chunk.Contains(c.Id))
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(s => s
                    .SetProperty(c => c.Status, CertificateStatus.Pending)
                    .SetProperty(c => c.StatusNote, (string?)null), ct);
        }

        foreach (var id in ids)
        {
            var certId = id;
            _jobs.Enqueue<CertificateExtractionJob>(j => j.ExtractAsync(certId, CancellationToken.None));
        }
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<CertificateDetailDto>> UpdateAsync(
        Guid certificateId, UpdateCertificateDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var cert = await _db.Certificates.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == certificateId, ct);
        if (cert == null) return ApiResponse<CertificateDetailDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø© ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯Ø©.", null, 404);
        if (cert.Status == CertificateStatus.Processing)
            return ApiResponse<CertificateDetailDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ø´Ù‡Ø§Ø¯Ø© Ù‚ÙŠØ¯ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø© Ø¯Ù„ÙˆÙ‚ØªÙŠ.", null, 409);

        var plateChanged = false;

        if (dto.PlateLetters != null)
        {
            var letters = Regex.Replace(dto.PlateLetters, @"\s+", "");
            if (!LettersPattern.IsMatch(letters))
                return ApiResponse<CertificateDetailDto>.Fail("Ø­Ø±ÙˆÙ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªÙƒÙˆÙ† Ù…Ù† 1 Ø¥Ù„Ù‰ 3 Ø­Ø±ÙˆÙ Ø¹Ø±Ø¨ÙŠØ©.");
            cert.PlateLetters = letters;
            plateChanged = true;
        }

            cert.PlateDigits = digits;
            plateChanged = true;

        {
            var all = (cert.PlateLetters ?? "") + (cert.PlateDigits ?? "");
            cert.NormalizedPlate = all.Length == 0 ? null : PlateNormalizer.Normalize(all);
        }

        if (dto.Make != null) cert.Make = TextUtil.NullIfBlank(TextUtil.Truncate(dto.Make.Trim(), 100));
        if (dto.Model != null) cert.Model = TextUtil.NullIfBlank(TextUtil.Truncate(dto.Model.Trim(), 100));
        if (dto.Color != null) cert.Color = TextUtil.NullIfBlank(TextUtil.Truncate(dto.Color.Trim(), 100));
        if (dto.Lessor != null) cert.Lessor = TextUtil.NullIfBlank(TextUtil.Truncate(dto.Lessor.Trim(), 200));

        cert.IsManuallyEdited = true;

            cert.Status = CertificateStatus.Extracted;
            cert.StatusNote = null;
        }

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
        _logger.LogInformation("Certificate {Id} edited manually", certificateId);

        var detail = await LoadDetailAsync(certificateId, ct);
        return ApiResponse<CertificateDetailDto>.SuccessResponse(detail!, "ØªÙ… Ø§Ù„Ø­ÙØ¸.");
    }

/// <summary>
/// Drive ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯ global (Singleton). Ø§Ù„Ø¥Ø¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª Ù…Ø±Ø© ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø©:

public sealed class GoogleDriveClient : IGoogleDriveClient
{
    private const string FolderMime = "application/vnd.google-apps.folder";
    private const string PdfMime = "application/pdf";
    private const string ShortcutMime = "application/vnd.google-apps.shortcut";

    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly ILogger<GoogleDriveClient> _logger;
    private readonly object _gate = new();

    private UserCredential? _credential;
    private string _state = "Unknown";
    private string? _accountEmail;
    private DateTime? _lastSyncAt;
    private int _lastSyncNewFiles;
    private string? _lastError;

    public GoogleDriveClient(IConfiguration configuration, ILogger<GoogleDriveClient> logger)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public bool IsConfigured =>
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_configuration["GoogleDrive:ClientId"]) &&
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_configuration["GoogleDrive:ClientSecret"]) &&
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_configuration["GoogleDrive:RefreshToken"]);

    public DriveStateSnapshot GetState()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return new DriveStateSnapshot(
                IsConfigured ? _state : "NotConfigured",
                _accountEmail, _lastSyncAt, _lastSyncNewFiles, _lastError);
        }
    }

    public void ReportSync(int newFiles, string? error)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _lastSyncAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            _lastSyncNewFiles = newFiles;
            _lastError = error;
        }
    }

    // ============================ Credentials ============================

    private UserCredential GetCredential()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_credential != null) return _credential;

            var flow = new GoogleAuthorizationCodeFlow(new GoogleAuthorizationCodeFlow.Initializer
            {
                ClientSecrets = new ClientSecrets
                {
                    ClientId = _configuration["GoogleDrive:ClientId"],
                    ClientSecret = _configuration["GoogleDrive:ClientSecret"]
                },
                Scopes = new[] { DriveService.Scope.DriveReadonly }
            });

            // Ø§Ù„Ù€ credential Ø¨ÙŠØªØ¹Ù…Ù„ Ù…Ø±Ø© ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© ÙˆÙŠØ¬Ø¯Ù‘Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Access Token Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø¯Ù‡
            _credential = new UserCredential(flow, "drive-sync",
                new TokenResponse { RefreshToken = _configuration["GoogleDrive:RefreshToken"] });
            return _credential;
        }
    }

    private static bool IsAuthRevoked(TokenResponseException ex) =>
        ex.Error?.Error is "invalid_grant" or "invalid_client" or "unauthorized_client";

    private void SetState(string state, string? error = null)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _state = state;
            if (error != null) _lastError = error;
        }
    }

    private async Task<T> WithDriveAsync<T>(Func<DriveService, Task<T>> action)
    {
        if (!IsConfigured)
            throw new DriveAuthException("Ø¥Ø¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª Google Drive Ù†Ø§Ù‚ØµØ© (GoogleDrive:ClientId / ClientSecret / RefreshToken).");

        using var service = new DriveService(new BaseClientService.Initializer
        {
            HttpClientInitializer = GetCredential(),
            ApplicationName = _configuration["GoogleDrive:ApplicationName"] ?? "Bank.Certificates"
        });

        try
        {
            var result = await action(service);
            SetState("Ok");
            return result;
        }
        catch (TokenResponseException ex) when (IsAuthRevoked(ex))
        {
            var reason = ex.Error?.Error ?? ex.Message;
            _logger.LogWarning("Drive refresh token rejected: {Reason}", reason);
            SetState("NeedsReauth", reason);
            throw new DriveAuthException("Ø¬ÙˆØ¬Ù„ Ø±ÙØ¶Øª Ø§Ù„Ù€ Refresh Token (Ø§ØªÙ„ØºÙ‰ Ø£Ùˆ Ø§Ù†ØªÙ‡Ù‰). Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªÙˆÙ„Ù‘Ø¯ ØªÙˆÙƒÙ† Ø¬Ø¯ÙŠØ¯ ÙˆØªØ­Ø¯Ù‘Ø« Ø§Ù„Ø¥Ø¹Ø¯Ø§Ø¯Ø§Øª.", ex);
        }
    }

    public Task<string?> CheckConnectionAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>

        {

            req.Fields = "user(emailAddress)";

    /// <summary>
    /// ÙƒÙ„ Ù…Ù„Ù PDF ÙÙŠ "Shared with me": Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„ÙØ§Øª Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø´ØªØ±ÙƒØ© Ù…Ø¨Ø§Ø´Ø±Ø© + ÙƒÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ø¬ÙˆÙ‡ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø¬Ù„Ø¯Ø§Øª Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø´ØªØ±ÙƒØ© (Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø£ÙŠ Ø¹Ù…Ù‚).
    /// </summary>
    public Task<List<DriveFileInfo>> ListAllSharedPdfsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        WithDriveAsync(async service =>
        {
            var files = new List<DriveFileInfo>();
            var seenFiles = new HashSet<string>();
            var visitedFolders = new HashSet<string>();
            var folderQueue = new Queue<string>();

            void Collect(IList<Google.Apis.Drive.v3.Data.File>? items)
            {
                if (items == null) return;
                foreach (var f in items)
                {
                    if (f.MimeType == FolderMime)
                    {
                        if (!visitedFolders.Contains(f.Id)) folderQueue.Enqueue(f.Id);
                    }
                    else if (f.MimeType == PdfMime)
                    {
                        if (seenFiles.Add(f.Id))
                            files.Add(new DriveFileInfo(f.Id, f.Name, f.CreatedTimeDateTimeOffset?.UtcDateTime));
                    }
                    else if (f.MimeType == ShortcutMime && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(f.ShortcutDetails?.TargetId))
                    {
                        var targetId = f.ShortcutDetails!.TargetId;
                        if (f.ShortcutDetails.TargetMimeType == FolderMime)
                        {
                            if (!visitedFolders.Contains(targetId)) folderQueue.Enqueue(targetId);
                        }
                        else if (f.ShortcutDetails.TargetMimeType == PdfMime && seenFiles.Add(targetId))
                        {
                            files.Add(new DriveFileInfo(targetId, f.Name, f.CreatedTimeDateTimeOffset?.UtcDateTime));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            const string fields = "nextPageToken, files(id, name, mimeType, createdTime, shortcutDetails(targetId, targetMimeType))";

            // 1) Ø§Ù„Ø£ØµÙ†Ø§Ù Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø´ØªØ±ÙƒØ© Ù…Ø¨Ø§Ø´Ø±Ø© Ù…Ø¹ Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø³Ø§Ø¨ (Ù…Ø¬Ù„Ø¯Ø§Øª ÙˆÙ…Ù„ÙØ§Øª)
            string? pageToken = null;
            do
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                var req = service.Files.List();
                req.Q = "sharedWithMe = true and trashed = false";
                req.Fields = fields;
                req.PageSize = 1000;
                req.PageToken = pageToken;
                req.SupportsAllDrives = true;
                req.IncludeItemsFromAllDrives = true;

                var resp = await req.ExecuteAsync(ct);
                Collect(resp.Files);
                pageToken = resp.NextPageToken;
            } while (pageToken != null);

            // 2) Ø§Ù„Ø²Ø­Ù Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ ÙƒÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø¬Ù„Ø¯Ø§Øª (BFS)
            while (folderQueue.Count > 0)
            {
                var folderId = folderQueue.Dequeue();
                if (!visitedFolders.Add(folderId)) continue;

                pageToken = null;
                do
                {
                    ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    var req = service.Files.List();
                    req.Q = $"'{EscapeId(folderId)}' in parents and trashed = false";
                    req.Fields = fields;
                    req.PageSize = 1000;
                    req.PageToken = pageToken;
                    req.SupportsAllDrives = true;
                    req.IncludeItemsFromAllDrives = true;

                    var resp = await req.ExecuteAsync(ct);
                    Collect(resp.Files);
                    pageToken = resp.NextPageToken;
                } while (pageToken != null);
            }

            return files;
        });

    public Task DownloadAsync(string fileId, Stream destination, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        WithDriveAsync(async service =>
        {
            var get = service.Files.Get(fileId);
            get.SupportsAllDrives = true;
            var progress = await get.DownloadAsync(destination, ct);
            if (progress.Status != DownloadStatus.Completed)
                throw new IOException("ÙØ´Ù„ ØªØ­Ù…ÙŠÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ù…Ù† Drive: " + (progress.Exception?.Message ?? progress.Status.ToString()), progress.Exception);
            return true;
        });

    /// <summary>IDs Ø¬ÙˆØ¬Ù„ Ø­Ø±ÙˆÙ ÙˆØ£Ø±Ù‚Ø§Ù… Ùˆ - Ùˆ _ Ø¨Ø³. Ø£ÙŠ Ø­Ø§Ø¬Ø© ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠØ© Ø¨ØªØªØ´Ø§Ù„ Ø¹Ø´Ø§Ù† Ù…Ø§Ù†ÙƒØ³Ø±Ø´ Ø§Ù„Ù€ query.</summary>
    private static string EscapeId(string id) =>
        new(id.Where(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c is '-' or '_').ToArray());
}

public class LiveCheckConnectionManager : ILiveCheckConnectionManager
{

    public void Add(string connectionId, LiveCheckConnectionState state) => _connections[connectionId] = state;

    public LiveCheckConnectionState? Get(string connectionId) =>

    public async Task<(CheckSession Session, Guid? CheckFileId)> CreateSessionAsync(
        Guid userId, string district, string street, string? excelSheetName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(userId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var activeCheckFileId = await _dbContext.CheckFiles

            .Where(f => userScope.GroupId.HasValue
                ? f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value
                : f.GroupId == null && f.UploadedBy == userId)
            .Select(f => (Guid?)f.Id)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var displayName = await GenerateUniqueDisplayNameAsync(userScope.GroupId, userId, street, cancellationToken);

        var session = new CheckSession
        {
            UserId = userId,
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            CheckFileId = activeCheckFileId,
            District = district,
            Street = street,
            ExcelSheetName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(excelSheetName) ? displayName : excelSheetName!.Trim(),
            DisplayName = displayName,
            Status = SessionStatus.Recording,
            StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        await _unit.Repository<CheckSession>().AddAsync(session);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "CheckSession {SessionId} ({DisplayName}) started by user {UserId}, snapshot CheckFileId={CheckFileId}",
            session.Id, displayName, userId, activeCheckFileId);

        return (session, activeCheckFileId);
    }

    public async Task<LiveCheckPlateResultDto> ProcessDetectionAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid userId, Guid? groupId, Guid? checkFileId, string district, string street,
        double? latitude, double? longitude, AiPlateDetectedEvent detection, CheckType checkType,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {

        long? matchedCheckPlateId = null;

        {
            matchedCheckPlateId = await _dbContext.CheckPlates
                .Where(cp => cp.CheckFileId == checkFileId.Value && cp.NormalizedPlate == normalized)

                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

            MatchedCheckPlateId = matchedCheckPlateId,
            CheckedAt = DateTime.UtcNow

            .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)

        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

    public async Task<ApiResponse<List<CheckSessionSummaryDto>>> GetAllAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<LiveCheckLogRowDto>>> GetPlatesAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid userId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {

            .OrderBy(l => l.CheckedAt)
            .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize)

                l.Id, l.NormalizedPlate, l.Location, l.CheckedAt, l.District, l.Street,
                l.User.FullName, l.VehicleType, l.IsMatched))

        {
            Items = items,
            PageSize = pageSize,
            PageNumber = page,
            TotalCount = totalCount
        };

    private async Task<string> GenerateUniqueDisplayNameAsync(
        Guid? groupId, Guid userId, string baseName, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var query = _dbContext.CheckSessions.AsNoTracking();
        query = groupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(s => s.GroupId == groupId.Value)
            : query.Where(s => s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == userId);

        var existingNames = new HashSet<string>(
            await query.Where(s => s.DisplayName.StartsWith(baseName)).Select(s => s.DisplayName).ToListAsync(cancellationToken));

        if (!existingNames.Contains(baseName)) return baseName;

        var suffix = 1;
        while (existingNames.Contains($"{baseName} ({suffix})")) suffix++;
        return $"{baseName} ({suffix})";
    }

    private async Task<bool> EnsureSessionInScopeAsync(Guid sessionId, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(userId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return false;

        return await _dbContext.CheckSessions.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, userId, sessionId), cancellationToken);
    }

    private async Task<UserScopeInfo?> ResolveUserScopeAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .WithEffectiveGroup()
            .Where(x => x.User.Id == userId)
            .Select(x => new UserScopeInfo(x.GroupId))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static System.Linq.Expressions.Expression<Func<CheckSession, bool>> ScopeFilter(Guid? groupId, Guid userId, Guid sessionId)
    {
        return groupId.HasValue
            ? s => s.Id == sessionId && s.GroupId == groupId.Value
            : s => s.Id == sessionId && s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == userId;
    }

    private record UserScopeInfo(Guid? GroupId);
}

public class WebSocketLiveCheckAiSession : ILiveCheckAiSession

    public async Task SendAudioChunkAsync(byte[] chunk, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

    public async IAsyncEnumerable<AiPlateEvent> ReadDetectionsAsync(
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var buffer = new byte[8192];

        while (_socket.State == WebSocketState.Open && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            using var messageStream = new MemoryStream();
            WebSocketReceiveResult result;
            var isNonTextMessage = false;

            do
            {
                result = await _socket.ReceiveAsync(buffer, cancellationToken);

                if (result.MessageType == WebSocketMessageType.Close)
                {
                    yield break;
                }

                if (result.MessageType != WebSocketMessageType.Text)
                {
                    // Ø§Ù„Ø±Ø³Ø§ÙŠÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ù†ØµÙŠØ© (JSON) Ø¨Ø³ Ù‡ÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ ÙÙŠÙ‡Ø§ Ø£Ø­Ø¯Ø§Ø« â€” Ø£ÙŠ Ø­Ø§Ø¬Ø© ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠØ©
                    // (binary ØºÙ„Ø· Ø¬Ø§ÙŠ Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ù†ÙØ³ Ø§Ù„Ù‚Ù†Ø§Ø© Ù…Ø«Ù„Ù‹Ø§) Ø¨Ù†ØªØ¬Ø§Ù‡Ù„Ù‡Ø§ Ø¨Ù‡Ø¯ÙˆØ¡.
                    _logger.LogWarning("Ignoring unexpected non-text AI message.");
                    isNonTextMessage = true;
                    break;
                }

                messageStream.Write(buffer, 0, result.Count);
            }
            while (!result.EndOfMessage);

            if (isNonTextMessage) continue;

            var json = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(messageStream.ToArray());

            AiRawMessage? message;
            try
            {
                message = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AiRawMessage>(json, JsonOptions);
            }
            catch (JsonException ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Could not parse AI message: {Json}", json);
                continue;
            }

            if (message?.Type is null) continue;

            var timestamp = message.TimestampMs ?? 0;

            switch (message.Type.ToLowerInvariant())
            {
                case "plate_detected":
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.PlateNumber))
                    {
                        yield return new PlateDetectedEvent(message.PlateNumber, message.VehicleType, timestamp);
                    }
                    break;

                case "plate_correction":
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.NewPlateNumber))
                    {
                        yield return new PlateCorrectionEvent(message.NewPlateNumber, message.VehicleType, timestamp);
                    }
                    break;

                case "plate_replacement":
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.OldPlateNumber) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.NewPlateNumber))
                    {
                        yield return new PlateReplacementEvent(message.OldPlateNumber, message.NewPlateNumber, message.VehicleType, timestamp);
                    }
                    break;

                case "error":
                    _logger.LogWarning("AI reported an error: {Message}", message.Message);
                    break;

                default:
                    // â­ Ø£ÙŠ Ù†ÙˆØ¹ ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠ (session_readyØŒ Ø¥Ù„Ø®) Ø¨ÙŠØªØªØ¬Ø§Ù‡Ù„ Ø¨Ù‡Ø¯ÙˆØ¡ØŒ Ù…Ø´ error â€”

                    _logger.LogDebug("Ignoring unsupported AI event type: {Type}", message.Type);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Shared.DTOs
{
    public interface IApiResponse
    {
        bool Success { get; }
        string? Message { get; }
        List<string>? Errors { get; }
        string? TraceId { get; set; }
        int StatusCode { get; set; }
    }

    public class ApiResponse<T> : IApiResponse
    {
        public bool Success { get; init; }
        public string? Message { get; init; }
        public T? Data { get; init; }
        public List<string>? Errors { get; init; }
        public string? TraceId { get; set; }
        public int StatusCode { get; set; } = 200;

        public static ApiResponse<T> SuccessResponse(T data, string? message = null, int statusCode = 200) =>
            new()
            {
                Success = true,
                Data = data,
                Message = message,
                StatusCode = statusCode
            };

        public static ApiResponse<T> Fail(string message, List<string>? errors = null, int statusCode = 400) =>
            new()
            {
                Success = false,
                Message = message,
                Errors = errors ?? new List<string> { message },
                StatusCode = statusCode
            };
    }

    public class ApiResponse : ApiResponse<object>
    {
        public static ApiResponse SuccessResponse(string? message = null, int statusCode = 200) =>
            new()
            {
                Success = true,
                Data = null,
                Message = message,
                StatusCode = statusCode
            };

        public static new ApiResponse Fail(string message, List<string>? errors = null, int statusCode = 400) =>
            new()
            {
                Success = false,
                Message = message,
                Errors = errors ?? new List<string> { message },
                StatusCode = statusCode
            };
    }

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Shared\DTOs\PaginationParams.cs =====
public class PaginationParams
{
    private const int MaxPageSize = 100;
    private int _pageSize = 20;

    public int PageNumber { get; set; } = 1;

    public int PageSize
    {
        get => _pageSize;
        set => _pageSize = value <= 0 ? 20 : Math.Min(value, MaxPageSize);
    }

    public string? SearchTerm { get; set; }
}

namespace Bank.Shared.DTOs
{
    public class PagedResult<T>
    {
        public IEnumerable<T> Items { get; set; } = Enumerable.Empty<T>();
        public int PageNumber { get; set; }
        public int PageSize { get; set; }
        public int TotalCount { get; set; }
        public int TotalPages => (int)Math.Ceiling((double)TotalCount / PageSize);

    }
